raw.description:
Role: Senior Associate - Policy Engagement, Mumbai
Experience: 4+ years
Salary: 9 to 12 LPA

Role Overview
We seek individuals to work in our Policy Engagement vertical and help us in the creation of evidence-backed collaterals. This will involve conducting literature reviews, analyzing government budgets, policies, and programs, reviewing existing evidence, and liaising with academics and experts to produce sharp insights, policy briefs, and actionable toolkits.
This role requires a solid understanding of public policy in India, social research methodologies, and program evaluation. Most importantly, the ideal candidate must have a strong belief that cash transfers empower people with choice, dignity, and the ability to carve their own path out of poverty.
Key Responsibilities:
Research & Data Analysis
  • Work closely with the policy research and program teams to conduct evidence-based research on social policies and author articles and briefs.
  • Develop concept notes and decks for proposed ideas and programs.
  • Support in producing comprehensive research reports, whitepapers, and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Ensure wide dissemination of insights into the cash transfer movement, including existing schemes, internal implementation, and global research.
  • Support monitoring, evaluation, and data analysis efforts, including building research tools for program implementation.
Policy Engagement
  • Undertake rigorous analysis of different aspects of the cash transfer movement in India to understand gap areas and potential solutions to strengthen our role in enabling cost-effective impact at scale.
  • Support the team in developing and executing a policy engagement plan to engage with relevant stakeholders, including governments.
Communication
  • Effectively communicate research findings to stakeholders through slide decks, concept notes, policy briefs, op-eds, newspaper articles, and journals.
  • Build and maintain stakeholder relationships independently.
Qualifications and Experience:
  • Education: A Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  • Work Experience: At least 3 years of full-time, relevant work experience with a preferred Master's degree.
  • Alternatively, candidates with a Master's degree and at least 6 years of full-time work experience in empirical analysis, policy-focused research, and writing will be considered.
  • Candidates with over 3 years of experience working with government stakeholders on a day-to-day basis are highly preferred.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience in preparing high-quality policy briefs, research papers, and concept notes is required.
  • Experience working with government orders, budgets, and policies is required.
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, data analysis, and interpretation is required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools is required.
  • Prior experience with data analysis software such as Stata, R, JAMOVI, or Tableau is preferred.
  • Familiarity with major Indian research datasets and experience compiling/using complex, large-scale datasets is preferred.
Knowledge & Competencies:
  • Familiarity with cash transfer programs, poverty dynamics, social security systems, and fieldwork is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of macroeconomics, public policy, and development economics is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated commitment to ethical research practices and a passion for social justice.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, handling uncertainties, and adapting quickly to organizational needs.
  • Language & Travel:
    • Ability to understand Marathi; proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the language is preferred.
Hiring Process:
Step 1: R1 with co-founder
Step 2: Assignment
Step 3: R2 with other co-founder
-
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on rolling basis. This job is reposted on November 12, 2026 on Ground Zero

For any questions, ping us on WhatsApp chat: +91-8058331557

We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love.Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀

Why should you apply? 🌟

  • Take ownership of a significant revenue target with the opportunity to directly influence business growth and success

  • Enjoy strong earning potential with a competitive base salary and commission.

  • Be part of a collaborative, experienced team with opportunities for long-term career development

  • Work in a highly consultative sales environment where you can leverage both your commercial expertise and relationship-building skills

  • Play a key role in shaping and expanding strategic client relationships within a growing international business

  • Base salary from £80,000, base + uncapped commission (OTE up to 2xbase salary)

  • Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025 and Technology award winner

  • Work for a profitable, fast-growingmarket leaderin the online reward and benefits space

**Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship and require people to be based in the UK or Ireland for this position**

Great benefits:

🤸 Flexible work – choose a working setup that works for you. You must be based in the UK or Ireland and some travel is involved in this role

💸 Full access to our comprehensive benefits package, including discounts from hundreds of high street brands, salary sacrifice schemes across Finance, Health, Tech, and more

🎂 Your birthday off

❤️ Two half day wellbeing days

🩺 Healthcare cash plan to cover the costs of day-to-day healthcare

🧠 Employee Assistance Plan 24/7 365 support

🤒 Income Protection (75%) and life assurance (4x salary)

💰 Referral bonuses

🌟 Enhanced parental leave package - 26 weeks fully paid maternity leave and 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave

✈️ Work from Anywhere policy for 90 days

🏖️ Buy and Sell scheme for holidays

💳 £50 monthly allowance to spend on whatever takes your fancy, your very own Benifex card will be topped up at the start of each month!

Role Overview 🚀

We are looking for a commercially driven Global Account Director to join our sales team. This is a quota-carrying role focused on winning new business and developing strategic client relationships. You will be responsible for selling complex, high-value solutions that combine market-leading technology with managed services.

This role would suit someone with a strong track record in consultative sales who is comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments and closing enterprise-level opportunities.

Responsibilities 🤘

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation, contracting and deal closure

  • Deliver against individual revenue targets and contribute to the overall growth strategy of the business

  • Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across target markets and customer segments

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, including HR, Reward, Benefits, Finance and Procurement leaders

  • Lead complex, consultative sales engagements involving multiple decision-makers and stakeholder groups

  • Understand customer challenges and position solutions that combine technology, services and industry expertise to deliver measurable value

  • Develop compelling commercial proposals, business cases and presentations tailored to customer needs

  • Collaborate with Product, Client Services, Implementation and Leadership teams to ensure a seamless customer experience throughout the sales process

  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast, providing regular updates on opportunities, risks and expected outcomes

  • Represent the business at industry events, networking opportunities and client meetings to build market presence and generate new opportunities

  • Stay informed on market trends, competitor activity and developments within the employee benefits and HR technology landscape

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospective clients, helping them shape and deliver their employee benefits and engagement strategies

What are we looking for? 🔎

  • A strong track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a quota-carrying role

  • Experience selling complex solutions that combine technology, services, or consulting offerings

  • A consultative and commercially minded approach, focused on understanding client challenges and delivering value-led solutions

  • The ability to build credibility quickly and engage confidently with senior decision-makers, including HR, Reward, Benefits, Finance and Procurement leaders

  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing multiple stakeholders throughout a sales process

  • Excellent presentation, negotiation and communication skills

  • A proactive, self-motivated mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and drive them through to completion

  • Experience managing long and complex sales cycles, from initial engagement through to contract close

  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, proposals and compelling value propositions

  • The resilience and adaptability required to succeed in a fast-paced, evolving business environment

  • Working knowledge or formal certification in MEDDIC sales training/methodology

Even if you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply! We are looking for talented and passionate individuals who are eager to learn and grow.

Our interview process

✌ Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.

📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team

⏳ Interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team

🤩 Final interview with the Director

  • Evaluate technical skills, tools, certifications and functional expertise against each requirement.
  • Advance qualified candidates to client interviews with complete, accurate and compelling submissions.
  • Hold two-way conversations with candidates by text, email or phone, and keep the team informed.
  • Keep candidate records accurate and current in the ATS, working within the firm's internal platform and tools such as Deel, TNS ATS, LinkedIn and Indeed.
  • Work toward weekly targets of about 20 interviews, 15 submissions and 50 two-way candidate conversations.

Requirements

  • Staffing industry experience in a production-driven recruiting environment.
  • At least 2 years supporting U.S. clients in the current or most recent role.
  • Experience recruiting IT, engineering or professional services talent.
  • Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confident using ATS platforms, sourcing tools and AI.

Qualifications

  • Recent staffing agency recruiting experience, ideally with alignment in healthcare, IT, engineering or professional services staffing.
  • Technical recruiting and strong Boolean sourcing skills (strongly preferred).

Soft skills

  • Proactive go-getter who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Warm and personable, with the ability to build trust with candidates quickly.
  • Highly goal driven, and energized by performance tracking that is highly visible.

Benefits

  • Full time, 100% remote.
  • Protected recruiting time, focused on sourcing, attracting and interviewing.
  • Transparent scorecards, so success is always clear.
  • Specialized desks that build deep expertise and strong talent networks.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced payroll specialist to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team. We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. Our Global Payroll Operations team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our global payroll products, which are natively built and fully integrated with Rippling’s broader suite of products.

As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to develop new muscles around global product operations and country-specific payroll expertise outside of the US.

This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is a critical hire for the Global Payroll Operations team that will be fully dedicated to developing and executing these new capabilities. This role will own all operational aspects across select countries, relationships with our external partners, and drive our expansion into new customer segments and geographies. Additionally, this role brings critical country-specific payroll expertise to support the development of our natively built payroll software.

This is an exciting role that requires significant cross-departmental engagement with a major impact on the product and customer experience.

What you will do

  • Execute timely payroll, filings, and payments for all customers across key countries
  • Drive issue resolution and communication with various government agencies and partners; you will directly interface with our customers and resolve issues on their behalf
  • Work closely with Global Payroll Engineering and Product teams to ensure that:
    • Natively built payroll software supports key payroll and tax compliance requirements
    • Product bugs and product issues (e.g., calculation errors, file generation errors) are quickly addressed
    • Internal tooling requirements are properly prioritised and implemented

What you will need

  • Minimum of 5+ years in a UAE payroll processing role, and ideally 2+ years in a client facing role
  • Expert knowledge of UAE payroll.
  • Bonus if you have experience running payroll in other EMEA countries.
  • Process payroll activities in accordance with company guidelines, social security, legislations and local taxes requirements.
  • Experience with Google Suite or Microsoft Office, especially Docs/Sheets/Excel, for data analysis and task organisation; familiarity with Salesforce queues, JIRA, and Confluence a plus
  • Ability to review and validate calculations
  • Must have understanding of payroll concepts
  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations
  • Has working experience with payroll related systems and software
  • Deep understanding of the leave entitlements
  • Good knowledge of labor legislation
  • Strong organisational skills and able to work under strict deadlines
  • Fluent in Arabic and English - written and spoken

Please apply with CV in English

Our team of seasoned professionals' designs, builds, manages, and maintains critical and sustainable infrastructure for the power, oil & gas pipeline, gas distribution, and communications industries. Building on a 100-year legacy of performance and service to utility, commercial, industrial, and government clients, H&M West brings together extensive knowledge and innovation to deliver infrastructure construction solutions that meet future energy needs today. H&M West is a purpose-driven company. Our core values guide our strategy, performance, and culture. We believe in maintaining an environment where team members can make an impact, grow, and thrive. A place where they find meaning and purpose in doing the important work of ensuring communities have the vital energy, light, and communications to prosper. Our culture is inclusive and welcoming. Our teams are empowered with abundant training, tools, and opportunities to follow their curiosity and ambitions. Everyone has an equal chance to advance. Everyone is supported, respected, and challenged to be their best. We’re always looking for talented and dedicated people to join us and love where they work. Henkels & McCoy West is a proud subsidiary of MasTec (NYSE: MTZ), a Fortune 500 Company ranked by Energy News-Record as one of the leading contractors in the country. H&M West is part of the MasTec Power Delivery segment. We are certified as a minority-controlled company by the National Minority Suppliers Development Council (NMSDC). Our rich diversity of people and ideas makes us a stronger, more innovative organization. Position Summary: The Estimator II prepares timely and accurate bid estimates for medium to large-scale projects and programs within the Power and Utilities market, including transmission, substation, and distribution construction. This role is responsible for developing competitive cost estimates, bid strategies, and project execution plans while ensuring the efficient use of personnel, equipment, materials, and subcontractors within contract requirements, schedule constraints, and operational objectives. The Estimator II possesses a strong understanding of utility construction practices, utility contracting methods, and the cost drivers associated with electric transmission, substation, and distribution infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will have direct experience preparing bids and proposals for major Investor-Owned Utilities (IOUs), municipal utilities, electric cooperatives, and other utility clients while ensuring compliance with Henkels & McCoy's Project Management Methodology and safety and quality standards. Responsibilities Prepare detailed estimates and competitive bids for power transmission, substation, and distribution construction projects. Analyze utility bid packages, engineering drawings, technical specifications, and contract documents issued by IOUs, municipal utilities, electric cooperatives, and other utility owners. Develop labor, equipment, subcontractor, and material pricing strategies specific to utility infrastructure projects. Lead bid reviews and risk assessments associated with utility construction programs, including EPC, unit-price, and design-build delivery models. Build and maintain relationships with utility clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal operations teams to support successful bid development and project execution. Provide estimating expertise and support for change orders, scope modifications, and contract negotiations throughout project lifecycles. Maintain knowledge of utility industry standards, utility procurement processes, and regional market conditions throughout the Western United States. Qualifications 5+ years of estimating experience within the electric utility construction industry. Demonstrated experience preparing successful bids and estimates for transmission, substation, and/or distribution projects. Direct experience working with major Investor-Owned Utilities (IOUs), municipal utilities, public utility districts, and electric cooperatives. Advanced knowledge of utility construction methods, utility contract structures, labor productivity factors, and cost estimating principles. Experience with computerized estimating and bidding software and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Ability to interpret utility engineering drawings, technical specifications, procurement documents, and construction contracts. Strong analytical, financial, and complex problem-solving skills. Completion of H&M PMM training and formal Project Management coursework preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience estimating projects for utilities such as SCE, PG&E, SDG&E, LADWP, APS, SRP, NV Energy, PacifiCorp, PNM, and other western utility clients. Knowledge of utility work methods, grid modernization programs, wildfire mitigation programs, underground distribution, and transmission line construction. Experience supporting master service agreements (MSAs), unit-price contracts, and utility capital improvement programs. Salary Range: $80,000/yr to 120,000/yr (will be dependent upon level of experience) Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefit plan which includes the following: 401(k) Plan Employee Stock Purchase Plan Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance Voluntary Life Insurance Voluntary Short Term & Long-Term Disability Paid time off Henkels & McCoy West, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.

raw.excerpt: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES• Lead enterprise evidence strategy for pipeline and commercial products.
raw.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead enterprise evidence strategy for pipeline and commercial products.
  • Develop strategic go to market plans which include market horizon scope, competitive analysis, strategic coding and reimbursement opportunity and planning
  • Lead HEOR, RWE, clinical utility, budget impact and cost-effectiveness studies.
  • Guide evidence generation supporting payer coverage, reimbursement and technology assessment submissions.
  • Partner with Product, Market Access, Clinical Affairs and Medical Affairs to align pipeline strategy and commercialization readiness.
  • Lead publication planning, value dossiers, abstracts, posters and manuscripts.
  • Represent Baylor Genetics with payers, KOLs, academic collaborators and industry organizations.
  • Lead teams of HEOR scientists, analysts and genetic counselors.

Key Success Metrics

  • Completion of annual evidence-generation objectives.
  • Positive payer coverage and technology assessment outcomes.
  • Publication and scientific dissemination targets achieved.
  • Pipeline assets supported with market access evidence strategies.
  • Employee engagement, retention and talent development goals achieved.
  • Contribution to revenue growth through payer adoption and coverage expansion.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, ScD, MPH, MS or equivalent).
  • 7+ years of leading payer launch planning, health economics and research teams.
  • 12+ years of progressive HEOR, outcomes research or evidence generation experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with RWE, cost-effectiveness and comparative effectiveness studies.
  • Strong publication record and payer evidence submission experience.
  • Proven people leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% domestically.
    •

Preferred:

  • Experience in precision medicine, genomics, oncology, women's health and rare disease diagnostics.
  • Experience with WGS, WES and technology assessments.
  • Existing academic, payer and KOL relationships.
  • Success in supporting guideline development in collaboration with Medical Affairs, Clinical Affairs and KOL Strategic Teams.
    •

COMPETENCIES

✓ Strategic Leadership ✓ Executive Presence

✓ Talent Development ✓ Organizational Development

✓ Cross-Functional Influence ✓ Data-Driven Decision Making

✓ Accountability & Execution Excellence

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

·Location: Remote

  • Physical demands for the job (e.g., Must be able to lift 25 lbs, standing for prolonged periods of time, etc.)
  • Work environment required for the job duties (e.g., Exposure to laboratory chemicals, etc.)

·Travel Requirements

  • Special conditions (e.g. lab/clinical requirements if applicable)

·Up to 40% Domestic Travel

Baylor Genetics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, childbirth, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Be inspired. Be valued. Belong. At Emory Healthcare

At Emory Healthcare we fuel your professional journey with better benefits, valuable resources, ongoing mentorship and leadership programs for all types of jobs, and a supportive environment that enables you to reach new heights in your career and be what you want to be. We provide:

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance & Reimbursement Programs
  • Family-focused benefits
  • Wellness incentives
  • Ongoing mentorship, development, leadership programs
  • And more

LOCATION:

Remote

This position is remote; however, applicants must be physically located and authorized to work in one of the following states: Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Michigan, New Hamsphire, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylavnia, South Caroline, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

Description

JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Reviews inpatient medical records for select payer populations post-discharge and pre-bill; audits the accuracy and completeness of diagnosis and procedure coding, DRG assignment, and abstracted data POA, Discharge Disposition.
  • Reviews discrepancies between the Clinical Documentation Specialist (CDS) DRG and the Coder DRG. Reviews non-CC/MCC records to determine if record was miscoded or if additional documentation is needed.
  • Works with Coders and CDSs to draft and initiate physician queries. Performs reviews in a timely manner to maintain DNFB target of 4 days.
  • Provides Coding development with coordination of educational and training programs regarding technical coding and clinical topics for the coding staff. Coordinates remediation when required. Coordinates with the Coding leadership, Quality nurses and the CDS team to educate physicians, nursing, and other clinical staff to improve documentation. Review's DRG Reassignment letters and assists in formulating Appeal letters

Minimum Required Qualifications:

  • Education: High school diploma Experience: Minimum five (5) years experience with coding ICD-10 in an acute care setting. Previous experience in performing DRG coding audits.
  • Certification: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) certification. Skills: 1. Possesses knowledge of DRG and grouping methodologies (MS DRG's and AP DRG's); in particular what diagnoses / procedures impact DRG assignment. 2. Basic computer skills in word processing and spreadsheet utilization. 3. Excellent interpersonal skills to develop relationships necessary to facilitate and educate. 4. Excellent prioritization and organizational skills. Preferred Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's degree in related field Certification: RHIA/RHIT.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

(Medium): 20-50 lbs; 0-33% of the work day (occasionally); 11-25 lbs, 34-66% of the workday (frequently); 01-10 lbs, 67-100% of the workday (constantly); Lifting 50 lbs max; Carrying of objects up to 25 lbs; Occasional to frequent standing & walking, Occasional sitting, Close eye work (computers, typing, reading, writing), Physical demands may vary depending on assigned work area and work tasks. ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:

Factors affecting environment conditions may vary depending on the assigned work area and tasks. Environmental exposures include, but are not limited to: Blood-borne pathogen exposure Bio-hazardous waste Chemicals/gases/fumes/vapors Communicable diseases Electrical shock , Floor Surfaces, Hot/Cold Temperatures, Indoor/Outdoor conditions, Latex, Lighting, Patient care/handling injuries, Radiation, Shift work, Travel may be required. Use of personal protective equipment, including respirators, environmental conditions may vary depending on assigned work area and work tasks.

Additional Details

Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

Emory Healthcare is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. Please contact Emory Healthcare’s Human Resources at . Please note that one week's advance notice is preferred.

raw.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Account Director to join our team full-time in the US.
raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Account Director to join our team full-time in the US.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Account Director, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. We are a custom product engineering and digital transformation company supporting both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts, and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

Ciklum is experiencing rapid growth, with the United States representing our primary strategic growth market. We are inviting experienced leadership professionals to drive high-impact digital transformations alongside premier West Coast technology companies, global retail brands, and innovative consumer financial platforms.

As an Account Director, you will serve as a key commercial leader and B2C Subject Matter Expert across our US West Coast region. In this high-visibility role, you will be responsible for scaling established enterprise B2C accounts across the West Coast tech and consumer landscape, while actively driving commercial development and expansion into key regional and global brands spanning Retail, Consumer Financial Services, and Consumer Tech.

Combining deep domain expertise in consumer digital experiences with strategic account management, you will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, guiding complex digital transformation initiatives, omnichannel commerce modernizations, and customer-facing digital products. You will champion AI-driven customer transformations, modern product delivery, and digital execution techniques to maximize customer engagement, retention, and account growth. You will partner closely with global delivery management, technical practice leads, and executive leadership to drive substantial business impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Leadership & Growth: Own and execute comprehensive portfolio plans for our strategic West Coast B2C accounts across Retail, Consumer Finance, and Tech. Formulate long-term account strategies rooted in a deep understanding of consumer behavior, omnichannel engagement, platform scalability, and client business goals
  • AI Transformation & B2C Innovation: Guide clients on leveraging Enterprise AI, Generative AI, and predictive analytics to power personalized customer journeys, modern commerce engines, automated support frameworks, and intelligent consumer applications
  • Commercial & Pipeline Development: Actively identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities within existing strategic B2C accounts while supporting new-logo acquisition across the West Coast market. Lead end-to-end sales and expansion efforts from initial opportunity shaping through contract execution
  • Domain SME & C-Suite Engagement: Function as a Subject Matter Expert in consumer engagement and B2C digital ecosystems. Engage with C-Level Executives (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Heads of Product/Engineering) to articulate Ciklum’s value proposition in modernizing digital touchpoints, mobile applications, and core platform capabilities
  • P&L & Portfolio Accountability: Take ownership of account-level P&L across your portfolio, including revenue growth, margin optimization, forecasting accuracy, statement of work (SOW) structuring, and commercial governance
  • Modern Digital Delivery Governance: Advocate for agile product development, DevOps/DevSecOps practices, cloud-native architectures, and AI-assisted engineering tools to deliver high-velocity product iterations and high reliability for mission-critical consumer applications
  • Matrix Leadership & Escalation: Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams (onshore, nearshore, and offshore) to ensure flawless program delivery, contract adherence, proactive risk management, and market-leading Net Promoter Scores (NPS)
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global practice leads (Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, Product Design, Experience Engineering) to design and package custom solutions engineered for high-scale B2C environments
  • Partnership Growth Focus: Takes ownership of some domain focused partnerships with regional partners to accelerate growth

Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum of 10+ years in technology consulting, IT services, digital transformation, or custom software engineering, with at least 8+ years dedicated specifically to account management, client relationship leadership, and commercial growth
  • B2C & Multi-Vertical SME: Demonstrated background managing enterprise accounts within Retail, Consumer Financial Services (e.g., neobanks, consumer payments, wealthtech), and Consumer Tech platforms. Practical consulting experience in high-volume, customer-facing digital ecosystems is required
  • West Coast Market Presence: Proven track record of navigating, growing, and managing enterprise accounts across the US West Coast technology and corporate landscape
  • Experience operating within fast-paced, matrixed environments utilizing global delivery models (onshore/nearshore/offshore)
    AI & Digital Product Fluency: Strong understanding of how AI/ML, personalization engines, data pipelines, and cloud platform modernizations are applied to solve modern consumer engagement and operational challenges
  • Digital Delivery & Tooling Acumen: Hands-on familiarity with modern software development methodologies (Agile at scale, CI/CD, modern microservices frameworks) and delivery tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, AI engineering tools) to engage credibly with engineering and product leaders
  • Enterprise Sales & Account Expansion: Proven history of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million-dollar booking quotas, revenue targets, and portfolio profitability metrics in consumer tech/digital service accounts
  • Executive Presence & Pitching: Exceptional capability to build trust with C-Level executives, framing technical capabilities into clear, quantifiable business outcomes (CAC reduction, LTV growth, platform throughput, conversion rate optimization)
  • Commercial & Contractual Acumen: Expert capability in deal structuring, MSA/SOW negotiations, team ramp models, and outcome-focused pricing structures

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: Healthcare, Basic Life Insurance, Short and Long-term disability insurance according to the Company’s Benefit Plans

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. In the US, Ciklum is growing fast—inviting experienced professionals to lead digital transformation alongside Fortune 500 clients. Be part of a company where innovation and impact go hand in hand.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

raw.title: Senior Network Engineer
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryMAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments.
raw.description:
Position Summary

MAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments. You'll design robust network solutions that ensure seamless connectivity, security, and performance while supporting digital transformation initiatives and multi-tenant secure environments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop network monitoring, automation, and performance optimization strategies
  • Configure and manage Microsoft Azure networking services (VNets, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Network Security Groups)
  • Evaluate, re-evaluate, understand, and support existing/legacy network requirements, including documenting and extending/revisiting implementations
  • Design and implement enterprise network architectures for hybrid cloud environments
  • Work with other IT cross-functional teams for collaboration where networkoperations could be impacted
  • Deploy and maintain Fortinet security appliances (FortiGate firewalls, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager)
  • Configure and optimize Cisco enterprise networking equipment (switches, routers, wireless controllers)
  • Implement network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies for secure multi-tenant environments
  • Design and deploy software-defined WAN (SD-WAN) solutions
  • Configure quality of service (QoS) for business-critical applications

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Support cybersecurity compliance requirements
  • Implement zero-trust network security architectures
  • Design and configure network access control (NAC) solutions
  • Perform network security assessments and vulnerability remediation
  • Implement advanced threat protection and intrusion prevention systems
  • Support compliance requirements (SOX, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2)
  • Manage network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives
  • Provide escalation support for complex network issues
  • Implement network security controls (encryption, authentication, segmentation)
  • Design and configure firewall rules and intrusion detection
  • Perform network vulnerability assessments
  • Implement zero-trust network architectures

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering
  • Advanced Knowledge of routing, switching, and network protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, QoS, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure networking (Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Microsoft Entra ID)
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls and security appliances (Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto,etc.)
  • Experience with FortiGate SD-WAN implementation
  • Experience with Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE)
  • Experience troubleshooting network security protocols (IPSec, SSL/TLS, 802.1X)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Cisco enterprise equipment (Catalyst switches, ISR/ASR routers, Wireless LAN Controllers)
  • Experience with network automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, Python scripting)
  • Understanding of container networking (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience with SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela, Silver Peak, VeloCloud)
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (FortiManager, PRTG, Nagios)
  • Experience with secure remote access solutions (VPN, ZTNA)
  • CCNA/CCNP, Azure certifications, or Fortinet NSE certifications

Clearance:

  • Must be eligible for Secret Security Clearance
  • US Citizenship required

Special Note

The position is contingent upon candidate’s ability to meet physical and medical requirements as needed by the position; including compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictional requirements.

Benefits and Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $97500 to $162500 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.

raw.description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

  • Conduzir a estratégia, sustentação e evolução contínua dos produtos digitais da frente de Atração Corporativa e Estratégica com postura de PM Builder, unindo a governança do sistema central de recrutamento à capacidade de prototipar automações ágeis e aplicar Inteligência Artificial para acelerar e qualificar o funil de contratação;
  • Governança & Evolução do ATS Corporativo: Liderar o ciclo de vida e a parametrização da plataforma central de recrutamento e seleção (ATS), desenhando réguas de triagem, fluxos admissionais e integração funcional com ferramentas de testes preditivos e comportamentais;
  • Prototipação Rápida & Ferramentas Low-Code (Perfil Builder): Desenvolver e sustentar soluções ágeis, fluxos automatizados e pequenos produtos utilizando ferramentas no/low-code (soluções baseadas em AppSheet, automações em scripts de produtividade, planilhas inteligentes e integrações via webhook), garantindo validações rápidas de hipóteses sem dependência exclusiva de esteiras pesadas de engenharia;
  • Aceleração com Inteligência Artificial em R&S: Mapear e implementar casos práticos de uso de IA (gerativa e preditiva) no funil de seleção, explorando triagens inteligentes de perfis, geração de descrições de vagas, match de aderência e automação de contatos com candidatos;
  • Métricas, Eficiência e People Analytics: Analisar dados de ponta a ponta do funil de atração (Time-to-Fill, SLAs, taxas de conversão, custos e diversidade), direcionando ações corretivas e priorização de backlog com base em evidências;
  • Articulação com Stakeholders: Atuar como parceiro de confiança das lideranças de Talent Acquisition, Business Partners e times de Dados/Engenharia para alinhar processos operacionais e roadmap tecnológico.
  • Experiência comprovada em Gestão de Produtos Digitais (Product Management), com perfil pragmático e executor (PM Builder), demonstrando capacidade de tirar ideias do papel e construir MVPs com autonomia;
  • Experiência prática na criação de soluções e automações utilizando ecossistemas no/low-code e linguagens de script para automação de processos internos e produtividade;
  • Experiência na aplicação prática de Inteligência Artificial (ferramentas de IA generativa, prompts estruturados, automações com IA ou agentes) voltada à eficiência operacional e produtividade em produto;
  • Conhecimento prático em plataformas e metodologias de People Science (testes preditivos, fit cultural e assessments comportamentais/cognitivos); Forte capacidade analítica e de diagnóstico por meio de métricas de funil, correlacionando dados com tomada de decisão de produto;
  • Excelente habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal, comunicação e construção de alianças, com capacidade de transitar entre diferentes áreas de negócio, construir relações de confiança mútua e realizar a gestão ativa de stakeholders em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos para o alinhamento de prioridades e geração de consensos.
Desejáveis:
  • Conhecimento prático sobre consumo e estruturação de APIs/webhooks para conectar o ATS com ferramentas periféricas e automações internas; Noções de governança e conformidade em processos seletivos (LGPD, cibersegurança e tratamento de dados confidenciais de candidatos);
  • Domínio funcional em plataformas corporativas de Recrutamento & Seleção (sistemas ATS corporativos de grande porte voltados a altos volumes e processos complexos).

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Saúde:

  • Plano médico e odontológico flexíveis
  • Auxílio medicamentos e vale saúde para familiares
  • Sessões de psicoterapia gratuitas e telemedicina 24h
  • Programas contínuos de prevenção, cuidado mental e vacinação

Alimentação & bem-estar

  • Vale Refeição (ou restaurante local) e Vale Alimentação (com vale extra no Natal)
  • Desconto de até 40% nas marcas do nosso ecossistema
  • Gympass/TotalPass para academias e estúdios esportivos
  • Auxílio Home Office para modalidades híbrida e remota
  • Day off de aniversário para celebrar do seu jeito
  • Plano de saúde pet, vantagens em convênios e programas de viagem/hospedagem

Para sua família

  • Licença parental estendida (180 dias para mães e 120 dias para pais)
  • Suporte para Pais Atípicos e auxílio babá / educação infantil
  • Auxílio material escolar e crédito nutrição infantil
  • Orientação jurídica, psicológica e social dedicada

The Consultant will confirmacceptance and feasibility of the deadline within [one (1)] working day.Products vary in size and complexity; the scope, effort and fee for each areagreed before work starts, using the unit rates in the Consultant’s financialproposal.

The Consultant will be responsible for the followingtasks:

  • Copy-editing and language editing: correct grammar, syntax, spelling andpunctuation; improve flow, concision and plain-language readability;standardise terminology, acronyms, headings, tables, figure captions andcross-references; apply the Project style guide and referencing conventions.

raw.description:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Isso não poderia ser diferente com o nosso principal combustível: as pessoas!

Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.

Buscamos profissionais inovadores que sejam movidos por desafios e focados em resultados.

Se você busca uma empresa dinâmica e parceira e que investe em seus colaboradores através de capacitação constante, a Leega é o lugar para você!

>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

  • Construir e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados em batch e streaming com BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub e Cloud Storage.
  • Modelar e organizar o Data Lake/Lakehouse em BigQuery e BigLake, com camadas, particionamento e otimização de custo e performance.
  • Definir contratos de dados (schemas, freshness e SLAs) e monitorar a qualidade e a linhagem das fontes.
  • Preparar dados para IA: limpeza, anonimização, chunking e geração de embeddings para Vertex AI RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search e vector stores.
  • Garantir conformidade com a LGPD no tratamento de dados sensíveis de saúde, aplicando mascaramento, anonimização (Sensitive Data Protection), policy tags e residência de dados antes que esses dados cheguem aos ambientes de IA.
  • Desenhar acesso a dados entre projetos (Cloud IAM, Dataplex, BigLake, Analytics Hub) evitando cópias, com menor privilégio e trilha de auditoria.
  • Disponibilizar dados e sistemas internos como ferramentas para agentes via servidores MCP e MCP Toolbox, apoiando o time de IA na integração com Vertex AI Agent Engine e Agent Development Kit (ADK).
  • Manter pipelines de MLOps/LLMOps com Vertex AI Pipelines, incluindo avaliação, guardrails (Model Armor) e monitoramento de drift e qualidade das respostas.
  • Provisionar a infraestrutura de dados e IA como código com Terraform e CI/CD, e acompanhar custos por área, projeto e modelo (FinOps) com billing export para BigQuery e labels.
  • Implementar observabilidade ponta a ponta (OpenTelemetry, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace) e apoiar estratégias de resiliência e disaster recovery.

    Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Domínio de Python e SQL.
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados no GCP: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow ou Dataproc e Pub/Sub.
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (Cloud Composer/Airflow, Cloud Workflows ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados no GCP: Cloud IAM, Dataplex, policy tags e Cloud KMS.
  • Terraform e CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou similares).
  • Experiência prática em ambientes GCP com múltiplos projetos, organização e folders.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (filas, retries, idempotência e consistência).
  • Experiência preparando dados para ao menos uma aplicação com LLM em produção (RAG ou agentes com uso de ferramentas).
  • Conhecimento de LGPD aplicada a dados sensíveis, incluindo técnicas de anonimização e mascaramento.

    Diferenciais

  • Vertex AI (RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search, Agent Engine, Pipelines), Gemini e Model Armor.
  • Frameworks de agentes (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) e desenvolvimento de servidores MCP.
  • Vector stores (Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB com pgvector, BigQuery Vector Search); GraphRAG é um plus.
  • Experiência no setor de saúde ou com padrões de dados clínicos (HL7, FHIR, Cloud Healthcare API).
  • Data Mesh, arquitetura hub-and-spoke e FinOps no GCP.
  • Certificação Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Professional Machine Learning Engineer ou FinOps Certified Practitioner.

    • Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara com cientistas de dados, times de IA, áreas de negócio e parceiros externos.
  • Disciplina de segurança e ética no tratamento de dados sensíveis de pacientes, especialmente quando consumidos por agentes autônomos.
  • Capacidade de explicitar trade-offs técnicos (cópia de dados vs. acesso entre projetos, batch vs. streaming, custo vs. latência).
  • Hábito de documentar e atribuir ownership de pipelines, fontes de dados e ferramentas entre os times.

C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

Travel Insured International, a Crum & Forster company, is hiring a Customer Service Representative.

Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident & Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Travel Insured International is proud to offer products to consumers and to agency partners of all sizes. We're committed to providing dependable coverage, great value, and customer satisfaction.

Because protecting travelers' journeys isn’t just our business—it’s our promise. Our promise to protect every traveler, every experience, every time. Travel Insured International travel protection meets our travelers in the moments that matter. We are here. Go be there.

Travel Insured International is hiring our next class of Customer Service Representatives to join our growing organization! Join us!

Our Customer Service Representatives deliver exceptional service to our callers, which include travelers and our extensive travel advisor community.

Interested in this role, but don’t have Customer Service experience? Our Customer Service Representatives are provided with training and tools to begin your career! Our structured training program includes licensing training, classroom training on everything Customer Care at TII, and a collaborative mentor stage that allows for practical application of your new knowledge.

We are proud that some of our best Customer Service Representatives have gone on to other parts of our organization, including, Claims, Product and our Quality Management teams, to name a few!

We are pleased to offer 100% remote working schedules within the US. The Customer Service department is open from 7:45AM – 7:15PM EST. Shift times include 7:45am -4:15pm, 9:00am-5:30pm, and 10:45am-7:15pm. Scheduled shifts are determined by business need and may be subject to change.

Job Description

What you will do:

  • Answer inbound calls
  • Provide accurate, clear and timely responses to a variety of traveler and travel advisor calls that will include, but not be limited to travel insurance coverage questions, website troubleshooting, purchase inquires and agent support requests
  • Create cases in Salesforce to address customer needs (such as documentation or policy changes)

  • Serve as backup for other Customer Care functions including Customer Care/Group call taking, supporting Customer Care Chats, Group desk administrative functions as well as Diamond Tour manifest processing

What YOU will bring to C&F:

  • Customer-Centric: skilled at prioritizing their needs and experiences, understanding what they want and delivering exceptional service.
  • Sales Focused: Ability to effectively communicate the value of TII’s offerings and tailored solutions to travelers insurance needs.
  • Effective Listening: Including active listening and empathy
  • Effective Communication Skills: Both written communication skills, targeting information, comments and explanations in a manner appropriate to the needs of the audience and verbally by phone/
  • Ability to resolve service issues and complaints, leveraging problem-solving and service skills to achieve an appropriate outcome promptly and effectively with a great deal of independence.

Requirements:

  • A High School Diploma or GED is required
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer service or retail role is required; call center experience preferred
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications is required. Includes MS Word, Outlook and Teams.
  • A Personal Lines or Property & Casualty License is required for this role. Classroom training is provided.
  • Experience in the Travel Insurance industry is preferred.
  • Dependable internet connection with a dedicated private workspace.

What C&F will bring to you

What C&F will bring to YOU:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenant is owning your career development so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you require a special accommodation, please let us know.

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.

In this role, you will build and run the infrastructure and tooling behind the platform's products - from AWS and Kubernetes environments, through CI/CD pipelines, to the observability stack - for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who manages infrastructure through code and automation, owns the reliability of what they deploy, and works closely with developers to get code to production.

Technology stack:

  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, EKS)

  • Containerization & orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Docker Compose

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Helm

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry

  • Programming & scripting: Python, Go, shell scripting

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (RDS), event streaming and CDC, RabbitMQ, MQTT

  • Security & compliance: IAM, SOC 2 controls, OAuth2

  • APIs: REST, gRPC

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of reliability, security and automation

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone whose working hours can overlap with the US East Coast

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow - Claude Code is used heavily across the team

  • This is an infrastructure-focused role, working closely with the product teams to connect code to production

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and maintaining infrastructure for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform

  • Operating and optimizing AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS) for cost, security and performance

  • Managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm

  • Building and improving CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and internal platform tooling that lets developers serve themselves

  • Improving monitoring, alerting and incident response, and defining SLOs (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki)

  • Helping enforce security and compliance standards, including SOC 2 controls

  • Working closely with the product teams to get code to production reliably

  • Contributing to documentation and onboarding, and taking part in the on-call rotation

  • Using Claude Code day to day: setting constraints, reviewing the output and staying accountable for correctness and security

Do we have a match?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with AWS, especially EKS and Kubernetes

  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Helm

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir or Loki, and with OpenTelemetry

  • Proficiency in Python, Go or shell scripting

  • Experience with CDC and event streaming, or with scaling large multi-tenant observability systems

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Strong communication and documentation skills

  • Availability for an on-call rotation and working hours overlapping with the US East Coast

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security-focused environments

  • Experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT or AMQP (e.g. RabbitMQ)

  • Familiarity with network source-of-truth or network automation tooling

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup (ideally 2+ years)

O Product Manager no Asaas desempenha um papel fundamental ao alinhar as necessidades dos clientes com os objetivos estratégicos do negócio e do mercado. Sua principal missão será liderar a squad responsável por soluções de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao nosso time de Produto, em especial aos produtos core do Asaas, com foco em automação, personalização e eficiência operacional.

Essa posição oferece um alto nível de impacto e inovação, pois você estará à frente da exploração e aplicação de IA generativa e preditiva para melhorar a experiência do cliente, aumentar a escalabilidade das operações e desenvolver novos recursos de valor agregado na nossa plataforma.

Você trabalhará de forma cross e em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, Engenharia, Dados, Design e Riscos, em um ambiente orientado à experimentação e entrega contínua.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Identificar e gerir oportunidades para uso de IA Generativa que tragam valor real aos nossos clientes e ao negócio, como automações, insights, personalização de jornada ou aumento de eficiência;
  • Liderar iniciativas de alto impacto na experiência final do cliente;
  • Evoluir, junto com time de Engenharia e Data&AI, a plataforma de IA Generativa para que produtos financeiros core possam evoluir seus casos de uso;
  • Realizar o Enablement (Awareness & Education) de PMs pares e squad cross jornada para a evolução de casos de uso dos produtos core da plataforma;
  • Definir e evoluir a visão de produto em IA Generativa nos produtos financeiros core da plataforma, em sinergia com outras squads e áreas da empresa;
  • Trabalhar com dados e métricas para tomar decisões, validar hipóteses e medir o impacto de soluções baseadas em IA;
  • Garantir que soluções baseadas em IA sigam os princípios de ética, segurança, transparência e conformidade regulatória;
  • Comunicar de forma clara os objetivos, aprendizados e resultados das iniciativas para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Ser guiado pelo desenvolvimento constante, saindo da zona de conforto;
  • Retirar obstáculos e entregar grandes projetos em pequenas partes coerentes e de alto valor;
  • Ser capaz de identificar oportunidades para impulsionar o engajamento e conversão por meio de melhorias estratégicas nas jornadas do produto;
  • Assegurar que todas as áreas da empresa sejam consultadas ou informadas quando necessário, sobre alterações no produto e também atuar em conjunto com a equipe de marketing na comunicação com o cliente, gerando engajamento.
  • Experiência prévia como Product Manager em produtos digitais (preferencialmente em fintechs ou produtos financeiros);
  • Ter atuado ativamente em produtos em estágios iniciais, “movendo do 0 para 1”;
  • Vivência com produtos, soluções envolvendo Inteligência Artificial, especialmente voltadas à automação, risco, atendimento ou personalização;
  • Vivência com fundamentos de machine learning, IA generativa, LLMs ou modelos preditivos aplicados ao contexto de negócio, permitindo diálogo aprofundado com times de engenharia;
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e métricas fundamentais de produto;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações de maneira clara e concisa para diferentes públicos;
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de antecipação de necessidades, gestão de expectativas e governança de ações cross.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em SQL;
  • Certificações ou cursos voltados para IA, Product Management ou Data Science (como Tera, PM3, etc);
  • Experiência com produtos regulados pelo Banco Central;
  • Vivência anterior em fintechs ou empresas SaaS voltadas para serviços financeiros;
  • Experiência com ferramentas e plataformas de IA generativa (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, etc).

Informações adicionais

Modelo de Trabalho:

For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success.

SIS provides comprehensive technology and services for ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), including practice management software, electronic health records (EHRs), patient engagement solutions, compliance technology, and revenue cycle management services. SIS also supports hospital perioperative teams with specialized software solutions.

Trusted by more than 2,900 surgical facilities, SIS is committed to helping healthcare organizations improve efficiency, optimize financial performance, and focus on delivering exceptional patient care.

At SIS, we believe our people drive our success. We foster a culture built on respect, integrity, accountability, client focus, bias for action, and continuous improvement. As a nationally recognized Top Workplace, we strive to provide an environment where employees can contribute, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for generating new business opportunities through targeted outbound sales campaigns and proactive prospect engagement. This role focuses on identifying prospective customers, connecting with key decision-makers, qualifying leads, and developing a consistent pipeline of sales opportunities for SIS software and revenue cycle services.

The BDR will collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to execute outreach strategies, engage prospective customers, and schedule qualified sales meetings. Success requires strong communication skills, persistence, organization, and the ability to effectively communicate the value of SIS solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Execute targeted outbound campaigns through cold calling, email, and other direct outreach methods to generate new business opportunities.
  • Research and identify prospective customers, key decision-makers, and target accounts within the ambulatory surgery center market.
  • Develop personalized messaging that communicates the value of SIS software and revenue cycle services.
  • Conduct consistent follow-up with prospects to build relationships, generate interest, and advance sales conversations.
  • Identify potential customer needs and opportunities aligned with SIS solutions.

Sales Pipeline Development

  • Qualify prospective customers based on business needs, decision-making authority, timing, and potential fit.
  • Schedule qualified discovery meetings for Account Executives and sales leadership.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team to ensure effective handoffs and continued engagement with qualified prospects.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information, activity records, lead status, and pipeline information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Consistently work toward established outbound activity, qualified meeting, and pipeline generation goals.

Campaign Execution & Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to execute outbound campaigns targeting priority customer segments and accounts.
  • Track campaign results and identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates.
  • Develop knowledge of SIS products, services, competitive positioning, and the challenges facing healthcare providers.
  • Share market insights and prospect feedback to support improvements in sales messaging and campaign effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 18 months of experience in B2B software sales, revenue cycle management, sales development, or business development.
  • Experience conducting outbound prospecting, including cold calling, email outreach, and lead generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage prospective customers, qualify leads, and generate sales opportunities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with business decision-makers.
  • Experience using Salesforce to manage leads, document sales activities, and track opportunities.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple outbound campaigns and prospect follow-ups.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and achieve established performance objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling SaaS solutions, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management software, or related services.
  • Familiarity with ambulatory surgery centers, healthcare operations, or revenue cycle processes such as billing, collections, and denials management.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Account Executives to generate and advance qualified sales opportunities.
  • Understanding of account-based prospecting and outbound campaign strategies.

BENEFITS:

  • Benefit package including Medical, Vision, Dental, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Vacation/Sick time
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid Holidays
  • SIS Cares Day
  • Hybrid or Remote environment depending on the role

We believe employees are our greatest asset and we empower them to make a difference in our business. Diversity and inclusion makes us all better. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, protected veteran status, and all other protected statuses

raw.description:
Position Summary:

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. This includes assembling, preparing, reviewing, and verifying loan closing documents while ensuring compliance with all applicable state, federal, and regulatory requirements. This role manages an active pipeline of transactions to ensure files are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with established service level agreements while delivering high-quality support to clients, lenders, and settlement partners.

Essential Functions:

  • Assemble, prepare, review, and verify all documents required for loan closings, including contracts, settlement statements, closing disclosures, mortgages, deeds, and title policies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare preliminary and final settlement statements, including Closing Disclosures (CD) and ALTA statements, and manage revisions and approvals as needed.
  • Review and revise closing documents to meet lender requirements, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, investor, and company guidelines prior to transmitting finalized packages to settlement agents.
  • Coordinate the closing process, including scheduling and execution of document signings, while ensuring all required documentation is complete prior to closing.
  • Perform final pre-closing reviews of title fees, taxes, premiums, endorsements, vesting, and all checklist items to ensure readiness for closing.
  • Serve as a liaison between lenders, title companies, borrowers, and settlement agents, maintaining clear and timely communication to ensure expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including disbursement and post-closing, to ensure a seamless transition from closing through funding and recording.
  • Support post-closing activities, including revisions to CDs or ALTA statements and overall file completion.
  • Manage an active pipeline of files, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and established service level agreements.
  • Provide operational support across all workflow stages, including back-office functions, and assist with coverage needs such as on-call, alternate shifts, and weekend support as required.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines.
  • Capable of generating a high degree of respect and trust to develop, maintain strong relationships with business partners across all levels of stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely present issues, ideas and recommendations in verbal, written and presentation formats.
  • Highly motivated, inquisitive, self-started with the ability to multi-task and effectively manage priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

Education, Formal Training, and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required, Baccalaureate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years’ experience with title or closing company preferred.
  • Strong customer service skills required.
  • National title closing experience preferable.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, is frequently required to sit, is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to type & reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Reasonable accommodations maybe made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

  • Employer paid disability and life insurance
  • Flexible spending accounts
