raw.description:
VIP Corporate Travel Consultant (Morning Shift)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

Our VIP Corporate Travel Consultants will need to provide a high level of consultation and accuracy during all aspects of the travel experience, including pre-booking consultation, and the reservation process from beginning to end. Candidate must have in-depth travel industry knowledge, exceptional problem-solving skills, while maintaining the highest degree of professionalism and courtesy.

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks training (paid). This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs.

The schedule for this role will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM ET, Monday – Friday.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional, personalized service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff, establishing strong rapport and ensuring all interactions are handled with professionalism.
  • Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, creating unique travel itineraries that meet the specific needs and expectations of high-level executives.
  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned

Job Title: Director of Engineering, Internal Platforms

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We’re looking for a highly technical, hands-on Director of Engineering to lead the architecture, development, and scalability of the internal platforms powering our operations, data workflows, and business ecosystem.

You’ll own the engineering direction of mission-critical systems while overseeing quality engineering, ensuring our platforms are reliable, scalable, and built for automation.

This role requires a strong technical leader who stays close to the code, drives architectural decisions, and leverages AI-powered tools and modern engineering practices to accelerate development. You’ll lead engineering teams, establish technical standards, and deliver systems that simplify complex operations at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Lead Internal Platform Engineering: Own the architecture, development, and scalability of platforms supporting operational workflows, expert lifecycle management, data collection, analytics, and business processes.
  2. Build Intelligent Systems: Integrate LLMs, AI agents, and automation into internal platforms to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency.
  3. Drive Platform Architecture: Design scalable APIs, distributed services, event-driven systems, and integrations connecting onboarding, assessments, subscriptions, data pipelines, and financial workflows.
  4. Own Quality Engineering: Lead QE strategy, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD quality gates, release validation, and production reliability across platforms.
  5. Advance Testing Automation: Implement AI-assisted testing, automated regression coverage, and evaluation frameworks for traditional and AI-powered applications.
  6. Stay Hands-On: Drive technical design, contribute to implementation, review code, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex engineering challenges.
  7. Improve Engineering Productivity: Introduce AI-assisted development workflows, developer tooling, and automation to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering quality.
  8. Lead Engineering Teams: Mentor engineers, establish technical standards, drive execution, and foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and accountability.
  9. Partner Cross-Functionally: Work with Product, AI/ML, Data, and Operations to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

What We’re Looking For

  1. 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering leadership roles.
  2. Strong hands-on development expertise in Python, TypeScript, or similar languages, with recent experience building and debugging production systems.
  3. Deep experience in platform architecture, including distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration.
  4. Practical experience with AI-powered systems, including LLM integrations, agentic workflows, RAG, and evaluation frameworks.
  5. Experience leveraging AI development tools and automation to improve engineering productivity and delivery.
  6. Strong Quality Engineering expertise, including automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, API and end-to-end testing, and production reliability.
  7. Cloud infrastructure proficiency with AWS, GCP, or Azure, Kubernetes, databases, observability, and DevOps practices.
  8. Experience building internal platforms supporting operational workflows, data pipelines, analytics, or complex business processes.
  9. Proven technical leadership, with the ability to mentor engineers, make architectural decisions, and deliver in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience in AI research labs, AI-native companies, or high-growth technology startups.
  2. Experience with human data platforms, including expert management, data annotation, human-in-the-loop workflows, data curation, and AI evaluation pipelines.
  3. Familiarity with LLM training and evaluation workflows, including human feedback, preference data, and model benchmarking.
  4. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Temporal, or similar technologies.
  5. Experience building internal developer platforms, shared infrastructure, or self-service engineering tools.
  6. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing, automated test generation, and evaluation of nondeterministic systems.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $280,000 –$350,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

This company is one of the world's leading providers of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure, enterprise digital solutions, cloud computing platforms, and smart devices. Established in the late 1980s and headquartered in China, the organization operates across more than 170 countries and is globally recognized for its leadership in telecommunications technology, 5G innovation, artificial intelligence, and enterprise digital transformation.

The company maintains a strong international reputation through continuous investment in advanced technologies including cloud computing, networking infrastructure, enterprise storage, optical transmission, cybersecurity, and intelligent collaboration platforms. Its large-scale R&D ecosystem and commitment to technological innovation position the organization as a strategic technology partner for governments, telecommunications operators, financial institutions, and enterprise clients worldwide.

In Indonesia, the organization plays a major role in supporting national digital transformation initiatives across sectors such as government, banking, telecommunications, logistics, manufacturing, and smart city development through strategic ICT infrastructure projects and enterprise technology solutions.

Job Role:

To strengthen its enterprise business expansion within Indonesia's Financial Services Industry (FSI) sector, the company is enhancing its strategic account management capabilities across key banking and financial institution accounts. The organization promotes a highly target-driven, competitive, and commercially focused culture centered on strategic customer engagement, enterprise solution selling, and long-term business growth.

The Account Manager – FSI is responsible for managing overall business performance, revenue growth, and market penetration across assigned financial institution accounts, including leading private banks and state-owned banks in Indonesia. This role carries full accountability for account strategy development, customer relationship management, project execution, channel collaboration, and achievement of commercial targets across the enterprise ICT portfolio.

  • Drive end-to-end enterprise sales execution, including opportunity identification, solution positioning, bidding, negotiation, and contract closure.

  • Conduct ongoing sales activities including account farming, pipeline management, customer engagement, product presentations, and business forecasting.

  • Strong commercial mindset with high resilience, competitiveness, and willingness to operate within highly demanding target-driven environments.

Salesforce Solutions Consultant

Solutions | United States (Remote) | Full-Time | NAM

Who We Are

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

You'll be the person prospects watch when they want to see Salesforce solve their problem in a live org. In this presales seat you design, build and deliver tailored demonstrations across the Salesforce Core platform, turning what you learn in discovery into a working story inside a live org. A typical week mixes discovery calls, demo builds, RFP responses and deal strategy sessions with our Account Executives. You'll field the hard product, architecture and integration questions in the room, then work with our delivery team so what gets sold is scoped to land. It's a hands-on role for someone who would rather configure the product than talk about it, with occasional travel for customer meetings, demos and team events.

What you'll do

  • Build tailored demos end to end, mapped to each prospect's own requirements and use cases.

  • Own the demo orgs, keeping environments, sample data and reusable scenarios current and presentation-ready.

  • Lead discovery sessions that surface business pain, technical requirements and success criteria, then shape the solution story.

  • Partner with Account Executives on solution strategy, value positioning and technical objections through the sales cycle.

  • Answer RFPs and RFIs and technical questionnaires, and support proof-of-concept and pilot engagements.

  • Keep proposals realistic with delivery and product teams, so every solution is scoped accurately and set up to implement well.

  • Bring new releases into your demos as the Salesforce roadmap moves, especially Agentforce and Data Cloud.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on Salesforce depth: 5 to 7 years configuring, building and demonstrating on the platform.

  • Presales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Presales Consultant, or in a demo-focused role.

  • Multi-cloud range to demo Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud (Data 360), Experience Cloud and Agentforce with confidence.

  • Consultative discovery skills that connect a business problem to the right platform capability.

  • Presence in the room to tell a clear story, run a live demo and handle technical questions on the spot.

  • Self-directed remote working, comfortable running your own week across a fully distributed team.

  • Bonus points for Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Sales, Service or Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist) or partner and SI experience.

Why this role, why now

Salesforce clients want to see Agentforce and Data Cloud working against their own use cases before they commit. As a Salesforce Summit Partner growing on private equity backing, BPX gives you the platform breadth and the customer conversations to show them, across Sales, Service, Data and Experience Cloud.

Additional information

Benefits include medical insurance, 401(k), PTO, sick leave and remote working.

Equal Employment Opportunity. Bluprintx is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications and business need. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process and will consider requests for reasonable accommodation at any stage, contact us to discuss what you need.

raw.excerpt: Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find ItWe are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.
raw.description:
Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find It

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. transportation operations with a focus on freight evaluation, load selection, mileage calculations, and operational planning.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have relevant exposure to U.S. trucking or transportation operations and a working understanding of freight load boards.

The right candidate should understand that a load cannot be evaluated by rate alone. Deadhead, loaded miles, equipment, appointments, driver availability, Hours of Service, and operating requirements all affect whether freight makes sense for a truck.

What You'll Evaluate

  • Search DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Compare available freight by lane, equipment type, mileage, rate, and appointment requirements.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Identify excessive deadhead and inefficient freight options.
  • Review pickup and delivery schedules for operational feasibility.
  • Consider available driver Hours of Service when evaluating loads.
  • Determine whether available equipment is appropriate for the freight.
  • Identify potential delays, accessorial considerations, and unusual load requirements.
  • Organize suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.

Understanding Freight Economics

Freight evaluation requires looking beyond the advertised load rate.

You will be expected to understand how factors such as:

  • Loaded mileage
  • Deadhead mileage
  • Rate per mile
  • Equipment type
  • Pickup and delivery appointments
  • Driver Hours of Service
  • Freight lanes
  • Driver location and availability
  • Potential detention or other accessorial situations

affect the operational value of a load.

Applicants should be comfortable working with mileage calculations, spreadsheets, freight information, and basic trip economics.

Relevant Transportation Background

Prior professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Relevant experience or knowledge may come from:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Owner-operator or fleet operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Logistics or transportation operations

Applicants must have enough U.S. trucking knowledge to understand basic freight terminology, equipment, mileage, lanes, and load-board information.

Essential Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with freight load boards such as DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable systems.
  • Understanding of common equipment types including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Ability to calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total miles, and rate per mile.
  • Basic understanding of U.S. freight lanes.
  • Working understanding of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with drivers, brokers, carriers, and transportation personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Computer proficiency and reliable internet access.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Verify freight information before presenting loads for review.
  • Communicate load information accurately to drivers and authorized operations personnel.
  • Assist with pickup and delivery scheduling.
  • Review rate confirmations and load information for consistency with agreed terms.
  • Monitor active shipments and document operational changes.
  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Escalate broker-verification, safety, compliance, service, or documentation concerns.
  • Maintain professional and timely communication throughout assigned operations.

Work Arrangement

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. transportation operations.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. trucking operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, dependable communication capability, and a professional remote-work environment.

raw.excerpt: Company OverviewCircet USA is the leading provider of Network Services in North America, and we're looking for talented professionals to join our team.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Circet USA is the leading provider of Network Services in North America, and we're looking for talented professionals to join our team. We specialize in engineering and construction services delivering comprehensive solutions across Inside Plant, Outside Plant, and Wireless networks to meet the evolving infrastructure needs of our customers.

With nearly 50 years of industry experience, we work with major telecom service providers, MSOs, cloud service providers, and utilities. At Circet USA, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact by helping to create customized solutions that address our clients' unique challenges. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Circet USA’s benefits package includes the following:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Digital Health & Wellness Support
  • Critical Illness, Accident, & Hospital Insurance
  • Short-term & Long-term disability
  • Group term & Voluntary life insurance
  • Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
  • Paid Time Off & 401K
  • Company Discount Website

Job Summary and Responsibilities

SUMMARY

Circet USA is a premier technology infrastructure design, build, and maintain partner. The Director, Project Management Office (PMO) will build and lead the Data Center Services PMO and Primavera P6 scheduling department. This hands-on leader establishes the project delivery framework, project controls, scheduling standards, governance, tools, reporting, and talent needed to support rapid growth and consistent execution across the project portfolio.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following; other duties may be assigned:

  • Define the PMO charter, operating model, roles, decision rights, governance cadence, and project delivery framework from preconstruction handoff through closeout and customer turnover.
  • Establish common standards and templates for project kickoffs, stage gates, risk and issue logs, change management, lessons learned, closeout, and customer reporting.
  • Select and implement the PMO tools and reporting stack in partnership with IT, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Estimating.
  • Build and lead the Primavera P6 scheduling department, including its mission, organization, staffing plan, hiring, training, career paths, and operating standards.
  • Serve as the business unit authority for P6 enterprise structure, coding, calendars, permissions, templates, baselines, resource loading, and update protocols.
  • Develop repeatable schedule templates for data center scopes, including structured cabling, phased data hall turnover, and commissioning support.
  • Require sound critical path method schedules and lead schedule-quality reviews using recognized criteria such as the DCMA 14-point assessment.
  • Oversee look-ahead schedules, recovery plans, delay analyses, and time impact analyses supporting change orders and claims.
  • Align Circet schedules with owner, customer, and general contractor master schedules and reporting requirements.
  • Provide leadership with an integrated view of portfolio health across schedule, cost, margin, safety, quality, staffing, change, and risk.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting, estimates at completion, change-order tracking, work-in-progress reviews, and margin performance.
  • Lead monthly portfolio reviews, identify at-risk projects early, and present data-supported recovery recommendations to the SVP.
  • Define and maintain key performance indicators for project delivery, PMO effectiveness, schedule quality, and portfolio performance.
  • Forecast labor and resource demand across backlog and pipeline, identify capacity constraints, and connect training capacity to project demand.
  • Support Sales and Estimating with schedule development, delivery plans, and customer-facing project-controls content.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop PMO and scheduling professionals; train project managers, superintendents, and field leaders on standards and tools.
  • Build a culture of accurate reporting, early escalation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers for change management and change order execution on their assigned project/s.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers as applies to project budget management, job cost control, and earned value management on their assigned project/s.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required.

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be substituted.
  • 10+ years of project delivery, project controls, or scheduling experience in data center, mission-critical, telecommunications, or complex infrastructure construction.
  • 5+ years leading a PMO, project controls group, scheduling team, or leading large-scale delivery.
  • Demonstrated success building or substantially rebuilding a PMO or scheduling function in a rapid-growth environment.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Primavera P6, critical path method scheduling, schedule logic, baselines, resource loading, and schedule-quality review.
  • Experience with recovery schedules, delay analysis, time impact analysis, and change orders tied to schedule impacts.
  • Working knowledge of contractor financials, including forecasting, estimates at completion, margin, and work in progress.
  • Experience reporting to executives and working directly with owners, customers, and general contractors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale or colocation data center delivery.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, methods of procedure (MOPs), commissioning levels, TIA-942, and BICSI standards.
  • PMP, PMI-SP, AACE PSP, or AACE CCP certification.
  • Experience with Power BI or a similar reporting platform and construction management software such as Procore.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed or similarly high-growth services business.
  • Experience with field-services workforces and labor-capacity planning.

COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic Leadership and PMO Development
  • Primavera P6 and Project Scheduling
  • Project Controls and Portfolio Governance
  • Financial Acumen and Performance Reporting
  • Risk, Change, and Claims Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence
  • Executive and Customer Communication
  • Talent Development and Change Adoption

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Within 30 days: current projects, tools, and reporting gaps assessed; PMO charter and hiring plan approved.
  • Within 90 days: P6 environment and standards defined; initial schedulers hired or assigned; monthly portfolio review operating; highest-risk projects on P6 schedules.
  • Within 6 months: all new projects launched using standard templates and stage gates; portfolio dashboard live; schedule-quality reviews established.
  • Within 12 months: all active projects baselined in P6; PMO and scheduling teams staffed to plan; labor forecasts informing capacity decisions; function prepared to support continued growth.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex business, construction, contractual, and technical documents; ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and communicate clearly with executives, customers, general contractors, and field teams.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate and interpret percentages, rates, variances, productivity, forecast-to-complete values, margins, schedule performance, earned-value indicators, and other project and financial measures; ability to apply basic algebra and quantitative reasoning.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect and validate data, establish facts, evaluate alternatives, identify cause and effect, and draw sound conclusions in situations involving multiple variables, competing priorities, and incomplete information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; talk; and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role combines office or remote work with regular travel to active project sites and customer locations. Site visits may require personal protective equipment and compliance with site safety, security, and access requirements. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

TRAVEL

Anticipated travel is up to 30% based on business need, including project-site visits and customer-facing engagements.

Circet USA is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of females, minorities, veterans and disabled.

About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org(opens in new window) to learn more.

Short Description

  • Uses clinical expertise to review patient medical records and ensure that the documentation accurately reflects the patient’s diagnosis, treatments and severity of illness. This role bridges the gap between healthcare providers and coding professionals, ensuring that medical records are complete, compliant, and support proper reimbursement.
  • Concurrently review inpatient medical records for clear consistent, concise, legible and accurate documentation to reflect the patient’s severity of illness and intensity of services.
  • Generate and utilize queries to clarify physician documentation whenever there is conflicting, ambiguous or incomplete information in the medical record regarding any significant reportable condition or procedure.

  • Collaboratively work with HIM Leadership, Coders, Coding Quality Educators/Reviewers and peers to improve accuracy of final DRG.

  • Facilitates modifications to clinical documentation through concurrent interaction with physicians, nursing staff, other patient caregiver and Health Information coding staff to support that appropriate reimbursement and clinical severity is captured for the level of service rendered to all inpatients.
  • Provide clinical review of cases denied for medical necessity by auditing agencies. Using knowledge of medical necessity criteria assist physician advisor in collecting pertinent information to support an appeal.

  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Bachelor's of Science in Nursing preferred

  • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist Certification preferred

  • Registered Nurse, any state, preferred

Special Requirements

Professional team player, able to communicate well with others on all levels required.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes.

Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

Purpose of the Role:

Support the Chief of Staff to the Chief External Affairs & Growth Officer through policy and business research, executive briefing preparation, project coordination, and tracking of organizational priorities. The intern will synthesize complex information into clear, actionable materials and support internal and external engagements involving energy, regulatory, legislative, political, and market issues. Constellation's 2027 Summer Intern Program will run approximately 10 weeks, from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to see how strategy, public policy, legal, communications, sustainability, advocacy, and development come together. The intern will work directly with the Chief of Staff and support projects that cut across the External Affairs & Growth organization, gaining exposure to senior leaders, enterprise priorities, and the processes behind executive decision-making.

A significant part of this work is policy-focused and centers on preparing the Chief External Affairs & Growth Officer for both internal and external engagements. The intern will help research the energy, regulatory, legislative, and political issues that shape Constellation’s business, and turn that research into the briefings, talking points, and background materials.

This is a great opportunity for someone interested in the intersection of energy, public policy, politics, corporate strategy, communications, and organizational leadership who wants hands-on experience seeing how a large, complex organization turns priorities into action.

About External Affairs & Growth:

External Affairs & Growth brings together teams responsible for Legal; Public Policy; Sustainability & Policy Analysis; Strategy, Corporate Affairs & Public Advocacy; and Development. The organization works across a wide range of issues affecting Constellation and the energy industry, bringing together different functions and perspectives to advance shared priorities.

Primary Duties and Accountabilities:

  • Conduct research on energy, public policy, legislative, regulatory, political, and market issues and summarize relevant findings for executive decision-making and engagements.
  • Draft and edit briefing materials, issue summaries, stakeholder profiles, talking points, presentations, meeting materials, and other executive communications.
  • Support preparation for leadership meetings and external engagements by developing agendas and materials, documenting decisions and action items, and coordinating follow-up.
  • Assist with cross-functional projects by organizing information, maintaining project plans and trackers, monitoring timelines and deliverables, and identifyingnext steps.
  • Track organizational priorities, commitments, decisions, and action items to support timely and consistent execution.
  • Use Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft 365 tools to organize, analyze, track, and present information.
  • Support process improvements, information sharing, and other time-sensitive assignments as priorities evolve.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate degree program.
  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex information clearly andconcisely to multiple levels of leadership including senior executives.
  • Demonstrated research, analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams, and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  • Ability to work full-time during the summer and primarily during East Coast business hours

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Rising junior or senior in an undergraduate program or currently enrolled in a master’s program.
  • Coursework or degree focus in public policy, public administration, economics, communications, marketing, political science, government, international affairs, energy, environmental policy, or a related field.
  • Prior internship, employment, or volunteer experience in government, public policy, political campaigns, energy, communications, corporate strategy, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including experience organizing, analyzing, tracking, and presenting information.
  • Interest in energy and public policy, organizational strategy, executive decision-making, or cross-functional business operations.

Constellation will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to lawfully work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Lead Systems Engineer - Design

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (55%)

  • Serve as client program lead, project trade lead, and SME for the BAS and EPMS scope for one or more projects and / or programs.
  • Develop client standards, basis of design (BOD), perform feasibility studies, and assist clients with building automation roadmaps
  • Lead designs for DDC and PLC based BAS and EPMS systems
  • Design controls network / system architecture including IT / OT requirements
  • Select instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices
  • Coordinate with equipment, system, and product vendors for building automation interface requirements
  • Create and review project book and sheet specifications
  • Create and review sequence of operations
  • Create and review system diagrams and point / alarm lists
  • Work closely with client IT departments for network design, interface details, and security requirements
  • Provide direction on engineering production aspects with internal and external Revit / BIM resources

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

  • Accountable for design document deliverables for design phases including Schematic Design (SD), Design Development (DD), Issue For Permit (IFP), Issue For Construction (IFC)
  • Lead planning and execution of Construction Administration (CA) phase activities remote and on site
  • Lead building automation focused design reviews and page turns
  • ​Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews
  • Lead internal and external project meeting discussions on engineering scope

Reporting and Communication (15%)

  • Manage project communication and reporting
  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

People Manager (15%)

  • Implement and monitor team objectives to meet set goals.
  • Manage and execute departmental or organizational projects, ensuring alignment with departmental focus.
  • Ensure employee adherence to company policies and procedures, serve as the first stop for employee questions on workplace rules and practices.
  • Direct team members clearly, maintaining consistency with organizational objectives.
  • Develop team efficiency and prioritization strategies.
  • Facilitate team member development through targeted coaching.
  • Resolve conflicts within the team, promoting a collaborative atmosphere.
  • Perform routine performance evaluations and 1:1 meetings, offering feedback and defining objectives.
  • Participate in organizational strategy discussions to synchronize departmental and company goals.
  • Foster interdepartmental communication to enhance organizational understanding.
  • Align team efforts with overarching company strategies.
  • Communicate details effectively to all stakeholders.
  • Optimize resource management and task assignments within the team.
  • Adapt resource allocation in response to project demands and departmental needs.
  • Cultivate a team environment that encourages cooperation and collective problem-solving.
  • Assist with team and departmental hiring and recruiting processes.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in designing BAS and EPMS packages
  • Knowledge of construction design process, stakeholders, deliverables
  • Knowledge of code requirements and energy guidelines related to BAS designs
  • Knowledge of data center HVAC applications and BAS control strategies including chilled water plants
  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Knowledge of Networking including Addressing, VLANs, LANs, Switches and Routers
  • Knowledge of open-source protocols (BACnet, Modbus and SNMP)
  • Knowledge of DDC systems used in building automation designs
  • Knowledge of PLC systems used in building automation designs
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to mentor and train junior engineers

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 15%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline

OR

  • Two years of experience with hands-on installation, testing, validation and troubleshooting of controls infrastructure

PLUS

  • Minimum eight years of additional experience with BAS and EPMS design
  • At least half of this experience should be with hyperscale or colocation data center projects

BENEFITS

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Michael Baker International is seeking a Telecom Designer to join our growing team and contribute to the design of innovative low-voltage and telecommunications systems for a variety of complex and exciting projects, including high-profile Federal projects. This is a great opportunity to build your technical expertise while working alongside experienced engineers, architects, and designers in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Under the guidance of senior team members, you’ll apply engineering and design fundamentals, develop plans and construction documents, and help deliver integrated technology solutions that support our clients and their facilities.

In this role, you will:

  • Assist in the design of low-voltage and telecommunications systems, equipment, components, and infrastructure for a variety of project types.
  • Use Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, and other design tools to develop plans, maintain BIM and detail libraries, and coordinate drawing production with other engineering and architectural disciplines.

  • Support the development of scopes of work, budgetary estimates, and multidisciplinary design coordination.
  • Design systems including structured cabling, access control, CCTV, voice and data systems, communications room layouts, audiovisual systems, wireless systems, and low-voltage building infrastructure.
  • Contribute to projects across a variety of markets, including Federal and government, higher education, healthcare, commercial, and other complex facilities.
  • Develop construction specifications and drawings and support projects through construction, including field inspections, field acceptance testing, contractor coordination, and review of close-out documentation.
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, project managers, and other technical professionals across multiple offices and disciplines.
  • Participate in occasional project-related travel and site visits.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

PROFESSIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Associate’s degree in a related field preferred.
  • 1–5 years of relevant experience, ideally including exposure to several of the following systems:
    • Data/voice structured cabling systems
    • Audiovisual presentation and conferencing systems
    • Wireless systems, including Wi-Fi
    • Data center infrastructure
    • Access control
    • Intrusion detection
    • Video surveillance systems
  • RCDD certification preferred.
  • Experience with Autodesk Revit and/or AutoCAD and Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
  • Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) preferred.
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with an understanding of how architectural and engineering disciplines work together throughout the design and construction process.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple assignments while meeting project deadlines.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team environment.

  • Interest in contributing to design approaches, technical solutions, and project concepts.
  • Availability for occasional project-related travel.

Compensation
The salary range for this position is $79,000- $110,000. The actual salary offered will be dependent on the experience and expertise of the incoming candidate.

Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian is building a next-generation Site Reliability Engineering team, and we’re looking for talented, motivated engineers who thrive in fast-paced, problem-solving environments. As an SRE, you’ll design, deploy, and operate large-scale distributed systems across compute, storage, networking, and AI/ML environments. You’ll lead projects from architecture to automation to intelligent monitoring, collaborating with both clients and teammates to build resilient, high-performing infrastructure.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

  • Operate and optimize Kubernetes clusters, Istio service mesh, and Linux-based systems.
  • Automate workflows using Go, Python, and Shell scripting.
  • Build monitoring and observability solutions with Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking, storage, and system performance issues.
  • Partner with AI/ML teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for model training and data pipelines.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and postmortem reviews to improve system resilience.

What we need from you:

  • Experience with Google Cloud, plus IaC tools (Terraform).
  • Strong knowledge of microservices, containers (Kubernetes, Docker), and networking.
  • Hands-on experience with PKI, service mesh, and Linux systems administration.
  • SRE mindset with a focus on automation, scalability, and reliability.

  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). raw.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, Operational AI
raw.excerpt: Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI.
raw.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

The Opportunity

As AI transitions from analysis into real-world autonomous action, enterprises require more than intelligent models—they need an ultra-low-latency operational fabric that connects agent swarms and workflows directly to live reality. That requires authoritative state, unified context, and enterprise-grade policy controls.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Aerospike, you will serve as the hands-on technical authority partnering with lead architects and engineering teams across Global 2000 enterprises. You will own the technical architecture and end-to-end implementation of mission-critical systems: discovering deep architectural challenges, writing core production code, validating high-throughput workloads, and driving post-production operational resilience.

This is a premier individual contributor (IC) role. You will bridge customer production deployments with Aerospike’s core product and platform engineering teams, translating novel distributed systems challenges into reusable platform patterns, hardened reference architectures, and foundational product features.

What You’ll Build

  • Authoritative State Engines: Architect and implement real-time distributed foundations for session, entity, workflow, and multi-agent state. Support massive concurrent reads/writes under stringent SLA guarantees for data freshness, consistency, and sub-millisecond recovery.
  • Context Assembly Pipelines: Design systems that merge enterprise records, streaming state, low-latency vector search, and graph topologies to provide grounded, permission-aware context for autonomous decisions.
  • Execution Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Embed deterministic boundaries, authorization checks, rate/execution governors, and human-in-the-loop triggers directly into distributed data and execution paths.
  • Auditable Governance & Traceability: Build immutable telemetry and lineage pipelines that capture runtime context, decisions, downstream side-effects, and state mutations to meet enterprise security and compliance standards.
  • The Continuous Operating Loop: Build and tune closed-loop distributed systems: State → Context → Inference → Action → Consequence → State Mutation, ensuring deterministic execution at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive System Architecture: Embed with enterprise staff/principal engineers and platform owners to break ambiguous, high-scale operational requirements into concrete systems designs, data schemas, and verifiable milestones.
  • Write Production Code: Write, optimize, and review high-performance code across Aerospike, distributed data backends, vector search runtimes, and agentic execution frameworks.
  • Own Technical Outcomes: Drive full-lifecycle validation in client staging and production environments. Troubleshoot concurrency bottlenecks, memory leaks, cluster failovers, and serialization overhead under extreme workloads.
  • Rigorous Systems Benchmarking: Design and execute performance profiles testing tail latency (p99p99p99/p99.9p99.9p99.9), throughput limits, cross-region replication lag, vector recall, and fallback reliability under active network partitions.
  • Influence Platform Roadmap: Function as the primary bridge back to internal core engineering. Extract reusable components, build field libraries and toolchains, and author standard-setting reference architectures.
  • Technical Thought Leadership: Serve as a domain expert on real-time operational AI. Present architectural trade-offs to senior client leadership, write definitive implementation guides, and mentor partner engineering teams.

How You’ll Lead (Staff/Principal IC Track)

  • Architectural Anchor: Act as the technical North Star for forward deployed engineering, setting standards for code quality, design documentation, and production readiness across high-value client projects.
  • Force Multiplier: Elevate senior and staff engineers across the team through design reviews, pair programming on complex distributed debugging sessions, and targeted technical mentorship.
  • Cross-Organizational Impact: Partner seamlessly with Product, Core Database Engineering, Professional Services, and Solutions Architecture to resolve architectural misalignments and accelerate deployment velocity.
  • Domain Advocacy: Distill real-world distributed agent failure modes into technical white papers, internal technical deep dives, and open-source tooling.

Operating Model with Client & Field Teams

Principal FDEs own the architecture, direct systems implementation, and end-to-end technical integrity of Operational AI deployments.

  • Professional Services leads standard installations, migrations, cluster sizing, and infrastructure operations.
  • Solutions Architecture & TAMs maintain long-term account governance, commercial alignment, and operational advisory.
  • Your Focus: You remain unburdened by routine implementation, maintenance tickets, or account management. Your remit is solving the hardest distributed computing and operational AI problems, deploying working code, and hardening our software for enterprise-scale adoption.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience building and scaling high-performance distributed systems, database internals, or large-scale data infrastructure in production.
  • Deep Systems Programming: Proven expertise in Go, C/C++, Java, or Rust, with an understanding of memory management, lock-free data structures, networking protocols, cache hierarchies, and concurrent systems programming.
  • Real-Time Data & Systems Design: Track record of designing systems with strict SLA targets (sub-10ms tail latency, high-throughput streaming, and robust consistency models).
  • Applied AI & Agentic Infrastructure: Hands-on experience building low-latency context retrieval platforms, vector index optimizations, stateful agent runtimes, or deterministic workflow orchestration engines.
  • Distributed Governance & Security: Practical knowledge of building zero-trust data access layers, cryptographic auditing, data isolation models, and distributed rate-limiting.
  • Client-Facing Technical Leadership: Demonstrated poise and clarity when working with customer engineering leaders, with the ability to cut through ambiguity and make high-judgment technical tradeoffs on the fly.
  • Independence & Execution Bias: Self-directed operator capable of taking an abstract concept from whitepaper or sketch through to battle-tested production software.

Helpful Experience

  • Hands-on experience with the Aerospike Real-time Data Platform, Aerospike Vector Search (AVS), or Aerospike Graph.
  • Experience with distributed coordination primitives (Raft, Paxos), durable event-driven systems (Kafka, Flink), or durable execution frameworks (Temporal).
  • Familiarity with Linux kernel tuning, eBPF, zero-copy networking, or bare-metal performance optimization.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes, hybrid-cloud networking, and Terraform.

Compensation and Impact

  • Evaluation Metric: Success is driven by production deployments, platform adoption, reduction of architectural debt, and high-impact software assets—never billable hours or utilization percentages.
  • Comprehensive Benefits (USA): Competitive base salary, significant equity participation, 401(k) matching, comprehensive medical/dental/vision coverage, and flexible remote work allowances.

Aerospike is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to an environment free from discrimination based on race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

To keep our recruitment pipeline as high-performance as our database, Aerospike uses AI-driven tools to streamline resume reviews, scheduling, and communication. While we love smart tech, we value human connection even more. AI helps us optimize the process, but real people make 100% of the actual hiring decisions.

raw.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Jira is the beating heart of Atlassian’s System of Work, evolving from a system that helps teams manage work into an intelligent partner for how modern work gets done.

Unifying organisational context, capabilities, and agentic workflows - and enriched by the Teamwork Graph and powered by Rovo, 1P, and 3P agents - Jira turns everyday collaboration into a blend of human creativity, enterprise-grade reliability and agent-driven execution.

Your future team

The Jira Design team’s remit is to continuously evolve Jira into the modern choice for work management and to unleash the power of every team.

We are looking for a Lead Product Designer to be a key contributor within the Jira Design team. In this role, you will report into a Senior Design Manager, and join an organization consisting of multiple teams in Australia and North America. As a lead individual contributor, you'll lead and execute strategic work across Jira, Atlassian’s flagship product within the Teamwork Collection app suite.

Responsibilities

What you'll do:

As a Lead Product Designer, you will conceptualise and deliver industry-leading experiences. You’ll mentor our Jira design team, lead strategic initiatives, set cohesive vision, and manage interconnected projects so Jira feels designed by one hand.

As a Product Designer at Atlassian, you'll:

  • Make a substantial impact at scale. We have more than 10M users worldwide, and teams both large and small depend on our software. As a designer involved from product strategy to UI implementation, your work will have direct customer impact.

  • You will own the entire design process. Instead of designing isolated features, you will define end-to-end product experiences and user journeys.

  • Collaborate with some of the industry’s smartest and kindest people. You’ll work on a multidisciplinary product team with engineers, product managers, content designers, researchers, brand and marketing experts, and analysts to advocate for the user experience and ship industry-leading work.

  • Amplify Atlassian’s System of Work and Jira’s role within the Teamwork Collection app suite. You will help usher in a new era of connected context, powerful Rovo capabilities and third-party agent tooling and integrations.

  • Champion our users and great design. We run a world-class design organisation and aim to make customers love our products, measuring our work against competitors and industry standards.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Design end-to-end experiences that integrate AI into Jira workflows and collaboration.

  • Design journeys and patterns that modernise Jira’s design language and create cohesion across our platform, Rovo and 1P/3P agentic workflows.

  • Partner with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to define a unified vision for modern work management at Atlassian.

  • Lead design projects from concept to delivery, owning customer value, outcomes, and impact.

  • Define success metrics to ensure designs deliver customer value and business impact.

  • Identify opportunities to improve our apps and platform and to advance AI-native product evolution.

Your background

  • 7+ years of product design experience designing complex or enterprise-level software

  • High level of craft in visual design execution

  • Strong prototyping skills, with the ability to present clear options, configurations and trade-offs

  • Recent experience designing AI-native processes, workflows and agentic tooling

  • Experience in end-to-end UX and product design, crafting impactful solutions to challenging problems

  • Passion for storytelling, with the ability to bring design direction to life through a compelling narrative

  • Experience conducting and applying customer research, including design thinking, prototyping and conceptual modelling

  • Experience balancing customer needs with business goals, market viability and technical feasibility

  • Facilitation and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the demonstrated ability to integrate the work of multiple teams, solicit and synthesise feedback, and facilitate design discussions that lead to clear progress and outcomes

  • Experience measuring success through qualitative and quantitative methods

  • The ability to define complex projects, requirements, measures of success, testing approaches and feedback mechanisms

  • Strong stakeholder management, risk mitigation and negotiation skills

  • Experience improving processes and methodologies to increase product value, team velocity and adoption of new capabilities

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Mit unserem Workation Worldwide Programm kannst du bis zu 60 Arbeitstage im Jahr ortsunabhängig arbeiten – jetzt weltweit innerhalb von ±4 Stunden zur deutschen Zeitzone.

raw.excerpt: The Role At Treewalk, you’ll own the entire public-company reporting cycle: fast closes, 10-K, 10-Q, and 20-F building, US GAAP judgment calls, and scalable system design.
raw.description:
The Role

At Treewalk, you’ll own the entire public-company reporting cycle: fast closes, 10-K, 10-Q, and 20-F building, US GAAP judgment calls, and scalable system design. You’ll own end-to-end financial disclosure for a portfolio of high growth clients from a broad range of industries. Many engagements will tap you as a de-facto fractional CFO, guiding strategy as well as disclosure; others will lean on you as the go-to technical expert. Either way, every file is yours to run.

Deadlines are real; overtime isn’t a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility—so your evenings stay yours.

If you’ve led pub-co audits at a small- to mid-size firm or managed reporting inside a US listed issuer, and you’re ready to trade 70-hour busy-season marathons for high-impact work, tangible ownership, and genuine balance, then we would love to hear from you.

How You’ll Create Impact Day-to-Day

  • Own the story behind the numbers: Draft and polish quarterly and annual financial statements and MD&A for Forms 10-Q, 10-K, 20-F and 40-F that stand up to SEC and capital-markets scrutiny and tell each client’s growth narrative.
  • Run the engine of multi-entity groups: Build rock-solid consolidation and foreign-currency translation models that make complex structures look effortless.
  • Turn data into insight: Deliver sharp balance sheet and P&L analyses, spotlighting trends and red-flag variances before anyone else sees them.
  • Keep leadership laser-focused: Produce monthly variance reports against forecasts and annual plans, translating the findings into clear, action-ready recommendations, including cash runway and financing timing.
  • Shape the roadmap: Guide annual budgets and rolling forecasts, aligning stakeholders around targets that push the business without breaking it.
  • Step in as the “extra brain”: Handle special-project bookkeeping or period-end close entries when clients need a fractional controller’s precision and speed.
  • Make audits painless: Design year-end audit plans, prep airtight support, and quarterback conversations with external auditors so CEOs and CFOs can sleep at night.
  • Guard continuous disclosure: Stay ahead of regulatory changes, draft timely filings, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks on EDGAR.

Result: clients see you as the calm, expert voice who keeps them compliant and strategic, while you build mastery across industries without the grind of traditional public practice.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

  • CPA designation required.
  • Significant public company audit and/or financial reporting experience – ideally with small to mid-sized reporting issuers listed in the US and reporting under US GAAP
  • After the base experience requirements are met, we hire first and foremost, strong analytical and problem solvers.


Why Treewalk Feels Different

It’s Treewalk for a reason: we invest in your growth, trust your judgment, and protect your life outside the ledger.

  • No-Strings Learning Fund: We pay 100% of your CPA modules, annual dues, and any pro-dev courses you choose, and we’ll never claw it back if you move on.
  • Freedom Over Face-Time: Own your deadlines, shape your schedule. Hit a midday workout, do the school run. Just bring the results.
  • Day-One Peace of Mind: Extended health, dental, vision, and parental-leave benefits start the moment you join.

Who We Are
