raw.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

DEPARTMENT: U.S. Resettlement, Asylum, and Integration (RAI)

TEAM: Virtual Services

LOCATION: Fully virtual

RECRUITMENT WINDOW: Fall

START DATE: October 15, 2026

DURATION: At minimum through March 31, 2027 but can be extended further

SUPERVISED BY: Virtual Matching Grant & Virtual Program of Initial Resettlement Coordinator


The International Rescue Committee (IRC) helps people affected by humanitarian crises survive, recover, and rebuild their lives. In the United States, the IRC supports refugees, asylees, and other immigrants through resettlement, employment, workforce development, and integration services delivered across its network of offices. This fully remote internship sits specifically on the Virtual Services team at IRC headquarters.


Matching Grant (MG) is a federally funded economic self-sufficiency program that helps refugees, asylees, and humanitarian parolees achieve self-sufficiency through employment. The Virtual Program of Initial Resettlement (VPIR) supports newly arrived clients with core resettlement services during their first months in the United States. This internship will provide structured learning about Matching Grant's employment services — including job search assistance, employer outreach, and career counseling — while also offering exposure to VPIR service delivery.


SCOPE OF SERVICE:

Under the supervision of the VMG/VPIR Coordinator, the intern will learn about and participate in guided activities related to the Coordinator's employment services and resettlement caseload. The intern will receive mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals and participate in activities designed for educational development. The intern's activities are designed for educational benefit and are not intended to replace or supplement the work of the Coordinator. The Coordinator will provide regular feedback, coaching, and evaluation based on the intern's learning progress, not productivity.


EDUCATIONAL BENEFIT:

The Virtual Services Intern will gain insight into how employment services and initial resettlement support are delivered to a virtual caseload, how job readiness training is structured, and how employment placement contributes to refugees' economic self-sufficiency. The internship is designed to build the intern's knowledge and professional skills in this field.


LEARNING OBJECTIVES:

  • The intern will gain exposure to and guided practice in employment services, including job search support, employer engagement, and career counseling.
  • The intern will deepen understanding of the Matching Grant program and refugee economic self-sufficiency.
  • The intern will gain exposure to the refugee resettlement process and the public benefits system.
  • The intern will develop skills in case management databases, digital communication tools, and program data reporting.

SUPERVISED LEARNING ACTIVITIES INCLUDE:

  • Observe and participate in guided client job search activities led by the VMG/VPIR Coordinator, including learning how job openings are identified, how resumes and applications are prepared, and how interview skills are practiced.
  • Observe employer outreach efforts led by the Coordinator and participate in guided exercises on identifying job leads and documenting employer partnerships.
  • Observe basic career counseling and coaching provided by the Coordinator, and practice under supervision how to help clients identify employment goals and next steps.
  • Participate in guided learning on pre-arrival and early resettlement tasks under the Virtual Program of Initial Resettlement, including supervised research on housing and community resources.
  • Observe one-on-one job readiness training sessions facilitated by the Coordinator, covering topics such as resume-building, interview preparation, and workplace expectations.
  • Participate in supervised exercises creating community asset maps with clients to learn how to identify local employment, education, and support resources.
  • Learn to document client interactions in case management databases through guided practice, with the Coordinator reviewing entries and providing feedback.
  • Participate in guided learning on data management, including data entry, data cleaning, and program reporting, with feedback from the Coordinator.
  • This internship is intended to complement academic coursework and may qualify for academic credit, depending on university requirements.

TRAINING ACTIVITIES:

  • Observation
  • Participation in team meetings
  • Guided assignments
  • Supervised practice

DESIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Bachelor's degree required; current graduate coursework toward a master's degree preferred.
  • Interest in and/or experience with job search assistance, employer outreach, or career counseling.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with clients, colleagues, and external partners.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, with strong organizational skills and the ability to engage in self-directed learning in a remote setting.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and comfort with digital tools for outreach, data entry, and communication.

TIME COMMITMENT:

  • This internship is fully virtual; the intern must use their own laptop/equipment.
  • Intern must have a private workspace where they can effectively participate in learning activities during regularly scheduled hours.
  • Minimum of 15 hours per week of availability; hours must fall within business hours (9am–5pm), Monday–Friday, in any U.S. time zone.
  • Onboarding and ongoing trainings are required to align with the IRC Way & organizational policies to safeguard our clients and programs.
  • Participate reliably and consistently in scheduled learning sessions and team meetings.

ELIGIBILITY & ONBOARDING REQUIREMENTS:

  • Interns must be located in the U.S. during the duration of the internship.
  • All positions are contingent upon clearing an IRC background check through HireRight before service.
  • Review and sign IRC intern policy documents and commitment paperwork.
  • IRC onboarding and training:
    • IRC Way, Every Day
    • RAI Safety and Security
    • Fundamentals of Safeguarding
    • Information Security Awareness Training
    • Additional quarterly organizational trainings
  • Program-specific training:
    • Virtual Services Team Orientation
    • Introduction to Matching Grant & VPIR Programs
    • Role-specific training

Interested applicants should apply online including a resume and cover letter outlining their interest in the position and relevant skills. Applications will be reviewed, and, if selected, candidates will be contacted for an interview.


This internship is structured for educational benefit and professional development. It does not constitute an employment relationship or guarantee future employment.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Engineering Manager - Design

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Engineering Manager - Design provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors. This role leads a team of BAS / EPMS engineers, ensuring consistent delivery and quality across multiple MEP design programs by integrating lessons learned and leading the QAQC effort.

This position will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Engineering Manager – Design will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (25%)

  • Serve as client program lead, project trade lead, and SME for the BAS and EPMS scope for one or more projects and / or programs.
  • Develop client standards, basis of design (BOD), perform feasibility studies, and assist clients with building automation roadmaps
  • Lead designs for DDC and PLC based BAS and EPMS systems
  • Design controls network / system architecture including IT / OT requirements
  • Select instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices
  • Coordinate with equipment, system, and product vendors for building automation interface requirements
  • Create and review project book and sheet specifications
  • Create and review sequence of operations
  • Create and review system diagrams and point / alarm lists
  • Work closely with client IT departments for network design, interface details, and security requirements
  • Provide direction on engineering production aspects with internal and external Revit / BIM resources

Training / Technical Firm Standards Development / Improvement of Policies and Procedures (30%)

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce organizational design standards, templates, and best practices for BAS / EPMS design projects alongside leadership
  • Mentor and train staff on technical competencies, software tools, and project workflows
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned sessions on completed projects
  • Perform QAQC reviews for all project milestones on projects / programs where they are not lead engineer

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

  • Accountable for design document deliverables for design phases including Schematic Design (SD), Design Development (DD), Issue For Permit (IFP), Issue For Construction (IFC)
  • Lead planning and execution of Construction Administration (CA) phase activities remote and on site
  • Lead building automation focused design reviews and page turns
  • Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews
  • Lead internal and external project meeting discussions on engineering scope

Reporting and Communication (15%)

  • Manage project communication and reporting
  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

People Manager (15%)

  • Implement and monitor team objectives to meet set goals.
  • Manage and execute departmental or organizational projects, ensuring alignment with departmental focus.
  • Ensure employee adherence to company policies and procedures, serve as the first stop for employee questions on workplace rules and practices.
  • Direct team members clearly, maintaining consistency with organizational objectives.
  • Develop team efficiency and prioritization strategies.
  • Facilitate team member development through targeted coaching.
  • Resolve conflicts within the team, promoting a collaborative atmosphere.
  • Perform routine performance evaluations and 1:1 meetings, offering feedback and defining objectives.
  • Participate in organizational strategy discussions to synchronize departmental and company goals.
  • Foster interdepartmental communication to enhance organizational understanding.
  • Align team efforts with overarching company strategies.
  • Communicate details effectively to all stakeholders.
  • Optimize resource management and task assignments within the team.
  • Adapt resource allocation in response to project demands and departmental needs.
  • Cultivate a team environment that encourages cooperation and collective problem-solving.
  • Assist with team and departmental hiring and recruiting processes.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in designing BAS and EPMS packages for MEP firm(s)
  • Knowledge of construction design process, stakeholders, deliverables
  • Knowledge of code requirements and energy guidelines related to BAS designs
  • Knowledge of data center HVAC applications and BAS control strategies including chilled water plants
  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Knowledge of Networking including Addressing, VLANs, LANs, Switches and Routers
  • Knowledge of open-source protocols (BACnet, Modbus and SNMP)
  • Knowledge of DDC systems used in building automation designs
  • Knowledge of PLC systems used in building automation designs
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to mentor and train junior engineers

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline; equivalent military / industry experience accepted
  • Minimum eight years of experience with BAS and EPMS design
  • At least half of this experience should be with hyperscale or colocation data center projects
  • MEP, DDC and PLC experience
  • Experience as a people manager

BENEFITS

Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

You'll partner closely with our security engineers, Sales and Solutions Engineering. The Head of Security owns program strategy, risk decisions and policy sign-off.

What you'll do

Audit readiness (SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS)

  • Run day-to-day work in Drata: map controls, connect integrations, close gaps, and keep evidence collection current

  • Coordinate the SOC 2 audit cycle: auditor coordination, evidence requests, walkthroughs, and tracking exceptions and remediation

  • Run the biannual and quarterly PCI reviews and track external scan findings to closure

  • Prepare recurring SOC 2 evidence, including quarterly access and group reviews, audit-log exports, and incident summaries

  • Chase owners to close postmortem follow-ups and control gaps across Engineering, Infra/DevOps, IT, HR and People Ops

Customer trust and sales support

  • Be first responder on security questionnaires, DDQs and customer vendor-risk reviews (about 4–8 a month). These include SIG, CAIQ and custom bank questionnaires, often submitted through customer portals such as LogicGate, Aravo and Coupa.

  • Keep the security answers current in the answer library that Solutions Engineering maintains. New or changed security claims get Security sign-off before they go out.

  • Build a reusable screenshot evidence pack for customers that won't accept Trust Center links

  • Keep our Trust Center current: SOC 2 report, pen test summary, policies and subprocessors

  • Review customer security requirements in MSAs and DPAs, and keep our customer security requirements tracker up to date

Policies, risk and governance

  • Run the annual review of our security policy set

  • Manage the security policy exceptions log

  • Coordinate the annual risk assessment, keep the risk register current, and prepare the leadership risk review

  • Coordinate the annual BCP/DR test and write the customer-facing summary

  • Track the HR-side SOC 2 controls: background checks, security training, onboarding and offboarding

Third-party risk management

raw.description:
Reports/Automation Specialist

Location: Remote

Contract Status: Pending Award

Notice: This position is contingent upon JCTM receiving a contract award and authorization to proceed. Employment opportunities and anticipated start dates are dependent upon contract award, government approval, and satisfaction of applicable onboarding and suitability requirements.

The Challenge

What if your data reporting and automation expertise could improve how federal decision-makers access critical operational information? USCIS relies on accurate and timely reporting to evaluate customer service operations across telephone, chat, and digital communication channels. JCTM is seeking a Reports/Automation Specialist to develop, maintain, and improve automated reporting processes that support data integrity, operational visibility, and informed decision-making.

Build Your Career

At JCTM, we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.

Challenging Projects

As a Reports/Automation Specialist with JCTM, you will support the analysis, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of periodic and ad-hoc reports within the USCIS Centralized Data Repository (CDR). You will help maintain reporting processes, develop automation improvements, validate data accuracy, and support the continued operation of reporting systems serving multiple USCIS programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Report Development and Maintenance: Analyze, design, implement, test, and maintain recurring and ad-hoc operational reports within the CDR environment.
  • Reporting Automation: Develop and improve automated processes supporting data collection, processing, report generation, and distribution.
  • Data Integration: Support the collection, transformation, and integration of reporting data from Amazon Connect, Salesforce, chat platforms, and other authorized sources.
  • Recurring Reporting: Maintain daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports in accordance with established USCIS requirements and delivery schedules.
  • Dashboard Development: Support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of reports and interactive dashboards using Amazon QuickSight, Amazon Connect Reporting, Crystal Reports, or comparable tools.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Review incoming data, identify missing files or anomalous statistics, and coordinate the resolution of reporting discrepancies.
  • Process Improvement: Identify manual reporting activities suitable for automation and implement approved improvements to reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Automated Task Monitoring: Monitor automated data imports, scheduled reporting tasks, and related processes to identify performance issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Prepare specialized data extracts, reports, and analytical products in response to USCIS operational requirements.
  • Testing and Validation: Test new and modified reports, automated workflows, and reporting system enhancements before deployment.
  • Technical Documentation: Maintain reporting documentation, operational procedures, automation workflows, and records of system modifications.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with USCIS stakeholders, technical teams, and external vendors to ensure reporting requirements are understood and implemented effectively.
  • System Support: Provide ongoing technical and analytical support for the CDR and associated reporting processes.

State-of-the-Art Technology

Expand your expertise through enterprise reporting and automation technologies, including Amazon Connect Reporting, Amazon QuickSight, AWS-hosted data environments, SQL databases, and business intelligence tools.

New Skills

Work alongside systems analysts, business analysts, technical developers, and federal program stakeholders while gaining additional experience in data automation, enterprise reporting integration, dashboard development, and large-scale operational analytics.

Room to Grow

You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to the company's strategic goals, supported by mentorship and a collaborative work environment.

You Have

  • Associate's degree or higher.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Information Technology field.
  • Ability to analyze, design, implement, test, and maintain reports and information technology processes.
  • Ability to support reporting system enhancements, technical documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate findings effectively.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience developing automated reports, data processing workflows, or business intelligence solutions.
  • Experience with Amazon QuickSight, Amazon Connect Reporting, Crystal Reports, or comparable reporting tools.
  • Proficiency with SQL queries, relational databases, or data extraction and transformation techniques.
  • Experience using scripting or programming languages such as Python or PowerShell to automate reporting functions.
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services, including Amazon S3.
  • Experience designing dashboards, analyzing large datasets, and validating reporting outputs.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis and reporting automation.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or enterprise change management tools.
  • Experience supporting federal reporting systems or large-scale customer service operations.

Clearance

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to applicable government information and systems. This position requires a satisfactory USCIS Enter-on-Duty (EOD) determination prior to beginning work and the ability to obtain and maintain the required government suitability determination.

Compensation

JCTM is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. The anticipated compensation for this position will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, which may include the candidate’s relevant education, training, certifications, security clearance and access requirements, years and depth of relevant experience, specialized skills and qualifications, position level, assigned responsibilities, work location, applicable contract or customer requirements, internal equity, and the approved compensation budget for the position. Where required by applicable state or local law, JCTM will include the applicable good-faith salary or hourly pay range, along with any required information regarding benefits and other compensation, in the job posting.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

JCTM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
Remote | Full-Time | US Healthcare

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Client Intake & Operations Coordinator to join a growing US-based healthcare services team.

Our client provides therapy services to children and families, including Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) and related behavioural health services.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the client intake and onboarding process, coordinating everything from the initial referral through to the commencement of therapy services.

This is a hands-on coordination role that involves managing multiple onboarding cases, arranging insurance verification, coordinating therapists and BCBAs, supporting recruitment activities and ensuring all required documentation and follow-ups are completed.

You will work closely with families, therapists, billing partners and internal team members to ensure that every step of the onboarding process runs smoothly.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally organised, naturally proactive and comfortable managing multiple moving parts without needing constant supervision. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates what needs to happen next and ensures nothing falls through the cracks

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Intake & Onboarding

  • Manage the end-to-end intake and onboarding process for new child-therapy clients.
  • Coordinate new referrals and ensure all required intake steps are completed.
  • Track multiple active onboarding cases simultaneously, typically between 5–10 clients.
  • Coordinate insurance verification and follow up on outstanding information or approvals.
  • Monitor onboarding progress, deadlines, documentation and outstanding requirements.
  • Ensure smooth handovers between families, therapists, billing partners and internal teams.
  • Follow up consistently to ensure each client progresses towards starting services.

2. Therapist Sourcing & Coordination

  • Assist with identifying and sourcing suitable therapists and Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) for new clients.
  • Coordinate therapist availability and match providers to client requirements.
  • Create, publish and manage job advertisements on Indeed.
  • Use LinkedIn for candidate sourcing, outreach and recruitment activities.
  • Conduct initial candidate interviews and coordinate the therapist selection process.
  • Assist with therapist onboarding and ensure all relevant steps are completed.
  • Maintain communication with therapists throughout the onboarding and service delivery process.

3. Service Delivery & Documentation Follow-Up

  • Follow up with therapists to confirm that scheduled therapy sessions are taking place.
  • Monitor outstanding session notes and ensure documentation is completed and signed.
  • Identify delays, missing documentation or potential service delivery issues.
  • Communicate with therapists and relevant team members to resolve outstanding items.
  • Escalate concerns or operational challenges when necessary.

4. Billing & Insurance Coordination

  • Coordinate insurance verification as part of the client onboarding process.
  • Liaise with the external billing company regarding client-related requirements.
  • Follow up on outstanding billing information and documentation.
  • Ensure relevant client information is shared with the appropriate billing contacts.
  • Help maintain communication between the intake team, billing partners and service providers.

5. Administration & Operational Coordination

  • Maintain accurate intake trackers, records and onboarding documentation.
  • Keep deadlines, follow-ups, handovers and outstanding tasks organised.
  • Introduce new team members to the appropriate contacts and ensure communication channels are established.
  • Provide updates on client onboarding progress and potential bottlenecks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and keep workflows moving efficiently.
  • Step into additional operational and administrative responsibilities when required.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience in healthcare administration, client onboarding, intake coordination, case management, operations coordination or a similar role.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple clients, projects or workflows simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Confident communicating with clients, healthcare professionals and internal teams.
  • Experience coordinating appointments, service providers, documentation or onboarding processes.
  • Strong follow-up and task management abilities.
  • Good computer literacy and confidence working with multiple systems.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.

Advantageous Experience

  • Previous experience in ABA, behavioural health or child-therapy services.
  • Experience coordinating patient or client intake processes.
  • Exposure to insurance verification and healthcare billing coordination.
  • Experience sourcing or recruiting healthcare professionals.
  • Experience interviewing and onboarding therapists or clinical staff.
  • Familiarity with Indeed and LinkedIn recruitment tools.
  • Experience coordinating with external billing companies.
  • Previous experience working with US-based healthcare providers.

Essential Skills & Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Exceptionally organised: Naturally uses trackers, lists, calendars and systems to keep everything in order.
  • Proactive: Anticipates what needs to happen next and follows up without waiting for reminders.
  • Accountable: Takes ownership of tasks and sees them through to completion.
  • Detail-oriented: Carefully checks information, documentation and deadlines.
  • Independent: Comfortable working remotely with a high degree of trust and minimal supervision.
  • A strong communicator: Professional, confident and comfortable communicating via email, WhatsApp, phone and video calls.
  • Resourceful: Able to think independently, solve problems and manage unexpected challenges.
  • Flexible: Willing to assist with broader operational responsibilities when needed.
  • Patient and compassionate: Has a genuine interest in supporting children, families and therapy services.

Working Hours & Availability

  • Full-time remote position.
  • Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST/EDT as applicable).
  • Must be available to assist with urgent operational matters over weekends when necessary.
  • Follows Jewish holidays rather than standard US public holiday arrangements.

What Success Looks Like

  • New clients move efficiently through the intake and onboarding process.
  • Multiple active cases are tracked accurately without missed deadlines or follow-ups.
  • Insurance verification and billing coordination are completed timeously.
  • Suitable therapists are identified, interviewed and onboarded as required.
  • Therapists are held accountable for session completion and documentation.
  • Families, therapists and internal stakeholders receive timely communication.
  • The overall operation runs smoothly without requiring constant management intervention.

We are looking for someone who naturally takes charge, enjoys bringing structure to busy environments and genuinely cares about delivering a high-quality experience for families and healthcare professionals.

raw.description:
UFG is currently seeking a Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting - GAAP who is responsible for supporting the preparation, analysis, and reporting of the Company's quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, SEC filings, and related financial reporting deliverables. This role ensures the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), SEC reporting requirements, and company policies.

Working closely with Financial Reporting leadership, Financial Accounting, Investments, FP&A, Actuarial, and other Finance teams, the Senior Accountant supports the preparation of financial statement disclosures, supporting schedules, SEC filings, and investment-related reporting. This position also assists with financial analysis, internal controls, process improvement initiatives, and audit support activities. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong financial reporting skills, attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting - GAAP

  • Prepare and support the review of quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, SEC filings (including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K), financial statement disclosures, supporting schedules, and related reporting documentation, ensuring compliance with generally accepted accounting principles and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Analyze financial results, balances, and trends and investigate unusual fluctuations or reporting variances.
  • Support investment accounting and reporting activities, including preparation of investment-related schedules, analyses, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Assist with implementation of new accounting standards, accounting policies, and reporting requirements.
  • Prepare select journal entries and account reconciliations related to assigned financial reporting responsibilities.
  • Prepare documentation supporting financial reporting conclusions and disclosure requirements.
  • Maintain current knowledge of financial reporting requirements, SEC developments, industry trends, and best practices.

Governance & Controls

  • Maintain SOX-compliant documentation, ensuring adherence to company policies and internal control requirements.
  • Assist with audit requests, including internal controls and testing evidence.

Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing processes, standardizing reporting, and automating data flow.
  • Mentor other team members by sharing knowledge and modeling best practices in accounting and financial reporting.
  • Support system enhancements and testing related to accounting or financial reporting applications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including operations and IT to support finance transformation initiatives designed to modernize systems and standardize financial processes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the finance department and company goals.

Job Specifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or progress toward certification preferred
  • Master’s degree in accounting or MBA preferred

Experience:

  • 5 years of financial reporting or insurance accounting experience.
  • Prior experience within property and casualty insurance preferred.
  • Experience preparing or supporting GAAP financial statements and related disclosures.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong understanding of generally accepted accounting principles and financial statement presentation requirements.
  • Knowledge of SEC reporting requirements and disclosure practices preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to accuracy and detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, complex formulas).
  • Experience with financial systems and subledgers desirable.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team setting.
  • Process improvement mindset with ability to identify and implement efficiency enhancements.
  • Critical thinking skills and sound professional judgment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Working Conditions:

  • General office environment
  • Travel Requirements: Infrequent travel, only as needed

UFG Insurance is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this position is $71,598 - $94,396 annually, which represents the typical range for new hires in this role. Individual pay within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, internal equity, geography and market data.

In addition to base salary, UFG Insurance offers a comprehensive total rewards package that includes:

  • Annual incentive compensation
  • Medical, dental, vision & life insurance
  • Accident, critical Illness & short-term disability insurance
  • Retirement plans with employer contributions
  • Generous time-off program
  • Programs designed to support the employee well-being and financial security.

About Us

At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.

We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.

At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, Customer Success Manager to serve as a trusted advisor and central point of contact for key enterprise customers. This role is responsible for coordinating internal resources, managing customer deliverables, mitigating project risks, and ensuring successful implementation and ongoing value realization from Versa solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong project and relationship management skills with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders in complex federal environments. You will work across a highly matrixed organization, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Engineering, Professional Services, and other internal teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience and identify opportunities for continued growth.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate internal resources to meet customer deliverables on time.
  • Coordinate management of Versa work to ensure completion of deliverables.
  • Develop and manage project plans to highlight status on key deliverables, and risks
  • Work with Versa stakeholders to ensure customer deliverables are correctly tracked
  • Work closely with internal Versa resources, including Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Engineering, and Professional Services, to ensure the customer’s highest level of satisfaction with Versa solutions.
  • Provide guidance and recommendations to the Customer to maximize the value of Versa solutions
  • Create opportunities for revenue growth – upselling and cross selling.
  • Produces internal and customer facing reports on a monthly, quarterly and ad hoc basis to keep the customer and Versa stakeholders informed.
  • Engage the appropriate internal resources to ensure project implementation and enhancements are successful.
  • Document and lead all customer engagement information – including updates on critical contacts, statuses, next steps, and related items.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years-experience in a similar role (Customer Success, Account Management, Project Manager)
  • Experience directing and managing deliverables for a complex customer project in a customer facing role
  • Evidence of establishing and maintaining exceptional client relationships that fuel growth
  • Strong organization skills
  • You will need to be:
    • Confident communicator; friendly, enthusiastic, comfortable talking to stakeholders of all levels via the phone, email, or in person.
    • Comfortable working in a highly matrixed environment
    • US Citizen

Location:

*Applicants must be authorized to work in the US

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment in California, Washington, or New York City is expected in the range of $160,000 to $210,000. A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Benefits

Why Versa?

At Versa Networks, we believe in taking care of our people – both professionally and personally. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being, growth, and work-life balance of our employees. When you join our team, you can expect:

  • Competitive Salary & Incentives: We offer a competitive compensation package with and pre-IPO equity to reward your hard work and dedication.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to ensure you and your family stay healthy and covered.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Enjoy a generous PTO policy that includes vacation days, sick leave, and paid holidays to recharge and take care of personal matters.
  • Flexible Work Environment: We understand the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work, and hybrid option to create the work schedule that works best for you.
  • Professional Development: We believe in continuous learning. Access to training, certifications, and educational resources to help you grow in your career and stay ahead of industry trends.
  • Employee Recognition: We celebrate achievements both big and small, with regular recognition programs and awards that highlight your contributions to our collective success.
  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a dynamic, inclusive, and supportive team where innovation and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.
  • Parental Leave: Generous parental leave policies to support you during life's important moments.

At Versa Networks, our benefits are designed to help you thrive both inside and outside the office. Join us and experience a rewarding, fulfilling career in a supportive environment that values your health, happiness, and success.

Versa Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Standard Job Description

Join the Lockheed Martin Production Operations One Lockheed Martin Transformation (1LMX) Plan to Stock (PTS) Information Technology (IT) team as an IT Business Analyst (ITBA) supporting the Integrated Manufacturing Master Data (IMMD) function within our SAP S/4HANA environment. This position plays a key role in designing, configuring, and supporting master data processes that enable production operations across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine deep SAP functional knowledge with hands-on technical and integration experience to deliver accurate, standardized master data across systems and value streams.

This role bridges business process understanding with system realization across key modules — Material Management (MM), Product Lifecycle Management System Integration (PLMSI), Master Data Governance (MDG), and Production Engineering and Operations (PEO) — to ensure data integrity, alignment, and usability for manufacturing and logistics execution.

This position can be based at any Lockheed Martin location or performed fully remotely.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and design integrated master data processes that support manufacturing, procurement, and production operations.
  • Lead and coordinate design discussions across Production Operations and technical teams to align master data requirements and governance standards.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA modules (MM, PLMSI, MDG, and PEO) to support consistent and accurate master data creation, maintenance, and usage.
  • Author and maintain functional specifications for enhancements, integrations, and data governance automation.
  • Collaborate closely with ABAP developers and technical architects to standardize and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Support data migration, validation, and conversion activities during system cutovers and production transitions.
  • Develop and coordinate documentation, testing procedures, and end-user training for master data management processes.
  • Recommend and implement S/4HANA innovations and process improvements related to master data across the production value stream.
  • Utilize Jira and SAP Focused Build to manage requirements, design deliverables, and project workflows.

Basic Qualifications

· Significant experience with SAP S/4HANA in one or more of the following areas: Material Management (MM), Product Lifecycle Management System Integration (PLMSI), Master Data Governance (MDG), or Production Engineering and Operations (PEO)

· Experience designing and supporting integrated master data processes across manufacturing and production environments

· Experience authoring functional specifications based on business requirements and translating them into technical design deliverables

· Experience collaborating with ABAP developers to design, standardize, and implement customized functional solutions

· Proven ability to analyze large data sets, identify data quality issues, and facilitate data-driven decisions

· Experience defining or supporting governance structures and validation rules for master data objects

· Ability to apply functional SAP knowledge to improve operational efficiency and standardization across production operations

· Experience supporting full system lifecycle activities, including gap analysis, requirements gathering, blueprinting, development, testing, and post go-live support

· Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills involving the integration of multiple IT systems

· Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to converse fluently between technical and functional audiences

· U.S. Citizenship required, as this role supports systems related to national defense

Desired Skills

· Hands-on configuration and support experience with SAP S/4HANA modules:

  • Material Management (MM)
  • Product Lifecycle Management System Integration (PLMSI)
  • Master Data Governance (MDG)
  • Production Engineering and Operations (PEO)

· Strong understanding of master data objects (materials, bills of material, routings, work centers, production versions) and their integration across manufacturing systems

· Experience designing and maintaining governance and validation rules for manufacturing master data

· Familiarity with data migration, conversion tools, and integration testing processes

· Experience using Jira and SAP Focused Build to manage requirements, test cases, and project workflows

· Ability to independently drive requirements gathering, solution design, and cross-functional alignment across business and technical teams

· Experience with Agile or hybrid delivery models in a large-scale ERP environment

· Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Accounts Administrator to provide full-time bookkeeping and financial administration support across multiple entities and client accounts.

This role is suited to someone who is confident managing reconciliations, invoices, financial records, and day-to-day accounting administration with limited supervision. You will work with both internal stakeholders and clients, taking ownership of routine accounting activities while ensuring financial information remains accurate, organised, and up to date.

The position requires strong attention to detail, confidence communicating with clients, and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a structured and professional manner.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience in bookkeeping, accounts administration, or a related finance role, ideally with approximately 3 to 5 years of practical experience.
  • Strong practical experience completing bank and account reconciliations independently.
  • Experience managing bookkeeping activities across multiple entities, accounts, or clients.
  • Proficiency with Xero or similar cloud-based accounting software.
  • Experience processing invoices, payments, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Support accounts payable and accounts receivable activities, including monitoring outstanding items and following up where appropriate.

  • Assist with month-end accounting activities and ensure relevant reconciliations and records are completed accurately and on time.

Benefits

Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.

Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.

The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.

  4. Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role.

  7. Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you’ll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.

Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.

This position is fully remote. All applicants must live and work in the United States.

TAG is seeking passionate, talented Lead CMS Developer to lead our Drupal projects and help deliver outstanding digital experiences to our clients. This is not a traditional lead role. At TAG, development is powered by our in-house, Claude-based software factory: autonomous development agents that take well-defined tickets from spec to pull request. As Lead Developer, you are the technical lead on your projects and the person responsible for those agents. You define the requirements with the client, direct the work, verify everything the agents produce, step in when they get it wrong, and ship the releases yourself. You are the most important quality checkpoint in our process. You will work on exciting projects using open-source technologies for some of the world's largest brands, in a fast-paced environment where several projects are in play at once. Becoming a TAG team member is an opportunity to grow and achieve, while working with a highly collaborative and diversely skilled team.

As a Lead CMS Developer at TAG you will...

  • Serve as the technical lead and primary technical point of contact on your CMS projects, primarily Drupal
  • Work directly with clients and project managers to gather requirements and translate them into clear specifications, acceptance criteria and development tickets
  • Own the architecture and technical direction of your projects: content modeling, module selection, integrations, performance, hosting and infrastructure
  • Direct and manage TAG's autonomous development agents using our Claude-based processes and tooling, and keep them productive and unblocked
  • Review and verify everything the agents produce against requirements and TAG standards; you are the final quality checkpoint before work reaches QA and the client
  • Troubleshoot and intervene when agents fail to meet requirements: diagnose why, correct the spec or the approach, and write the code yourself when that is the right call
  • Perform code releases and manage release cycles. Releases at TAG are done by people, never by AI.
  • Estimate the level of effort required to complete development work
  • Contribute to improving our development automation, specs and agent workflows based on what you learn on your projects

You might be who we are looking for if...

  • You have 6+ years' overall engineering experience, including 2-3+ years as the lead or senior developer on large projects
  • You have 5+ years of deep Drupal experience and in-depth knowledge of modern CMS architectural standards
  • You have experience in a development role at a digital agency
  • You have used AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Devin or similar) to do real project work, and you have opinions about where they excel and where they fail
  • You are comfortable owning the quality of code you did not write, and you know how to verify it rather than trust it
  • You are a creative problem solver who is energized by diagnosing why something did not work and finding a better path
  • You have Headless CMS experience and experience with JavaScript frameworks and libraries like React and Next.js
  • You have 2-3+ years' experience with:
    • Working with clients to turn business requirements into technical specifications
    • Agile methodology and working closely with project managers to plan sprints, flesh out tickets and organize releases
    • Laying out technical documentation both for the internal team and client handoff
    • Code reviews, continuous integration and production releases on platforms like Acquia or Pantheon
  • You have a strong command of Git processes and have experience with Git Flow
  • You are smart and like to get sh*t done.
  • You don't mind talking to people.
  • You are a team player.
  • You live and breathe best practices.

Benefits and Perks

  • 100% employer paid health, vision and dental insurance
  • Life and short-term disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • Family First PTO Bank
  • Up to 100% remote / telecommute
  • Flex Fridays
  • Paid vacation
  • 401k with up to 4% match
  • Charitable matches and/or community service hours
  • End of year merit-based bonuses
  • Annual company retreat with absolutely no trust falls
  • Company culture events such as trivia and team lunches
  • Professional development budget

About Third and Grove

Third and Grove is a fully remote full-service digital agency. Our vision is to use technology and design to make the web worth browsing. We want to leave the web better than we found it. TAG team members strive to embody our core values, leading with empathy and practicing accountability, excellence, integrity and curiosity -in everything we do.

Diversity Statement: Third and Grove’s vision is to leave the web better than we found it. Our diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives play a significant role in that. As an equal opportunity employer, we are working to ensure we both grow and maintain a team of individuals from varying backgrounds and perspectives. People are at the center of everything we do, and we want to encourage our staff to bring their authentic selves to work, so that we can learn from each other and better serve our clients, our communities, and the world.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
raw.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

The Maximum Impact Incubator (MII) aims to utilize econometrics and epidemiology to incubate programs across CHAI's entire portfolio that generate significant health impact through highly cost-effective programming. The Maximum Impact Incubator team has the exciting and challenging aim of working with CHAI’s country and program teams to develop the most cost-effective and scalable opportunities for new programs aligned with the Effective Altruism (EA) philosophy of maximizing the benefit of available resources.

As a Senior Program Manager on the MII team, you will play a key role in ensuring the programs graduated from the incubator run smoothly and deliver on agreed implementation, research, and learning objectives, including supporting program launch, implementation, coordination, and donor management. After the MII team completes its investigation of new programs, which includes assessing a program’s cost-effectiveness, potential research objectives and learning objectives, and programs receive grant funding from EA-aligned donors, these programs “graduate” from the incubator. During the implementation phase, graduated grants are owned and implemented by the relevant CHAI program and country team (e.g., a program delivering Zinc/ORS to treat childhood diarrhoea in Nigeria would be owned by CHAI’s Child Health and Nigeria teams during implementation); the incubator’s role is to manage the donor relationship and to serve as the institutional memory of the original vision that was agreed between the donor, MII and the program and country teams during the MII-led investigation.

The Senior Program Manager will be the steward of that intent: (1) supporting the handover and launch of newly graduating projects to the implementation teams, (2) ensuring implementing teams have a shared understanding of the cost-effectiveness evidence base of the program, delivery expectations and the tools needed to track delivery, (3) providing a critical technical advisory role to teams on the appropriate monitoring processes, study designs and research concepts to address questions in the donor’s monitoring and learning frameworks and to conduct impact evaluations or other evaluation methods required by the donor, and (4) monitoring implementation to ensure it remains aligned with the original concept, and acting as a bridge between implementation reality and grant commitments, flagging early if work plans shift, and keeping the donor accurately and proactively informed.

This role may require ~20% travel internationally and domestically. The Senior Program Manager is expected to have a reasonable ability to travel.

Responsibilities

Preparing and transitioning newly graduated projects (15%)

  • Before a project graduates, confirm that MII, program and country teams and donors are fully aligned on the concept and delivery expectations, and teams are ready to deliver so that any gaps are resolved before implementation
  • Ensure the implementing team has a strong understanding of the back-of-the-envelope calculation (BOTEC) cost-effectiveness model and the evidence behind it
  • Support the transition of newly graduated projects from investigation to implementation, including co-leading internal project kickoff (roles and responsibilities, work plan, budget, and M&E plan)
  • Work with the implementing team ahead of graduation to make sure the BOTEC, budget, and work plan are aligned, and that key risks and government dependencies are identified up front
  • Contribute to developing and testing MII SOPs, tools, and templates for launching and supporting graduated projects, including clear roles and responsibilities between MII, program and country teams
  • Support implementing teams to set up monitoring and evaluation processes as to address donor’s monitoring and learning frameworks and conduct impact evaluations or other evaluation methods required by the donor

Donor management and stewardship of graduated projects (85%)

  • Once projects have graduated, coordinate donor requests and internal workstreams on graduated programs, including but not limited to deliverable reviews, preparations for and follow up from meetings including documenting key decisions and requests from the donor, and contract reviews, serving as a quality check to ensure they are accurate, clear, consistent with one another (e.g., BOTEC, budget, and work plan), faithful to what was agreed, and acting as the primary point of contact between the donor and the implementing teams
  • Set up the systems and serve as the institutional memory for each graduated grant:
    • Maintain a clear record of what the donor funded and why (concept, BOTEC assumptions, key commitments, and decisions made along the way)
    • Bring that context to implementing teams, particularly through staff transitions
  • Convene a regular coordination forum that brings together MII, global program, and country teams
  • Track progress against the workplan, budget, and critical milestones agreed with the donor, compare implementation with the original design and donor expectations, and raise discrepancies, delays, or changes to the agreed design promptly with program leadership so they can be resolved and communicated to the donor in a timely way
  • Track implementation dependencies outside CHAI’s control (e.g., national or global guideline changes, government endorsement of new products, subnational approvals) against check-in milestones, and ensure the donor is proactively updated when key assumptions change
  • Advise on technical aspects of graduated programs, particularly impact evaluations and other research and learning processes, in collaboration with CHAI’s Analytics and Implementation Research (AIR) team

Qualifications

  • Masters or higher degree in economics, public health, epidemiology, nursing, or a related field
  • Minimum of eight years work experience in global health or related fields, including significant experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs or donor portfolios
  • Experience managing or coordinating the implementation of multi-stakeholder projects in resource constrained environments, including work plans, budgets, and milestone tracking
  • Experience and knowledge with quantitative research techniques
  • Experience working with and analysing large surveys and administrative datasets
  • Experience in designing and implementing impact evaluations including randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental methods
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex quantitative findings to diverse audiences; proficiency in one or more languages spoken in CHAI countries is a plus
  • Experience collaborating on a wide variety of programs and/or working with partners (government or non-profit) in at least one CHAI program country
  • Demonstrated ability to manage senior internal and external stakeholder relationships, including influencing program and country leadership without direct authority

Advantages

  • Experience conducting cost-effectiveness research in key health areas, such as maternal and child health, nutrition, neglected tropical diseases (NTDs), or infectious diseases
  • Direct experience collaborating with donors in the global health and development space
  • Project management training or experience setting up project management tools and processes for a program or portfolio
  • Familiarity with cost-effectiveness analysis and the evidence standards used by cost-effectiveness focused funders
  • Experience supporting program implementation alongside government or country teams in high-burden settings

Attributes

We are seeking exceptional and highly motivated individuals with a desire to maximize global health outcomes. An ideal candidate will be described as:

  • Effective leader – You are able to drive work forward across teams you do not own or manage, influencing without formal authority and keeping colleagues aligned with agreed plans and timelines while building trust. Where you manage others, you find a balance between delegation and control, giving more junior team members opportunities to learn and grow whilst ensuring high-quality team output
  • Insightful – You draw cogent conclusions from large amounts of analysis, sharing what is relevant for real-world challenges the Incubator team is trying to address
  • Practical – You demonstrate judgment in how you allocate your efforts when balancing multiple priorities, focusing on the most decision-critical aspects, and dynamically changing these priorities in response to changing circumstances
  • Communicative – You can respectfully and effectively navigate varied and sensitive stakeholder environments, including in-country teams to senior donor executives, and you are comfortable giving direct, constructive feedback and escalating concerns through the right channels
  • Rigorous – You take pride in your work and have high standards for what you produce, creating analysis that can stand up to the scrutiny of internal and external parties. You have meticulous attention to detail and make sure materials are accurate and internally consistent
  • Transparent and proactive – You raise problems early and openly, even when the news is uncomfortable, bring a sense of urgency when a project needs attention, and help create an environment where others feel safe doing the same

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute to the launch, donor management, and implementation of large programs. You will have the chance to work across CHAI’s diverse health programs, interact with policymakers, and directly influence how resources are allocated to save lives at scale.

There is no ‘perfect’ candidate for this role. We are seeking dedicated and passionate individuals who want to make a difference in global health outcomes. If you have a passion for evidence-driven decision-making, a strong background in quantitative methods, and an eagerness to engage with CHAI’s country programs to drive impact, we encourage you to apply.

raw.description:
About The Team

Snow Commerce is a leading provider of eCommerce strategy, design, and digital marketing, helping some of the world’s most exciting brands succeed online. Our partners include Paramount, Netflix, Bauerfeind, NBCUniversal, Warner Bros., and more. Learn more at .

About The Role

The role is hybrid in Cincinnati, OH or Remote in the US Eastern Time Zone.

As the Data and BI Lead at Snow Commerce (part of the FYUL family), you will lead our Business Intelligence vision and data infrastructure to empower high-impact commercial and operational decision-making across our e-commerce platforms. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Experiences, you will serve as both a strategic leader and hands-on data architect scaling our cloud data warehouse, establishing rigorous data governance (including strict financial data accuracy), and translating complex metrics into actionable executive insights. If you thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment where data directly shapes customer experiences and business growth, this role offers the autonomy to build, innovate, and make an immediate enterprise-wide impact.

Your Daily Tasks Will Entail:

  • Architect & Scale Modern Data Infrastructure:Design, optimize, and maintain high-performance cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) and robust ETL/ELT pipelines to unify multi-channel e-commerce, CRM, and operational datasets.

  • Lead Enterprise Reporting & Dashboards:Plan, deliver, and maintain intuitive, scalable BI dashboards and visual models (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for executive leadership, client-facing teams, and departmental leads.

  • Champion Financial & Operational Data Integrity:Establish and execute rigorous audit protocols to guarantee 100% accuracy in financial reporting, revenue modeling, and commercial KPIs.

  • Translate Data into Commercial Strategy:Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Client Strategy to extract predictive insights, identify growth levers, and deliver compelling data storytelling.

  • Cultivate BI Team & Best Practices:Provide hands-on mentorship, code reviews, and structured project management for analytics initiatives, fostering a high-velocity, continuous-learning culture.

  • Drive Data Governance & Security:Oversee enterprise data governance, access controls, compliance, and strict confidentiality protocols to safeguard intellectual property and sensitive client data.

Your Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Finance or a related quantitative field, paired with 5+ years of progressive data analytics/BI experience (including 2+ years leading projects or teams).

  • Ecommerce Experience:Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and other similar sales and behavior channels are preferred.

  • Advanced SQL & Data Warehousing Mastery:Fluent, expert-level SQL capability with demonstrated hands-on experience structuring, modeling, and optimizing enterprise data in BigQuery or Snowflake environments.

  • Scripting & API Integration Skills:Proficient in Python or R for data pipeline scripting, automation, statistical modeling, and ingesting data through third-party APIs (e.g., e-commerce, marketing platforms).

  • Data Storytelling & Financial Literacy:Proven ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear executive summaries, with strong business acumen and experience auditing financial data and e-commerce metrics.

  • Scrappy & Entrepreneurial Mindset:A self-starter who excels at balancing high-level architectural strategy with roll-up-your-sleeves execution in dynamic, growth-oriented environments.

  • Cross-Functional Communication:Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a track record of building trusted partnerships across technical and executive non-technical stakeholders alike.

What we offer:

  • Energetic, collaborative work environment in Over-the-Rhine

  • Competitive pay and benefits: health, dental, vision, and life insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401k with company match

  • Personal and professional development opportunities

  • A fast-paced eCommerce retail environment where you can learn and grow while working with major brands


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

Snow Commerce is a leading provider of eCommerce strategy, design, and digital marketing, helping some of the world’s most exciting brands succeed online. Our partners include Paramount, Netflix, Bauerfeind, NBCUniversal, Warner Bros., and more. Learn more at .

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!
