raw.title: Gestionnaire de la performance des affaires (Business Performance Manager)
raw.excerpt: Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada.
raw.description:
Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque
nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous
Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.
Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.
Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto
Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.
Pour en savoir plus:
vie chez nesto
Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.
Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

À propos du poste
À titre de gestionnaire de la performance des affaires (Business Performance Manager), vous prenez en charge le rendement opérationnel et la rentabilité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Vous êtes imputable de l'efficacité avec laquelle nous transformons nos dépenses de marketing, nos prospects (leads) et notre portefeuille de clients actuel en revenu net, ainsi que du maintien de ce rendement à un niveau élevé et prévisible.

L'an prochain, cela représente un portefeuille de renouvellements de 2 milliards de dollars et 1 milliard de dollars en origination directe au consommateur (D2C). Vous disposerez des leviers, des données et des relations interfonctionnelles nécessaires pour faire progresser ces deux volets. Ce poste est idéal pour une personne qui voit une entreprise comme un système de leviers : vous savez lesquels existent, comment ils interagissent et comment en créer de nouveaux lorsque ceux en place ne suffisent plus.

Vos responsabilités

  • Prendre en charge le rendement opérationnel et la rentabilité en stimulant la conversion, le revenu net et la productivité, du haut de l'entonnoir jusqu'au portefeuille de renouvellements, en planifiant et en prévoyant les résultats par rapport aux cibles, et en apportant des ajustements en temps réel lorsque les résultats s'écartent du plan.
  • Gérer le haut de l'entonnoir en contrôlant le volume, la qualité et le coût des prospects, du premier point de contact jusqu'à la qualification, en décidant où investir le prochain dollar de marketing et en réduisant les dépenses lorsque les rendements sont insuffisants.
  • Repérer et colmater les brèches en analysant l'état des résultats (P&L) et les données de l'entonnoir pour identifier les baisses de conversion, de productivité ou les dérapages de coûts, et y remédier en collaboration avec les équipes interfonctionnelles.
  • Gérer le portefeuille de renouvellements en assumant la responsabilité de son rendement et des opportunités potentielles à mi-terme, en l'exploitant pour des refinancements, des marges de crédit hypothécaire (MCH) et d'autres événements générateurs de revenus, et en bâtissant des pipelines pour les concrétiser.
  • Équilibrer l'offre et la demande en temps réel en surveillant le volume de prospects par rapport à la capacité des conseillers et des représentants en développement des ventes (SDR), et en agissant en conséquence, par exemple en lançant des envois massifs de SMS, en ajustant la durée de qualification des SDR ou en contactant proactivement les conseillers pour modifier leur statut.
  • Concevoir et actionner des leviers avec les intervenants fonctionnels, en assurant un leadership horizontal basé sur les données à travers le marketing, les chefs d'équipe des ventes et la technologie pour orienter l'acheminement et les décisions tactiques, telles que les modifications de taux et la réponse concurrentielle.
  • Traduire les besoins d'affaires en solutions technologiques en rédigeant des requêtes (tickets) claires, en spécifiant les flux de travail et les automatisations, en collaborant avec les développeurs pour les déployer, et en configurant Five9 et Salesforce avec notre architecte Five9 pour améliorer le temps de réponse aux prospects (speed to lead) et l'expérience des agents, tout en développant de nouveaux processus grâce à la technologie et à l'IA lorsque nécessaire.
  • Bâtir la visibilité sur laquelle repose l'entreprise en travaillant avec l'équipe des données sur les tableaux de bord et les rythmes opérationnels afin que les gestionnaires se basent sur les mêmes chiffres, et diriger des initiatives interfonctionnelles telles que les travaux sur la rentabilité des partenaires externes.

Indicateurs de performance clés (IPC) dont vous serez responsable

  • Conversion, revenu net et rentabilité
  • Dépenses marketing et efficacité de la main-d'œuvre
  • Métriques de l'entonnoir
  • Disponibilité et productivité des conseillers (% du temps en appel + prêt)
  • Conception des métriques de rendement
  • Soumissions et pourcentage de prospects convertis en soumissions (Lead to submission %)
  • Tentatives et connexions par client
  • Rétention des renouvellements et revenus générés par le portefeuille

Ce que vous apportez

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience dans les opérations de marché, les technologies financières (Fintech) ou le secteur hypothécaire/des prêts, ou 2 à 4 ans en consultation.
  • Capacités analytiques exceptionnelles : solide maîtrise de SQL et des outils d'intelligence d'affaires (Tableau ou équivalent), et capacité à relier les activités du haut de l'entonnoir au financement final et au revenu net.
  • Compréhension approfondie des moteurs de revenus et de dépenses dans une entreprise de prêts.
  • Maîtrise des piles technologiques modernes (CRM, composeur automatique, outils de données), avec la capacité de définir les besoins et de faire développer des requêtes (tickets) par l'équipe de développement.
  • Réflexion systémique : vous comprenez comment la modification d'un levier affecte le reste du système.
  • Solides compétences en communication et capacité à rallier et diriger des pairs et des gestionnaires sans autorité directe.
  • Aisance dans un environnement à forte croissance où l'IA et l'automatisation de la téléphonie évoluent rapidement.

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici

Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.
Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.
Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

raw.title: Senior Financial Analyst
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to partner with our R&D organization. Samsara's R&D organization creates the industry-leading IoT products and features that power our customer experience. You will partner with our engineering leaders, driving quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify cost optimization opportunities. You will help build the reporting and attribution frameworks needed to track and govern AI spend, support month-end close procedures, and drive forecast models that give our leaders and investors accurate guidance. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner closely with leaders across our Software and Firmware Engineering teams to manage Headcount, Software and AI vendor spend.
  • Analyze financial results, prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting, and support financial review meetings with R&D and Finance leadership.
  • Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities, cost classification, and reporting requests.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to drive AOP planning.
  • Improve the accuracy and scalability of existing financial reporting and forecasting models.
  • Develop new mechanisms, analysis, or KPIs to inspect business performance.
  • Leverage AI tools to streamline financial reporting, forecasting, and ad hoc analysis workflows.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A/Strategic Finance/Big 4 Accounting/Investment Banking.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • High aptitude and enthusiasm for complex problem solving utilizing financial modeling and analysis, including advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience at a high-growth tech company.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally in a fast-paced, often changing environment.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to senior management.
  • Proactive and highly organized self-starter, able to work independently under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with Headcount & SaaS cost modeling and management.
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Glean, Cursor, etc.), Databricks, and FP&A tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar planning systems) and NetSuite.
  • Prior partnership with software engineering teams.
  • Passion for building new models, processes, and mechanisms.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$81,600—$105,600 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Cambridge Design Partnership is an employee-owned product and innovation consultancy operating internationally with offices in the UK (Cambridge) and US (North Carolina). Our scientists, engineers, designers and commercial teams work together to solve complex problems for leading businesses across Healthcare and Life Science markets.

We are seeking an experienced Key Account Manager to manage and grow our strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences client accounts across the UK and Europe. You will engage client companies that require an external engineering partner to accelerate new product development from concept through commercialization.

The work we do for clients includes the development of new products, technical innovation, and engineering consulting. Our clients are market leaders across Healthcare and Life Sciences.

This is a senior role, responsible for the commercial growth, strategic development and long-term value of key accounts. You will direct the account strategy, and act as trusted partner to your clients, understanding their challenges and connecting them with CDP's technical expertise. The role demands a proactive, growth mindset with a focus on long-term client partnership over transactional sales.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify and progress qualified opportunities for new project activity, working with CDP's technical teams to develop proposals and secure business.
  • Expand relationships up and across the client organisations to reduce single-thread risk

Requirements

  • Ability to understand complex technical challenges and work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to develop new opportunities.
  • Strong commercial understanding, including pricing, negotiations, pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Willingness to travel across the UK and Europe.

Benefits

Cambridge Design Partnership (CDP) is an end-to-end innovation partner, propelling global brands and ambitious start-ups to success. We build breakthrough products and services – from insight to ideas, prototypes to production – bringing innovation to life. Our teams are multi-disciplinary, uniting scientific rigor, design ingenuity, and engineering excellence for consumer and healthcare clients. People-centred, deeply collaborative, and – above all – expert, we’re uniquely positioned to shape the future for consumers, patients, and industry. Even our ownership model is innovative: We’re 100% owned by our employees, ensuring an open culture and a total commitment to our projects’ success. As part of our benefits package, we offer:

  • flexible working
  • a discretionary bonus
  • excellent learning and development opportunities
  • a 12% non-contributory pension
  • private healthcare
  • electric vehicle lease salary sacrifice scheme
  • share incentive plan
  • 33 days holiday inclusive of bank holidays

Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.

Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.

¿Qué es lo que valoramos?

Experiencia de al menos 3 años como Desarrollador Front End con React Native:

  • Experiencia trabajando con React Native para el desarrollo de aplicaciones.

• Nivel alto de inglés.

  • Experiencia en la creación de soluciones de entretenimiento, tanto en aplicaciones con gran volumen de usuarios como en herramientas internas para optimizar el desarrollo.
  • Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con clientes y equipos multidisciplinarios.

¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?

  • Desarrollo de aplicaciones SmartTV: Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar aplicaciones para entornos SmartTV, asegurando experiencias fluidas y de alta calidad en diferentes dispositivos.

  • Colaboración Multidisciplinaria: Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de producto, diseño y desarrollo para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras y alineadas con las necesidades del negocio.
  • Colaborar en el desarrollo de Soluciones Low-Code/No-Code: Crear y gestionar soluciones innovadoras utilizando la PowerPlatform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse), adaptadas a las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

Nos encantaría si además te manejases bien con Inglés.

Además, valoraremos muy positivamente si tienes experiencia y/o conocimientos en:

  • Experiencia trabajando con Shaka Player u otros reproductores de vídeo en JavaScript.
  • Conocimientos en optimización de streaming y reproducción multimedia.
  • Experiencia en entornos ágiles de desarrollo.

raw.description:
Accelerate possibilities. The WSP Data Center CoE (Center of Excellence) is growing, and we’re looking for smart, responsive, collaborative people to join us. Our CoE is 100% focused on data centers—supporting the world’s leading AI and cloud infrastructure companies. You’ll work to help tackle our clients’ biggest challenges: Where to build? How to secure power and water? How to develop responsibly and become a valued part of the community? AI is transforming life from scientific discoveries to smarter transportation and more sustainable communities. Data centers make it possible.

With us, you can build impact, deliver remarkable projects, and grow your career while shaping the future of the data center industry.

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Data Center ICT/Telecom Designer, Senior Conusltant to sit in any of our kW offices or work remotely. As a Telecommunications Designer with us, you will design Outside Plant Pathways and other building systems including MMR/IDF layouts, Cable Tray layouts, Wireless Access Point layouts, and structured Cabling infrastructure layout to support the Controls Network

Your Impact

  • Work independently to perform a variety of BIM/CAD design assignments supporting multiple engineering disciplines
  • Produce accurate 2D drawings, 3D BIM Models using Revit or equivalent BIM program
  • Design low voltage systems for buildings including telecommunications systems, audio visual, security, and electrical/mechanical control integrations
  • Meet required schedules while producing quality work
  • Perform Quality Assurance/Quality Control of design packages
  • Perform design tasks for site and building technologies including telecommunications systems, audio visual, security, and control integrations
  • Independently support the team during design and construction stages of projects
  • Research & recommend fundamental components identified in designs
  • Develop equipment, conveyance and device layouts, floor plan, and riser diagrams
  • Prepare cable schedules and specifications
  • Perform construction administrations tasks
  • Survey and evaluate existing conditions
  • Work within multi-discipline project teams to develop drawing and specification documents for issuance to architects, contractors and building owners
  • Demonstrate significant understanding of the range of services provided by the kW MCE engineering and design teams & related practices
  • Implement best practice procedures
  • Integrate project requirements into mission critical facility designs
  • Attend and represent the Telecom discipline in internal and client facing meetings
  • Lead Telecom design team on projects
  • Mentor and lead junior designers

Who You Are

The ideal candidate is highly experienced in Revit and AutoCAD and has experience in information and communications technology. Strong communication skills, and an interest in liaising with internal and external design, client and construction team members are also necessary.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of experience designing low voltage systems for high performing commercial, industrial, or mission critical/data center buildings
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant work experience
  • Experience with applicable software packages including AutoCAD, Revit
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Attention to detail, highly organized, self-starter?
  • Ability to travel to project sites
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Mission Critical/Data Center experience
  • Experience with international projects
  • RCDD and/or DCDC certifications

WSP Benefits

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation

  • Expected Salary (all locations): $112,000- $147,000.
  • Expected Salary(Colorado): $112,000- $147,000

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

raw.excerpt: About Ellucian Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students.
raw.description:
About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

The Full Stack Developer uses technical, analytical, and consulting skills to support the Ellucian Managed Services client community. The role works directly with customers to understand business and technical needs, troubleshoot application issues, and implement reliable solutions using the tools and resources available.

The work ranges from software troubleshooting and break/fix support to application enhancements, integrations, reporting, and scripting. This is a customer-facing role that requires a strong learning mindset, structured problem solving, clear communication, and effective collaboration across teams.

Prior Higher Education or Ellucian product experience is not required. Successful candidates are expected to learn new business domains, products, and technologies quickly and apply that knowledge to customer needs.

Where you will make an impact

  • Investigate and resolve defined to moderately complex technical issues using a structured troubleshooting approach, established practices, and available documentation and tools.
  • Gather information from customers to understand program needs, objectives, business processes, functional requirements, inputs, outputs, and expected outcomes.
  • Analyze application behavior, code, logs, API responses, integrations, data, and configuration to identify likely causes of errors and implement appropriate fixes or workarounds.
  • Prototype, configure, refine, test, and debug applications, integrations, reports, scripts, and related technical solutions.
  • Apply development and programming skills across application tiers to build, modify, and test application changes, interfaces, reports, and scripts.
  • Use REST APIs and API clients such as Bruno, Postman, or Insomnia to validate requests, responses, authentication, payloads, and integration behavior.
  • Provide high-quality technical consultation and support for Ellucian products and services, including Ethos, Banner Extensibility, Ellucian Experience, Ethos Data Connect, Banner Self-Service, and related solutions.
  • Communicate progress, findings, dependencies, and resolution steps clearly to customers and internal teams, including translating technical information for non-technical audiences when needed.
  • Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required, providing clear evidence, troubleshooting history, and reproducible details to accelerate resolution.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to complete assignments, resolve customer issues, and meet agreed priorities and service expectations.
  • Document technical findings, solutions, and reusable troubleshooting steps to strengthen team knowledge and improve future resolution efficiency.
  • Demonstrate customer focus, active listening, adaptability, accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new systems and technologies.

What you will bring

  • Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience in application development, technical support, integrations, consulting, or a related technical role.
  • Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript technologies such as ReactJS, NodeJS, and ES5/ES6 JavaScript.
  • Experience consuming and troubleshooting REST APIs and working with API clients such as Bruno, Postman, or Insomnia.
  • Experience with inbound and outbound system integrations and the ability to trace data or transactions across connected systems.
  • Experience with Git or another version-control system.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or relational databases; experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle PL/SQL is desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot for troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, code and data analysis, solution design, prototyping, and documentation; able to validate outputs and protect customer information.
  • Experience with GraphQL is desirable.
  • Experience with help desk, incident-management, or ticketing systems is desirable.
  • Experience with business process management or workflow tools such as ProcessMaker is desirable.
  • Customer service and/or consulting experience, with strong active-listening and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical information clearly.
  • Ability to work independently on defined assignments while seeking guidance or escalating appropriately when scope, risk, or complexity increases.
  • Ability and motivation to quickly learn unfamiliar applications, technologies, and business processes. Higher Education experience is not required.

What makes #Ellucianlife

  • Comprehensive health coverage: family major medical expenses, dental and life insurance.
  • Christmas bonus 30 days
  • Saving fund
  • Monthly food coupon
  • 15 workdays vacation
  • Thrive Flex Program that allows you to contribute towards your health, financial or learning interests
  • 5 charitable days to support the community that supports us
  • Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups such as: Women in Technology, Pride and Go Green to name a few.
  • Parental leave
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
  • We Foster a learning culture with:
    • Tuition Reimbursement Assistance
    • Professional development opportunities
    • LinkedIn Learning

raw.description:
Job Title: Clinical Project Manager (Early Clinical Development, Home-Based)

Job Location: Florence, Kentucky, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BASIC FUNCTIONS:

Responsible for the successful planning, implementation and execution of contracted activities. Assures the accurate transfer of contracts from proposal through project completion. Functionally responsible for all team members throughout the duration of each clinical trial. Assures clear client communication, process documentation, and compliance with Good Clinical Practices and procedures set forth by IQVIA Biotech and sponsors. Supports the department director in development of functional training, definition of standards and execution of department goals including process improvement.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsible for all activities related to implementation of clinical studies including:

  • Manages projects of full scope regional and global projects. Responsible for project team leadership
  • Responsible for building and maintaining positive client relationships
  • Ability to negotiate with clients to assure IQVIA Biotech’s operational processes are maintained, projects are done within scope.
  • Reviewing and identifying project study trends and proactively responding to client and respective team members
  • Developing appropriate early warning systems of potential obstacles to the successful completion of the projects; analyzes information and develops innovative solutions to challenges
  • Identifying, define, document training requirements in LMS systems and assure project level compliance with study specific training requirements
  • Responsible for change management on all assigned projects
  • Responsible for assuring projects assigned are run according to SOPs and WP as refined in the contract
  • Responsible for assuring project timelines are met as per contract
  • Responsible for identifying processes which need updating and documenting that to the direct line manager or divisional lead
  • Responsible for maintaining client relationships for all assigned work, keeping all project reporting current, and assuring executive management is aware
    • In conjunction with management, assists with developing, documenting, and updating internal processes and processes required for consistency across programs such as SOPs, working practices, and related quality assurance forms.
    • Provide other project support to Managers, as assigned
    • Oversee delegation of support staff activities, as necessary
    • Assists in the development and delivery of capability and proposal defense presentations to prospective clients
    • Supports Contracts and Proposals with final project contract execution and CIS documentation by the project team. Represents senior management in negotiation of contracts as appropriate.
    • Participates in the performance appraisal program by providing timely and accurate feedback regarding the performance of respective team members at least annually
    • Maintains current knowledge of FDA regulations, and GCP and ICH Guidelines for clinical research.
    • Responsible to maintain personal currency documentation for IQVIA Biotech SOPs, CAPA completion and timesheet maintenance including assurance or back-up PM staff at every instance of out of office

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of clinical research process from Phase I through regulatory submission
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written) to express complex ideas
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Positive attitude and ability to interact with all levels of staff to coordinate and execute study activities
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities within various clinical trials
  • Ability to reason independently for the purpose of assessing and recommending specific solutions in clinical settings
  • Ability to set baseline targets, track trends and implement mitigation plans
  • Understanding of basic data processing functions, including electronic data capture
  • Working knowledge of current ICH GCP guidelines

CRITICAL JOB FUNCTIONS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ADA CRITERIA:

  • Very limited physical effort required to perform normal job duties.
  • Up to 20% travel may be required including international travel
  • Must be able to secure a credit card cosigned by IQVIA Biotech

MINIMUM RECRUITMENT STANDARDS:

Previous Management Requirements:

  • Nursing or University degree US Bachelor Level or equivalent) in a health-related field with a minimum of three (3) years direct clinical trial experience in a CRO or research-related organization with at least one (1) year management experience OR
  • Equivalent level of education and experience.
  • Previous experience in managing people within a scientific/clinical environment is preferred.

Clinical Monitoring or Data Management experience required.

Excellent and demonstrated verbal and written communication and presentation skills.

Ability to work independently, prioritize and work with in a matrix team environment is essential.

Working knowledge of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required.

  • Prior experience in electronic data capture preferred.
  • Experience in contract/timeline management preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills required
  • Ability to travel domestically or internationally as required

CLASSIFICATION:

US: This position is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act; employees are not eligible for overtime compensation.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is $93,100.00 - $232,800.00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

This job is curated by Lifelancer.

Lifelancer is a talent-hiring platform in Life Sciences, Pharma and IT. The platform connects talent with opportunities in pharma, biotech, health sciences, healthtech and IT domains.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Financial Admin Assistant

Compensation range:$700 - $900 AUD/ Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule:Part-time, Monday to Friday, Available Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT)

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally engaged as an Independent Contractor (ICA). We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

Our Client is an Australian care provider supporting clients funded through Aged Care, NDIS, DVA and private funding. The business is growing quickly, taking on new clients every week, and is building out its admin team to keep up.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-focused Financial Admin Assistant to look after the billing data behind every client service. Your main job is to review completed shifts in ShiftCare one by one and enter each service accurately into the invoicing spreadsheet, which feeds into Xero. Accuracy is the most important part of this role, because every entry becomes an invoice. The role starts at about 20 hours a week, with strong potential to move to full-time within around 6 months as the business grows.

Key Responsibilities:

Shift Review & Billing Entry

  • Review completed shifts in ShiftCare one by one.
  • Enter each service into a detailed invoicing spreadsheet (27 columns) covering Aged Care, NDIS, DVA and private funding.
  • Make sure every entry has the correct funding type and service details so it flows correctly into Xero.
  • Check your own work, and flag anything missing, unclear or inconsistent before it is invoiced.

Staff Compliance Tracking

  • Track staff police checks and screening clearances and keep records up to date.

Research & General Admin

  • Complete research tasks and general admin as needed.
  • Handle confidential client and staff information responsibly.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • Experience in high-volume billing, invoicing or data entry.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working in large, detailed spreadsheets.
  • A very high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and manage your own workload.
  • Clear communication, including flagging questions or issues early.
  • Responsible handling of confidential information.
  • Availability for about 20 hours a week during Australian business hours.

Nice-to-Have:

raw.description:
HEAD OF GROWTH - SAMAKO CLEANING

Full-time | Remote (EU)

Competitive package + performance bonus

We've partnered with Samako Cleaning, a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer home-care brand, to find a Head of Growth who can lead its next stage of scale. This is a true build-and-scale opportunity: take fragmented growth activity and turn it into a structured, systemised and predictable engine connecting acquisition, eCommerce, conversion and retention.

ABOUT SAMAKO CLEANING

At Samako, we believe a clean home creates a clear mind. Cleaning shouldn't feel like a chore or a source of frustration; it should bring calm, clarity and balance to everyday life. Rooted in Dutch design, Samako creates minimalist, beautifully crafted cleaning companions designed to be seen and used. Thoughtful products, packaging and customer experiences help transform a functional category into a desirable lifestyle brand.

After strong and consistent growth, Samako is building the foundation for an internationally scalable €100M+ business. The opportunity is to bring full marketing ownership, structure and creative leadership to the heart of the company.

Explore the brand:

THE ROLE

The Head of Growth owns the full growth engine - acquisition, conversion and retention - and the commercial operating system that connects them. You won't simply manage channels or agencies. You'll identify where growth is constrained, prioritise the highest-impact opportunities, build an experimentation framework and lead execution across performance marketing, eCommerce and CRM. You'll also lead the Creative Strategy (CS) team, bring strong creative judgement and make high-impact AI adoption central to how the growth function operates.

You'll work directly with the founder and leadership team, creating visibility into what drives performance, what isn't working and where the business should invest next. This role requires both strategic clarity and the ability to operate at pace.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Full-funnel growth strategy

  • Own the growth roadmap across acquisition, CRO, retention and customer value.
  • Translate ambitious revenue targets into practical channel, customer and conversion plans.
  • Identify the biggest bottlenecks across the customer journey and prioritise initiatives by commercial impact.
  • Connect paid media, eCommerce and CRM into one cohesive system rather than disconnected functions.

Performance marketing and creative effectiveness

  • Lead and develop the Creative Strategy (CS) team, setting its direction and priorities while partnering with acquisition specialists and agency partners to improve creative effectiveness, spend efficiency and new-customer growth.
  • Bring strong creative judgement to concepts, hooks, messaging and formats, and build a clear feedback loop between creative testing, landing-page performance and customer behaviour.
  • Evaluate campaigns using CAC, LTV, conversion and broader business economics, not isolated platform results.
  • Drive practical, hands-on AI adoption across research, ideation, creative briefing and production, analysis and optimisation, using AI to increase the speed, volume and quality of testing.

Conversion and customer experience

  • Drive structured testing across landing pages, product pages, offers, checkout and merchandising.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insight to remove friction and improve conversion rate and AOV.
  • Work with eCommerce and product teams to ensure the site converts the demand generated by marketing.

Retention and customer lifetime value

  • Align lifecycle, CRM and acquisition priorities around long-term customer value.
  • Improve repeat purchasing and retention through better journeys, targeting and experimentation.
  • Establish a consistent understanding of how acquisition quality affects customer value.

Measurement, forecasting and operating rhythm

  • Build reporting that makes acquisition, site and lifecycle performance visible to leadership.
  • Own growth forecasts, testing priorities and clear performance reviews.
  • Establish disciplined experimentation: hypotheses, baselines, test design, learning and next actions.
  • Turn data into decisions and decisions into delivery.

Leadership and cross-functional execution

  • Align marketing, eCommerce, product and operations around shared commercial objectives.
  • Bring clarity and accountability to teams and external partners.
  • Build the structure, processes and capabilities needed as the brand scales.

DAY TO DAY

  • Review performance across acquisition, site conversion and lifecycle.
  • Diagnose where growth is being lost and agree the highest-value interventions.
  • Run and prioritise creative, landing-page, offer and retention tests.
  • Collaborate with eCommerce and CRM to improve conversion and LTV.
  • Lead weekly reporting and performance reviews with senior leadership.
  • Keep multiple growth initiatives moving without losing accountability for results.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You've already helped scale a DTC/eCommerce brand and understand how to make growth repeatable. You're equally comfortable discussing a commercial growth model and interrogating the details of a conversion experiment.

You bring:

  • Proven experience driving growth in a high-growth DTC/eCommerce environment.
  • Strong full-funnel understanding from acquisition through conversion to retention.
  • Strong creative judgement and experience leading creative strategists or a Creative Strategy team, alongside practical understanding of performance marketing, CRO and lifecycle.
  • Analytical rigour and the ability to translate data into action.
  • Experience designing structured experimentation programmes and embedding AI tools and workflows into day-to-day growth and creative operations.
  • Commercial fluency in CAC, LTV, CVR, AOV and growth efficiency.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and an operator's sense of ownership.
  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

WHAT REALLY MATTERS

You think like an operator, not just a marketer. You understand that growth is a system, not a collection of channels. You can create structure where activity feels fragmented, balance strategy with hands-on execution, and move quickly without sacrificing commercial judgement. You want to build and own the engine end-to-end.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Progress towards scaling revenue from approximately €30M to €100M+.
  • Improved CAC:LTV and overall growth efficiency.
  • Higher conversion, AOV, retention and customer lifetime value.
  • Faster experimentation and learning cycles, supported by AI-enabled workflows and a high-performing Creative Strategy team.
  • Clear full-funnel performance visibility and accountability.
  • A more predictable, system-driven growth organisation.

WHY JOIN SAMAKO?

  • Join a brand with strong momentum and genuine product-market fit.
  • Own the entire growth engine, rather than a single channel.
  • Play a central role in the journey towards €100M+.
  • Work directly with the founder and leadership team.
  • Build best-in-class growth systems with meaningful autonomy.
  • Have real ownership, impact and progression as the business scales.

PACKAGE AND LOCATION

Competitive salary plus performance bonus. Full-time.

If this sounds like you, apply or contact for a confidential conversation.

Samako is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Applications from all backgrounds are welcome; please let us know if you require adjustments during the recruitment process.

In this hands-on role, you will work closely with cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, and AI platform teams to translate AI security strategy into practical controls, reusable patterns, and implementation guidance for Machine Learning, Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions deployed at enterprise scale.

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES 🚀

• Translate AI security risks and strategic objectives into practical security controls, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and implementation guidelines.

• Conduct AI security assessments, architecture reviews, threat modeling exercises, and security testing activities for AI-enabled solutions.

• Review and support Machine Learning, Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI architectures from a security perspective.

• Collaborate with development and platform teams to integrate security controls into AI applications, cloud platforms, development pipelines, and AI engineering processes.

• Define security requirements for AI applications, models, data, agents, identities, integrations, monitoring, and incident response capabilities.

• Support the implementation of secure development practices across AI initiatives.

• Work closely with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, AI platform, privacy, legal, quality, and business teams to establish sustainable AI security practices.

• Contribute to the evolution of enterprise AI security standards, frameworks, and best practices.

• Promote security-by-design principles throughout the AI solution lifecycle.

SKILLS 🤹
Must Have

• Degree or equivalent practical experience in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Proven experience in Security Architecture, Application Security, Cloud Security, Platform Security, Product Security, or Security Engineering.

• Practical exposure to securing AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI solutions.

• Solid understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI architectures, including associated security risks and data flows.

• Hands-on experience with threat modeling and security assessments.

• Knowledge of secure software development practices and security testing methodologies.

• Experience with Identity & Access Management (IAM), secrets management, cloud security controls, and development pipeline security.

• Ability to translate complex security concepts into practical guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills.

• Fluent professional English.

Nice to have ⭐

• Experience with AI security testing, red teaming, adversarial AI testing, or AI risk assessments.

• Exposure to AI engineering practices and MLOps environments.

• Experience working in regulated industries such as Pharma, Healthcare, Finance, or Life Sciences.

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications (CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or similar).

• Knowledge of privacy, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks.

• German and/or Spanish language skills.

• Experience securing cloud-native environments and enterprise AI platforms.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

• AI solutions are delivered with security embedded from design through operation.

• Security requirements are translated into practical and scalable implementation patterns.

• AI risks are proactively identified, assessed, and mitigated.

• Development teams are empowered to build secure AI solutions through clear standards and guidance.

Our goal is that you are well in every way!

raw.title: Site Reliability Engineer
raw.excerpt: Why Pythian: At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence.
raw.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Customer‑facing SRE role designing, operating, and supporting reliable, observable, and cost‑effective platforms across Linux, Kubernetes, and public cloud. You’ll manage workstreams, automate with IaC, improve SLOs/SLIs and alert hygiene, and support peers.

Data Platforms expectation: bring depth in one area and the responsibility/willingness to ramp on the others in 60–90 days:

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch

Redis (OSS/Enterprise; ElastiCache/Memorystore/Azure Cache)

Kafka–Hadoop–Spark (incl. Confluent/MSK/Event Hubs, Cloudera/CDP/Dataproc/EMR)

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

  • Improve reliability, availability, and visibility for customer platforms; plan/execute documented maintenance; drive remediation/automation.
  • Provide remote support for Linux-based infrastructure across data center and cloud environments.
  • Manage the full OS lifecycle, including installation, deployment (Kickstart, VMs, containers, bare metal), patching, and upgrades.
  • Design and implement automation for infrastructure deployment, configuration, and operations using scripting (Bash, Pythian) and tools (Ansible).
  • Implement and evolve SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity plans, and reliability reviews; harden observability (metrics/logs/traces) and keep alerts actionable.
  • Build and extend infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet/Chef/Salt), and GitOps (Helm, Argo CD/Flux) pipelines.
  • Collaborate with support/app/data teams; reduce toil via scripting (Bash/Python) and small tools.
  • Data Platforms – pick one at depth, ramp on others:
    • Elasticsearch/OpenSearch: cluster ops, shard/replica strategy, ILM/snapshots, performance/security, EFK integration.
    • Redis: cluster/Sentinel ops, failover drills, parameter tuning (maxmemory, timeouts), cache observability (hit ratio/latency/evictions), persistence/DR (RDB/AOF, snapshots).
    • Kafka–Hadoop–Spark: topic/ACL management, retention/partitioning, connector basics, rolling upgrades; pipeline observability (lag/throughput/error rates); routine automation.
  • Facilitate technical discussions with customers; advise on platform roadmaps and architecture trade‑offs.
  • Support and cross‑train teammates; uphold documentation quality and internal knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in on‑call, escalations, and change reviews; proactively reduce toil via scripting/automation.

What we need from you:

Core

  • Strong Linux administration/troubleshooting; Kubernetes fundamentals (workloads, networking, storage, upgrades, security, HA); one major cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure).
  • IaC + config management experience; CI/CD/GitOps familiarity; scripting with Bash and/or Python.
  • Consulting mindset: clear English (written/spoken), estimation, stakeholder communication, documentation quality.

Data Platforms (depth in one; ramp on others)

  • Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (ops, tuning, ILM/snapshots, security/EFK), or
  • Redis (OSS/managed operations; data structures, eviction policies, RDB/AOF persistence).
  • Kafka–Hadoop–Spark (production exposure; Confluent/MSK/Strimzi; Dataproc/EMR/CDP familiarity), or

Nice to have

  • Security/IAM basics, budget/capacity awareness; Prometheus/Grafana experience; diagramming/runbook excellence.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

HiringDisclaimer

  • The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.
  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Technical Solution Architectto join our team full-time in Bulgaria.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Technical Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Our client is a leading global payments platform that connects businesses and consumers across 260 payment types in over 40 countries. With over 20 years of experience and an annual transaction volume exceeding $150 billion, it is a powerhouse in digital wallets, eCash solutions, and merchant acquiring.

In 2026, our client is undergoing a massive AI transformation. You will be joining the Intelligent Automation & AI Engineering initiative with the goal of replacing manual decision-making workflows with reliable, auditable AI-assisted systems.

You will work in an automation COE, collaborating with a centralised AI Platform team, IT, Dev Ops etc.

Responsibilities:

  • Design end-to-end AI-powered solutions, defining architecture, technology choices, integrations, and deployment approaches
  • Build prototypes, AI agents, automations, and production-ready solutions using modern AI technologies
  • Design and improve AI-assisted development workflows, develop reusable agent skills, engineering standards, and automation frameworks
  • Design, deploy, and optimize Azure infrastructure for AI applications, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Transform business ideas into working prototypes, validate assumptions, and iterate quickly based on feedback
  • Connect AI solutions with enterprise platforms, internal APIs, databases, and business systems
  • Own technical decisions and proactively identify challenges, driving solutions from concept through delivery
  • Work directly with business stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns, security guardrails, and engineering best practices
  • Research emerging AI technologies, evaluate new tools, and identify opportunities to accelerate engineering and business processes
  • Mentor engineers, document reusable solutions, and help teams adopt AI-assisted development practices
  • Take responsibility for technical outcomes, troubleshoot blockers, and proactively coordinate across teams to ensure delivery

Requirements:

  • Strong experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions, including integrations, APIs, authentication, data flows, and cloud infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID, networking, and identity management
  • Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, tool calling, RAG, and multi-step workflows
  • Strong experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code, including agent instructions, skills, and automated development workflows
  • Strong development background in at least one programming language: Python, C#, or TypeScript, and experience building production-ready applications
  • Experience connecting enterprise systems using REST APIs, MCP, webhooks, and workflow automation
  • Ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into working prototypes quickly, validate assumptions, and iterate based on feedback
  • Understanding of enterprise security, RBAC, managed identities, secrets management, and secure AI solution design
  • Ability to independently drive technical initiatives from discovery through implementation and deployment
  • Strong English communication skills, comfortable working directly with business stakeholders and explaining technical decisions
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Graph API
  • Familiarity with Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience designing reusable AI agent skills, custom instructions, MCP servers, and agentic SDLC workflows
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, and automated cloud provisioning
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Docker, and automated deployment pipelines
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, and other enterprise platforms
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt optimization, tracing, monitoring, and cost management
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, with security, compliance, and governance constraints
  • Experience mentoring engineers, creating reusable engineering standards, and enabling teams to adopt new technologies
  • Experience exploring emerging AI technologies, running technical experiments, and turning successful prototypes into reusable solutions
  • Highly proactive and initiative-driven, takes initiative, challenges existing approaches, and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, thrives in a fast-paced R&D environment with evolving requirements and uncertainty
  • Strong builder mentality, prefers experimenting, prototyping, and validating ideas rather than spending excessive time on theoretical discussions
  • Passionate about AI, actively explores emerging AI tools and technologies and applies them in real-world scenarios
  • Independent and accountable, makes technical decisions and takes ownership without requiring constant guidance
  • Scalability-oriented, thinks beyond individual tasks and focuses on creating scalable, reusable solutions that benefit multiple teams
  • Pragmatic engineering mindset, balances speed of delivery with engineering quality, security, and maintainability
  • Collaborative, enjoys working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

What’s in it for you?

  • Regular salary reviews based on performance
  • Corporate events: webinars, offline parties, and meetups
  • Internal Mobility Program
  • Tailored education path (including full access to Udemy, certifications, etc.)
  • 25 paid days off: 20 business days of vacation per calendar year + 5 undocumented sick leave days
  • Additional health insurance
  • 100% company-covered Multisport card, with discounts available for family members

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

Since expanding to Bulgaria in 2022, we’ve been building a fast-growing team that thrives on learning, collaboration, and innovation. Join us on this exciting journey and help shape the future of our delivery center.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Join an Australian life insurance group as a Compliance Auditor, working from home on a permanent, full-time Philippine contract. You’ll review the insurance applications, written communications and call recordings that Authorised Representatives (ARs) submit, check them against the compliance scorecard, and turn what you find into practical coaching for the advisers.

This role suits someone who already scores calls or customer files against a compliance standard and is comfortable giving firm, constructive feedback.

Why this role is worth having

You’ll see how advice is audited from end to end: you’ll validate the work of an offshore audit team, spot recurring breaches across the network, and report trends to the compliance team and the Compliance Committee. You’ll also help prepare and present monthly training drop-ins for the advice team, and help improve the audit scorecard and process over time.

What you’ll be doing

  • Review insurance applications submitted by ARs, including written communications and call recordings.
  • Review audits completed by the offshore audit team and validate their findings against the compliance scorecard, giving feedback and calibration support so audit quality stays consistent.
  • Update scorecards and feedback where needed, then finalise and submit audits within agreed service levels, with no finalisation task older than 10 days.
  • Log remediations, follow them up and escalate aged or unresolved items with ARs.
  • Identify trends and recurring breaches across ARs and licences, and report them to the compliance team and the Compliance Committee.
  • Coach ARs day to day, on trends and on ad hoc issues, both verbally and in writing.
  • Help prepare and present monthly training drop-ins for the internal advice team and the wider AR network.
  • Review internal and client-facing documents such as FSGs, scripts and templates for regulatory accuracy and clarity, and contribute to audit reporting, data accuracy and improvements to the scorecard.

You’ll work in a CRM, 3CX call recordings, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams).


Requirements

What you’ll need

  • At least 2 years of experience listening to recorded calls or checking customer files and scoring them against a compliance, regulatory or QA scorecard.
  • Hands-on experience giving written or verbal feedback or coaching to people based on your own audit or QA findings.
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to listen critically to calls and assess conduct, disclosures and client outcomes.
  • Clear, constructive written feedback that is firm on substance and encourages improvement.
  • Confidence speaking with ARs, including in challenging conversations about poor adherence.
  • Good organisation and time management.
  • RG 146 or a relevant compliance qualification, or willingness to complete one.
  • Availability to work Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM PHT.

Nice to have

  • Experience in Australian life insurance or financial advice compliance.
  • Familiarity with life insurance products, and knowledge of the difference between general and personal advice.
  • Knowledge of specific insurer products (for example TAL, Zurich, AIA, ClearView, NEOS).
  • Experience designing or delivering compliance training.
  • Experience building or refining audit scorecards or compliance frameworks.
  • Data and reporting skills, such as Excel pivot tables and dashboards.

Benefits

What’s on offer

Offshore 24/7 has been placing professionals with international businesses since 2008, with 500+ professionals placed. You are employed by Offshore 24/7 on a local Philippines employment contract with real job security, backed by a 4.9/5 rating on Glassdoor and 5.0 on Google. We provide ongoing training and coaching of our own, with reviews at 1, 3, 5 and 12 months.

Benefits
