About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
  • Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
  • Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
  • Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
  • The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

  • Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
  • Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
  • Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
  • AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
  • Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

raw.excerpt: À propos du posteCOROS conçoit des produits et solutions d'entraînement de pointe pour les athlètes d'endurance.
raw.description:
À propos du poste

COROS conçoit des produits et solutions d'entraînement de pointe pour les athlètes d'endurance. Le/la France Trail Running Marketing Specialist est le moteur de la présence de COROS au sein de la communauté trail running française. Le poste consiste à exécuter le plan marketing trail running de COROS en France, en donnant vie à notre stratégie de marque globale grâce à des créateurs de contenu/amabassadeurs, des athlètes, des événements et des partenariats qui parlent aux traileurs français. Membre de notre équipe marketing globale, tu apportes des idées créatives et réfléchies et es prêt(e) à les mettre en œuvre vous-même. Tu seras rattaché(e) directement au Head of Marketing et travailleras en étroite collaboration avec la Global Trail Running Lead.

Ton terrain de jeu

  • Constituer, gérer et développer le réseau de créateurs de contenu/ambassadeurs trail running de COROS en France, de la prospection et de l'onboarding au briefing, à l'envoi de produits et au suivi des contenus.

  • Gérer les partenariats et sponsorings événementiels, en pilotant la relation avec les organisateurs de courses et en veillant à ce que COROS tire pleinement parti de ses partenariats.

  • Planifier et piloter la présence de COROS sur les grandes courses de trail et les salons : stand, logistique, activations sur site et campagnes digitales avant, pendant et après chaque événement.

  • Coordonner athlètes et créateurs de contenu autour des événements clés pour produire et partager des contenus engageants en temps réel.

  • Gérer les budgets événements, athlètes et créateurs, et analyser les performances pour améliorer les activations futures.

Ton profil

Parcours professionnel

  • Profil : C'est un poste junior. 1-3 ans en marketing sportif, avec une spécialisation en trail running, running, cyclisme et/ou montres/compteurs GPS.

  • Expérience : Tu as déjà planifié et mené des activations physiques et digitales, des activations événementielles aux partenariats avec des créateurs de contenu/ambassadeurs, en gérant les budgets, en négociant les contrats et en mesurant les résultats (portée, engagement, ROI).

  • Connaissance du marché : Compréhension approfondie de l'univers du trail running en France : technologies produits, tendances, événements, athlètes, médias clés, publics cibles et leurs sources d'information.

  • Gestion des ambassadeurs : Expérience dans la gestion de créateurs de contenu/ambassadeurs et d'athlètes dans le cadre d'un partenariat marketing. Tu es à l'aise pour transformer des concepts et des idées en briefs de contenu pertinents.

  • Gestion de comptes : Solides compétences en prospection, négociation, développement de relations, gestion des paiements et suivi des livrables.

Autres compétences clés

  • Collaboration et organisation : Excellentes compétences en communication, collaboration et gestion de projet.

  • État d'esprit : À l'aise dans un environnement en rapide évolution, tu apportes des idées créatives et réfléchies et les mets en œuvre toi-même.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais courants (langues de travail).

  • Déplacements : Tu es disponible pour te déplacer sur les courses, salons et événements professionnels en France, y compris le week-end, avec récupération des jours travaillés.

Le cadre

  • Rattachement : Head of Marketing, en étroite collaboration avec la Global Trail Running Lead.

  • Localisation : En France, de préférence à Annecy ou Chamonix.

  • Mode de travail : À distance, avec plusieurs réunions d'équipe par an.

  • Type de contrat : CDI.

Package et avantages

  • Une équipe motivée et internationale.

  • De l'espace pour tes idées et ton autonomie.

  • Faible hiérarchie et circuits de décision courts.

  • L'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise dans une phase très dynamique, avec de nombreuses perspectives d'évolution personnelle.

  • 25 jours de congés payés et 12 jours de RTT.

  • Rémunération : Le salaire de base pour ce poste démarre à 38 000 € brut par an, selon l'expérience, les compétences et la localisation, avec la possibilité de percevoir un bonus sur performance.

Langue de candidature : Merci de nous adresser ta candidature en anglais, l'anglais étant notre langue de travail.

raw.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

Location: 100% Remote

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

raw.description:
Job Type:

Term (Fixed Term)

Position Description

The RAND Corporation is a nonprofit institution that helps improve policy and decision-making through research and analysis. RAND is widely respected for operating independently of political and commercial pressures as a nonpartisan organization. RAND values objectivity and integrity in both its research processes and internal interactions and emphasizes a collegial environment that respects the contributions and dignity of all staff.


RAND is seeking a Senior Researcher to lead its effort to integrate AI into RAND's research and into the business processes that support it. This is a one-year term position, renewable. The role helps set the direction for AI adoption across RAND: understanding where RAND is today, learning from peer organizations, defining what RAND needs to be good at in an AI world, and working with researchers and leadership to make adoption real at scale.


The position is well suited to someone who has used AI directly in research and business work, has helped other organizations build AI into their core functions, and can move a large, expert community toward practical use.


Key Responsibilities

  • External learning: Draw lessons from peer organizations, including FFRDCs, UARCs, and consulting firms, on what distinguishes successful adoption from failed attempts, and translate them to RAND's context.
  • Strategic direction: Recommend a framework for how AI fits across RAND's diverse portfolio.
  • Adoption at scale: Design and test approaches with researchers on real projects, including quick wins that build momentum, and define what AI tools need to look like to be used well inside RAND's culture and research practice.
  • Tools and resources: Advise on the tool landscape (what to keep, build, buy, or stop), how separate tool efforts should work together, and how to allocate resources, with attention to security, compliance, and budget constraints.
  • Governance and measurement: Propose how decisions about AI deployment should be made and define evidence-based measures of whether adoption is working.

Qualifications

All research positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity.

Required:

  • Experience integrating AI to transform research and business processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a cross-organizational effort, working with senior leaders and with technical and non-technical staff.
  • Ability to synthesize evidence from interviews, usage data, and external practice into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Experience moving users from skepticism to routine use of new tools.
  • Familiarity with research organizations, FFRDCs, or similar institutions.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AI governance, security, and compliance requirements.

Education Requirements and Experience

The preferred candidate will have a PhD and 8+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with thesis and 13+ years of experience, in computer science or engineering, information science, cyber engineering, or related field (such as mathematics, operations research, physical sciences, or closely related discipline). Professional experience should demonstrate the applicant’s ability to design, execute and disseminate results of research using analytically rigorous methods.

Location

Fully remote

Salary Range: $171,800 - $283,100


RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate's work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. This position is eligible for overtime. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND's sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Role:

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AMER Payroll Lead to join our growing team. In this role, you will take ownership of payroll across North America, the Caribbean, and Europe, processing and auditing payroll for a portfolio of 20+ countries, including multiple US states, Canada, and Puerto Rico, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, and driving payroll automation in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

  • Prepare payroll reports and documentation for audits and internal stakeholders, and assist with year-end tax filings including W-2s etc.
  • Lead payroll reconciliations and journal entries, and proactively resolve discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the People team to ensure accurate employee classifications and pay rates across all jurisdictions.
  • Maintain confidentiality and data privacy in accordance with company policies and regulations.
  • Process Improvement

Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in payroll processing, with a strong focus on multi-country payroll.

  • Good understanding of US federal and state payroll regulations, tax laws, and compliance requirements. Working knowledge of Canadian, Caribbean, and European payroll regulations is a strong advantage.

  • Familiarity with benefits administration and 401(k) reporting.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable working independently and in a distributed team environment.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented mindset.

Committed to Culture

Specialty insurance helps others succeed by transforming uncertainty into predictable expense—empowering small businesses to do what was previously impossible. At Accelerant, we carry that same spirit into how we build our People function.

We are Other-Obsessed. We design every People Ops process to support others in achieving their goals. We work from first principles with clear outcomes in mind. We say “yes” when we can. We give sustained maximum effort—every day—because enabling the success of others is our success too.

We look for people who are wired for how we work:

Ambiguity: you’re effective and comfortable in undefined, shifting conditions, without needing clarity or structure to be provided for you.

Initiative: you spot problems, claim unowned work, and act before being asked. At Accelerant, the person pulls; the organization doesn't push.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Bold, innovative and just a tad naughtier than you would expect, Honey Birdette are looking for an online Customer Service Manager to join our Hive!

About Honey B

Honey Birdette was created by women for women, to offer an experience unlike any other lingerie retailer. We are a luxury lifestyle brand offering high-end lingerie and premium bedroom accessories. Bold, innovative and a little naughtier than you would expect, Honey Birdette has quickly become the most talked about lingerie brands. We inspire, create curiosity, and empower women through their beauty and confidence.

Who We Seek

The online Customer Service Manager is a hands‑on leader charged with shaping, supporting, and energising a high‑performing team to deliver stellar customer experiences across every touchpoint. You’ll handle all aspects of managing team —creating and approving monthly rosters and timesheets—while providing regular one‑on‑one coaching, managing escalated tickets, and identifying skill gaps for training. Front‑of‑house, you’ll manage live chats, calls, social media, Click & Collect, VIP invoicing, and order issues, maintaining 24/7 customer support. Operationally, you’ll coordinate with warehouse teams, manually process orders, resolve shipping or fraud issues, and file courier claims. With a proactive, solution‑oriented mindset, you’ll champion a customer‑centric culture—anticipating needs, actively resolving problems, and ensuring commitments are met. You’ll also produce weekly reports for e‑commerce, stay compliant with all HB/PLBY policies, participate in ongoing training, effectively communicate across internal channels, and take on additional responsibilities as required—always keeping the customer perspective front and centre. This role embodies the essence of true customer obsession, where every decision, process, and interaction is driven by the goal of delighting and retaining customers


What You’ll Do - Job Responsibilities

  • Approve team timesheets and monitor adherence to scheduled hours.

  • Handle escalated tickets and identify training opportunities for team growth.

  • Deliver weekly region performance reports and ad hoc analysis for e‑commerce.

raw.excerpt: What is 8020REI? 8020REI is a pioneering B2B data and SaaS platform that empowers professional real estate investors to generate consistent leads from Cold Call, SMS, and Direct Mail without spending more.
raw.description:
What is 8020REI?

8020REI is a pioneering B2B data and SaaS platform that empowers professional real estate investors to generate consistent leads from Cold Call, SMS, and Direct Mail without spending more. We leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to identify homeowners likely to sell at a discount, and we use a proven strategy to maximize our clients' ROI. As part of our network, we also operate alongside three sister companies: DMForce, 8020Recruit, and 8020CRM, each contributing specialized services to the real estate sector.

Core Values at 8020REI:

  • Find a Better Way:We dig until we understand the real problem, then improve or innovate to solve it. Focused on the 20% that drives the biggest result.

  • Have Each Other's Back:We work as a team. We support, step in, and go the extra mile to create a great experience for each other and our clients.

  • Honor Your Word:We honor our promises, hold ourselves accountable, and do the right thing even when nobody’s looking.

  • Own Your Growth:We're obsessed with personal growth and take pride in the work we deliver. Intrinsically motivated, we hold ourselves to a high standard and never coast.

  • Bring Your A-Game:We take care of our recovery, health, and family time, and that’s why we show up focused, energized, and ready to perform at our best.

🎯 Role Overview

As our SDR Manager, you run our sales team and you build the system it sells inside. You lead the SDRs who open the conversations, you work alongside the Account Executives who close them, and you own the number the team produces.

You will be hiring and coaching reps, running the 1:1s and the call reviews, and building the machine underneath them: the dialer, the outreach sequences, the prospect list, the CRM discipline, and the reporting that says which stage is losing deals and why.

This is a hands-on seat. You run the 1:1s and the call reviews yourself, and you get on the phone with the live list every week. There is no layer between you and the reps, which is the point: you'll know exactly why the number is what it is.

💡 Key Responsibilities:

This role is about owning a team and the system behind it. Parts of this are still to be built, and building them is the job.

• Lead the SDR Team: Every SDR is yours: their number, their ramp, their development. You coach off their own recordings, not off a scoreboard, working one habit at a time and closing it out on a later call before starting the next. You hire, you decide who makes it, and keeping the reps worth keeping is part of the job.

• Own the Number: You carry your team's number, from first touch through to qualified pipeline. Booked calls that don't get held, and meetings that don't survive qualification, are a miss and not a result. You own that number and you report it, with the reasons behind it, every week.

• Own the Three Channels: Cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. That is the job, and it is deliberately narrow. Email and LinkedIn are underbuilt today, so expect to rebuild rather than maintain.

• Build the Systems: The dialer, the outreach sequences, the CRM, the reporting, the tooling. You set them up, you fix them when they break, and you decide what the team spends its budget on. This is a builder's seat as much as a manager's.

• Know Why the Numbers Move: When something slips, you can say whether it was the list, the script, the process, or the rep, and you bring the evidence. A diagnosis, not a dashboard link.

• Protect What Reaches the Closers: You work with our Account Executives on what a qualified deal looks like, and you own the quality of what your team hands them.

• Use AI Where It Actually Wins: You scale the repetitive parts with the tools available and you test where AI genuinely beats a person, instead of assuming it either way.

• Stay Call-Ready: No personal quota, but you work the live list every week and you personally run a new script before handing it to the team. A leader who hasn't worked the list can't coach the list.

• Keep the Tank Full: You set the spec for the prospect list and hold the bar on quality, so the team never runs out of the right people to call.

✅ Qualifications

• Experience: 4 to 7 years in B2B sales, with at least 2 years managing reps. You've run a cold-calling team, not just been on one.

• Industry Fit: You've sold in B2B, SaaS, or another niche industry where the buyer is a specific kind of operator and the addressable list is finite. Broad consumer or commodity selling is a different job and it does not transfer here.

• Built the System, Not Just Run It: You've stood up the machine your team sells inside, the dialer, the sequences, the CRM discipline, the reporting, and can walk through what you changed and what it did to the numbers. This is the bar.

• Hands-On Depth: Real depth in at least two of cold calling, email, and LinkedIn, shown not claimed. Outreach you personally built and ran, not work you approved or handed to an agency. Two done well beats passing familiarity with all three.

• Thinks in Unit Costs: You can say what a booked call cost you in a previous seat and what you did to move it. You don't need to have run a P&L, but you should be the kind of manager who knows what the team's activity actually buys.

• Coaches From the Recording: "At 4:12 you asked a closed question, here's the open one, here's why he shut down." Not "be more energetic."

• Holds the Line: You can tell a rep the number isn't there, on the day it isn't there, in plain words, and still have the relationship next week.

• Manages by Numbers: You know your team's conversion at every stage without opening a report, and you catch a dip in days.

• Native-Level Spoken English: A hard requirement. You'll coach tone and delivery on live U.S. cold calls, and you can't coach a bar you can't hit.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working alongside or managing closers.

  • Sales teams built in more than one industry, with a clear account of what had to change between them.

  • Knowledge of Salesmate, Koncert, Instantly, or Clay. Having taken a rep from zero to quota. Having built a sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one.

  • Experience selling into contractors or the trades.

Why Join Us?

At 8020REI you'll be building the sales engine, not inheriting one. The team, the process, and the systems are yours, with a real budget behind you and the autonomy to decide what gets scaled, fixed, or cut. Most seats like this hand you a machine and ask you to run it a little better. This one hands you the whole problem and gets out of your way. If you want a role where the funnel is yours end to end and the results are unmistakably yours, this is it.

📝 What We Offer:

  • Competitive Base Compensation

  • Profit Share Bonus

  • Flex PTO (up to 26 days per year)

  • Home Office Upgrade Bonus

  • HMO Bonus

  • Full-time Remote Work

  • Opportunity for growth and team-building potential

  • Ongoing support and budget to develop new skills

Join us at 8020REI and contribute directly to revolutionizing the real estate investment landscape!

SUMMARY

The Editorial Developer is responsible for executing the successful development of assigned program content to meet the program goals as described in the business case and program schedule, as well as broader Pearson goals related to the Global Quality Policy, local content requirements, and IHE strategy. The Editorial Developer collaborates with the product team to create the content plan for all assigned titles, and works with authors, subject matter experts, vendors, suppliers, project managers and other external and internal stakeholders to ensure that content is created and delivered as planned within the established schedule and budget. The Editorial Developer will build and maintain a strong working knowledge of Pearson platforms to ensure that the delivered content follows best practices for the intended delivery model.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE

  • Completion of a university degree.
  • Post graduate degree/diploma is an asset.
  • 2-3 years of previous Developmental Editing, Content Development, and/or digital editorial experience.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES

  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with various software; including all Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience with various additional software such as Smartsheet, Jira, Adobe, and Oracle applications is an asset.
  • Knowledge of higher education publishing standards, eTexts, digital learning platforms, LMS and/or other learning apps, environments, and tools.
  • Editorial skills, including basic copy editing and substantive editing.
  • Time management skills, ability to prioritize, and the ability to balance the needs of many projects at once.
  • Experience and/or formal training in Instructional Design is an asset.
  • Familiarity and comfort working with generative AI and prompt building is an asset.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, detail-oriented, and strong ability to multi-task.
  • Adaptable problem-solver, team collaborator, and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously and operate in a demanding work environment is important.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning and scheduling of content plans and/or media plans

  • Collaborate with the product owner and project manager to create content plans and establish workflows, with particular attention to content requirements, scope, schedule, and execution.
  • Establish coordinated high-level content development schedules and development plans for full program components.
  • Plan for and attend all assigned project-related meetings.
  • Finalize and document project-specific media plans.
  • Clarify required deliverables for each program component and ensure final content is delivered to acceptable standards.
  • Ensure that pedagogy standards and Global Content Policy requirements are documented, maintained, and implemented.
  • Work with the R&P team to ensure that permission requirements are properly communicated and documented.

Manage content development of assigned titles

  • Manage the development of the content plan, in collaboration with the product team, that reflects the strategic goals of the program and supports the program scope as presented in the business case and planning process. This may involve the hiring and management of vendors, suppliers, and other contributors.
  • Collaborate with the product owner, project manager, and other stakeholders to document and implement the digital learning requirements, digital structure etc. within the limitations of platform, budget and schedule to support the best possible digital learning experience for each product.
  • Prepare start-up materials for authors including detailed documentation summarizing the content plan. This will include incorporating manuscript preparation requirements for print and digital outputs. This work may involve the analysis of previous edition files and documentation including project plans and permission logs.
  • Analyze and assess content during the writing process to ensure compliance with the Global Content Policy and any specific DEI feedback obtained via the review process. Work with authors and SMEs to ensure successful implementation of the feedback throughout the development process. This may include escalating issues to other stakeholders within the product team for further remediation.
  • Analyze peer review feedback of products obtained prior to signing and/or during development and prepare documents summarizing the analysis and providing guidance for authors and SMEs in the implementation of the feedback.
  • Obtain and review content from authors and SMEs throughout the development process and ensure they are provided detailed feedback on adherence to the content plan and other project parameters.
  • In close collaboration with the project manager prepare content for transmittal from the writing stage to the production stage and ensure projects comply with acceptance criteria and workflow guidelines, including tools and templates appropriate to the platform for which content is developed.
  • Assist in training and supporting external content writers/SMEs in pedagogy and other areas related to content development.
  • Create and maintain all required core and supporting documentation throughout the development process.
  • Track and communicate ongoing detailed status of projects to other stakeholders.

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop proficiency with Pearson platforms and systems, as well as key 3rd party applications for the purposes of content creation and provide support to other stakeholders within these platforms as required.
  • Guide and instruct authors, subject matter experts, and vendors, when appropriate, in preparation of writing samples and demo materials as required, using appropriate author tools for all content including 3rd party applications integrated within Pearson products.
  • Assist in training and supporting external content writers (authors/SMEs/vendors) in pedagogy and their use of the appropriate authoring environment and tools.

    Work with other team members to remediate all content query tickets as assigned. This may include providing detailed instructions for the work to be carried out by a vendor.

This may include the use of generative AI and subsequent validation of the content directly or in collaboration with an external SME.

raw.description:
The Role

At Treewalk, you’ll own the entire public-company reporting cycle: fast closes, MD&A storytelling, IFRS/US GAAP judgment calls, and scalable system design. You’ll own end-to-end financial disclosure for a portfolio of high growth clients in life sciences, including pharmaceuticals, therapeutics, and other applications of biosciences and biotechnology. Many engagements will tap you as a de-facto fractional CFO, guiding strategy as well as disclosure; others will lean on you as the go-to technical expert. Either way, every file is yours to run.

Deadlines are real; overtime isn’t a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility—so your evenings stay yours.

If you’ve led pub-co audits at a small- to mid-size firm or managed reporting inside a listed issuer, and you’re ready to trade 70-hour busy-season marathons for high-impact work, tangible ownership, and genuine balance, then we would love to hear from you.

How You’ll Create Impact Day-to-Day

  • Own the story behind the numbers: Draft and polish quarterly and annual financial statements and MD&A that stand up to capital-markets scrutiny and tell each client’s growth narrative from the science, to the milestones, and the financial commitments required to achieve the business objectives.
  • Make R&D spend make sense: Advise clients on accounting for research and development costs, clinical and pre-clinical trial accruals, CRO/CDMO arrangements, and measuring burn rate against progress.
  • Master the technical hurdles: Tackle complex issues such as licensing and collaboration agreements, milestone and royalty revenue, acquired IPR&D, government grants and funding, intangible assets and impairment, and package them into robust technical memos and disclosures.
  • Untangle complex capital structures: Work through warrants, convertible instruments, derivative liabilities, royalty and streaming financings, unit offerings, debt/equity splits, and stock-based compensation.
  • Run the engine of multi-entity groups: Build rock-solid consolidation and foreign-currency translation models that make complex structures look effortless.
  • Turn data into insight: Deliver sharp balance sheet and P&L analyses, spotlighting trends and red-flag variances before anyone else sees them.
  • Keep leadership laser-focused: Produce monthly variance reports against forecasts and annual plans, translating the findings into clear, action-ready recommendations, including cash runway and financing timing.
  • Shape the roadmap: Guide annual budgets and rolling forecasts, aligning stakeholders around targets that push the business without breaking it.
  • Step in as the “extra brain”: Handle special-project bookkeeping or period-end close entries when clients need a fractional controller’s precision and speed.
  • Make audits painless: Design year-end audit plans, prep airtight support, and quarterback conversations with external auditors so CEOs and CFOs can sleep at night.
  • Guard continuous disclosure: Stay ahead of regulatory changes, draft timely filings, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks on SEDAR+ or EDGAR.
  • Build and grow the industry service line: Take ownership of the practice area and scale it, and develop the people who will run alongside you.

Result: clients see you as the calm, expert voice who keeps them compliant and strategic, while you build Treewalk’s Biotechnology and Life Sciences service line without the grind of traditional public practice.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

  • CPA designation required.
  • Significant public company audit and/or financial reporting experience, serving or working within pre-revenue or early-commercial biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or other life sciences reporting issuers listed in Canada and/or the US.
  • Hands-on technical depth in life sciences accounting and fluency in the drug and product development lifecycle.
  • After the base experience requirements are met, we hire first and foremost for strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Why Treewalk Feels Different

It’s Treewalk for a reason: we invest in your growth, trust your judgment, and protect your life outside the ledger.

  • No-Strings Learning Fund: We pay 100% of your CPA modules, annual dues, and any pro-dev courses you choose, and we’ll never claw it back if you move on.
  • Freedom Over Face-Time: Own your deadlines, shape your schedule. Hit a midday workout, do the school run. Just bring the results.
  • Day-One Peace of Mind: Extended health, dental, vision, and parental-leave benefits start the moment you join.

Benefits

Who We Are

Treewalk is Vancouver-born, scaling nationwide, and obsessed with turning capital-markets complexity into clarity. We give TSX, TSX-V, CSE, NASDAQ, and OTC issuers an end-to-end disclosure engine, so they can focus on growth while we keep them bullet-proof in the spotlight.

But labels like “accounting firm” don’t capture our DNA. Picture a tech startup powered by CPAs:

  • Holacracy over hierarchy: Ideas outrank titles, and ownership lives on every desk.
  • Sector depth, startup curiosity: If it’s innovative, we’re already in it, or will be tomorrow.
  • Growth at warp speed: One of Canada’s fastest-rising advisory practices, we set audacious goals, then sprint past them.
  • Training ground for tomorrow’s CFOs: Whether you’re a seasoned audit manager or a life sciences controller, Treewalk is where accountants level up for industry roles and capital-markets strategy.

The Values That Power Us

Mastery: We hunt knowledge relentlessly and build expertise into every engagement.
Support: No one goes it alone. Collaboration is our default setting.
Ownership: We celebrate wins and own slip-ups with equal conviction.
Kaizen: Continuous improvement isn’t a buzzword; it’s our daily operating system.

Annual Salary: $125,000

raw.description:
About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a senior, hands-on software engineer who has used AI coding agents to deliver secure, production-ready software within established enterprise environments. You will help 8 West develop practical, repeatable agent-driven engineering workflows for existing applications and client projects, with a particular focus on GitHub Copilot and Microsoft technologies.

This is not an AI strategy or prompt-only role. You will write and review code, build and operate agent harnesses, and ship thoroughly tested changes to real systems, including legacy and business-critical applications. You will guide developers in adopting these practices alongside live delivery commitments and within enterprise security, governance and contractual boundaries.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Deliver production software. Personally design, implement, test, review and release agent-assisted changes to existing enterprise applications, not only new builds or prototypes.

  • Engineer agent workflows and harnesses. Build reusable instructions, tools, context pipelines, execution loops and feedback mechanisms that help agents work reliably within enterprise repositories and engineering controls.
  • Modernise brownfield applications. Adapt agent workflows to established .NET services, legacy code, databases, integrations and build pipelines; manage dependencies, regression risks and safe incremental change.
  • Make quality non-negotiable. Connect agent output to unit, integration and end-to-end tests, code review, security scanning, build pipelines and clear release criteria; investigate failures yourself.
  • Respect enterprise boundaries. Apply least-privilege permissions, approved tools and models, secure environments, sensitive-data controls, traceability and human approval points to agent workflows.
  • Modernise delivery incrementally. Introduce practical workflows for understanding, modifying, testing and maintaining existing systems; pilot improvements without disrupting live project commitments.
  • Work in the Microsoft ecosystem. Apply GitHub Copilot and other approved agentic tools to .NET, Azure, SQL and established Git repositories, integrating with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and existing delivery pipelines.
  • Coach developers through delivery. Pair on real work, demonstrate techniques, review agent-generated changes and create concise playbooks that enable other engineers to work independently.
  • Influence stakeholders. Explain opportunities, limitations, risks and technical choices clearly to developers, engineering leaders, security teams and client decision-makers.
  • Demonstrate measurable value. Evaluate delivery speed, rework, escaped defects, engineering effort, reliability and cost rather than treating AI-generated code volume as success.

Essential Skills & Experience

Proven enterprise production delivery. Demonstrable personal experience shipping and supporting production software through agentic coding workflows, with evidence of rigorous verification, release controls and operational outcomes.

  • Brownfield enterprise experience. Must have personally built and deployed AI-driven development workflows around existing production applications, not only greenfield projects. Comfortable with legacy code, incomplete documentation, complex dependencies, established tests and change controls.
  • Agentic development and harness design. Hands-on experience with multi-step coding agents, planning, context engineering, reusable instructions or skills, tool integrations (including MCP where relevant), safe execution controls and feedback-driven validation.
  • Strong core software engineering. Substantial experience designing, coding, debugging and maintaining complex enterprise applications and services; sound judgement on architecture, APIs, data, performance and maintainability.
  • GitHub Copilot and Microsoft tooling. Practical experience with GitHub Copilot agent workflows in Visual Studio or VS Code, plus familiarity with .NET/C#, Azure, SQL Server and GitHub or Azure DevOps delivery practices.
  • Engineering quality and release controls. Ability to implement automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing, CI/CD checks, peer review, security controls, deployment verification and production troubleshooting for AI-assisted changes.
  • Security and governance by design. Experience working within enterprise restrictions on source code, client data, secrets, tools, networks and access; understands prompt-injection risks, IP/licensing concerns and auditable approvals.
  • Pragmatic engineering transformation. Evidence of helping established enterprise teams adopt agentic practices, working through legacy constraints, resistance to change and competing delivery priorities.
  • Communication and mentoring. Strong ability to teach by pairing and demonstration, communicate with technical and non-technical leaders, constructively challenge assumptions and bring developers with you.

Desirable Experience

  • Regulated industries. Insurance, healthcare, financial services or similarly controlled environments, including evidence of compliant delivery, auditability, privacy and formal change management.
  • Broader agentic tooling. Experience with additional coding agents or frameworks, agent orchestration, custom agents, hooks, MCP servers, sandboxing and evaluation harnesses.
  • Advanced delivery automation. Infrastructure as code, secure build environments, observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or repeatable software delivery templates.
  • AI systems and assessment. Experience evaluating agent performance with repeatable tasks, automated checks, traces and failure analysis; familiarity with LLM-enabled product features is useful.
  • Consulting and technical leadership. Experience coaching engineers across multiple enterprise teams or client engagements, developing reusable practices and advising stakeholders on trade-offs.

Personal Profile

You are a hands-on, security-conscious engineer who enjoys complex, imperfect codebases. You modernise existing systems safely, teach others by example and know when agents require human oversight. You are practical, collaborative and accountable for production quality.

What Success Looks Like

Existing client systems benefit from secure, tested agent workflows that meet enterprise release controls. Reusable harnesses reduce repetitive work without increasing defects or risk. Developers gain practical skills, and 8 West demonstrates measurable improvement across engagements.

the company is looking for Medicare Enrollment Specialists to help evaluate and improve AI systems on Medicare topics. You’ll use your Social Security or employer benefits experience to check that questions sound like real beneficiaries and that answers are correct and useful. Accuracy comes first. No AI experience is needed; your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review sample questions about signing up for Medicare and flag any that don’t sound like what real people ask.
  2. Write rubrics that define a correct, complete answer on initial enrollment, special enrollment periods, and Part B late penalties, including how enrollment ties to Social Security benefits.
  3. Cover Medigap vs. Medicare Advantage and Part D in your rubrics, with a focus on scenarios involving employer or retiree coverage.
  4. Cover how employer coverage interacts with Medicare, including employer size, primary vs. secondary coverage, COBRA, and creditable coverage.
  5. Evaluate AI-generated answers against your rubrics, flagging errors, omissions, and common misconceptions.
  6. Share clear written feedback with the project team, working asynchronously.

Required Qualifications

  1. Former SSA Medicare enrollment experience, or employer benefits/HR experience advising employees on Medicare
  2. 1+ years advising on initial enrollment, special enrollment periods, Part B late penalties, Medigap vs. Medicare Advantage, and Part D
  3. Working knowledge of Social Security and employer coverage coordination, including creditable coverage
  4. US-based
  5. Able to start quickly and commit 20-30 hours/week
  6. Clear, precise writing

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with premium adjustments (such as IRMAA), working while enrolled, or HSA rules alongside Medicare
  2. Experience creating guides, counseling scripts, or training materials
  3. Experience helping a diverse range of beneficiaries, including rural and non-English-speaking clients

raw.description:
Sobre nosotros

Draftea es la startup de tecnología mexicana que está revolucionando el mundo de las apuestas. Creada por y para los aficionados a los deportes, estamos respaldados por inversionistas de clase mundial como Sequoia, Kaszek y Bullpen. Nuestra razón de ser es sencilla: darle a los aficionados una nueva forma de disfrutar su pasión. Queremos que todos los amantes de los deportes puedan sentir como si cada partido fuera la final del mundial y cada triunfo una razón para celebrar. Queremos acercar a nuestros jugadores a sus ídolos y equipos y hacerlos partícipes de las emociones que se viven dentro del campo.

Nuestra cultura

Construimos un producto orientado al entretenimiento de nuestros usuarios, es por esto que promovemos un entorno de trabajo donde trabajamos duro pero al mismo tiempo la pasamos bien y en donde cada persona puede trabajar con compañeros igualmente motivados y con un alto rendimiento. Creemos y confiamos en la flexibilidad horaria en donde el objetivo es la consecución de resultados es por esto que buscamos a alguien a quien le apasione el producto, la función y el reto, y que no busque simplemente otro trabajo de 9 a 5.
Somos una empresa "remote-first". Esto significa que, aunque tenemos una oficina en Ciudad de México y Buenos Aires nuestro equipo está trabajando desde diferentes países (Perú, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Argentina, República Dominicana, Estados Unidos).

Objetivo de la posición

El especialista tendrá la responsabilidad de atender a los usuarios que se contacten a través de nuestros canales de atención, buscando siempre superar sus expectativas de servicio. Debe ser un apasionado del servicio, empático y resolutivo.

El Customer Experience Specialist debe tener excelentes habilidades de comunicación, ya que hablará directamente con los clientes. Además, deben tener una sólida comprensión de los productos y servicios de su empresa para abordar las preguntas de los clientes. También debe tener una actitud agradable y capacidad de negociación.

Desafíos de la posición

  • Atender las interacciones online y offline de nuestros clientes.

  • Ofrecer soluciones y alternativas adecuadas utilizando procesos definidos dentro de los tiempos establecidos y realizar un seguimiento para garantizar la resolución.

  • Revisar resultados y estadísticas de juegos.

  • Gestión de crisis y situaciones sensibles: En situaciones donde los clientes enfrentan emergencias relacionadas con la plataforma Draftea, el Customer Experience Specialist deberá manejar estas situaciones con sensibilidad y eficacia.

  • Resolución de problemas complejos, colaborar con los equipos internos con la finalidad de llegar a una solución para satisfacer las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

  • Adaptación a las necesidades cambiantes: Las necesidades y expectativas de los clientes pueden evolucionar con el tiempo, lo que requiere una adaptación continua de las estrategias y procesos de éxito del cliente.

  • Comunicación efectiva: Superar barreras de comunicación y garantizar una comprensión mutua.

  • Mantenerse al día con las actualizaciones de la plataforma: Draftea puede lanzar actualizaciones y nuevas características regularmente para mejorar la plataforma. Mantenerse al día con estos cambios y comprender cómo afectan a los clientes, es crucial para proporcionar un soporte efectivo y asesoramiento sobre las últimas funcionalidades.

Requerimientos

  • Soft Skills: Empatía para comprender las necesidades y preocupaciones de los clientes, sensibilidad para leer las emociones, lectura activa, comunicación asertiva y paciencia

  • Problem-Solving: Nuestro día a día presenta problemáticas nuevas y desafiantes.

  • Aprendizaje Continuo: Así como Draftea evoluciona, también lo hace el equipo de CX. Ayuda a mejorar los procesos y herramientas de la operación.

  • User-Centric: Te debe motivar querer ayudar a que nuestros usuarios tengan siempre una experiencia extraordinaria. Recuerda que eres la voz de Draftea.

  • Experiencia: Dos años en puestos de atención a clientes, idealmente en canales online. Manejo de ticketeras (zendesk, freshdesk).

  • Ownership: Debes sentirte cómodo con adueñarte de procesos u operaciones y ejecutarlos con responsabilidad.

  • Disponibilidad: de horario para rolar turnos incluidos los fines de semana.

What you bring

  • Strong hands-on SQL experience, including query development, report building, troubleshooting, data validation, and data analysis.
  • Experience working with relational databases and learning complex database structures.
  • Professional Services, implementation, technical consulting, or enterprise-software delivery experience.
  • Experience with REST APIs, web services, system integrations, ETL/data movement, or file-based exchanges.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical solutions.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or end users.

raw.description:
Job Summary

For our client, we are looking for Senior Software Engineers with strong expertise in JAVA to join a remote team developing and enhancing mission-critical software systems within the financial services industry.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of high-performance, scalable applications while collaborating with experienced engineers, architects, and business stakeholders. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and work in a modern Agile environment using best software engineering practices.

You will be part of a long-term team augmentation project supporting a global investment management organization. Depending on your experience and interests, you may join one of the following engineering teams:

Execution Technology

Develop systems responsible for routing, executing, and monitoring trades across global markets, including broker and venue connectivity, order routing, trade lifecycle management, and execution analytics.

Order Management and Analytics

Build and enhance the core Order Management System (OMS), supporting the complete investment order lifecycle-from order creation and compliance checks to routing, execution, allocations, and audit trails. This area requires a strong focus on correctness, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Enterprise Engineering

Develop and maintain shared internal platforms, APIs, CI/CD tooling, and engineering infrastructure that support multiple development teams. The focus is on scalability, reliability, automation, and improving the overall developer experience.

This is a fully remote opportunity offering the chance to work on complex, business-critical systems using modern technologies while collaborating with international engineering teams. It is an excellent opportunity for senior engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems, building high-quality software, and contributing to the architecture of enterprise-scale platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex software solutions from requirements gathering and architecture design to development, testing, and production deployment;
  • Own and drive long-term technical initiatives and architectural improvements across systems;
  • Spotting gaps or unclear requirements early and proactively reaching out to the right teams for answers;
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business goals;
  • Champion engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and scalable design patterns;
  • Balancing multiple priorities at once, new features, production issues, support requests, and releases;
  • Operating day-to-day within the project tools, codebase, infrastructure, and processes as part of the project team.

Requirements:

  • 5-7+ years of experience as a software engineer;
  • Strong experience with Java (Spring Boot), Apache Kafka, and microservices architecture;
  • Confidence navigating and contributing to large, unfamiliar codebases;
  • Solid understanding of messaging protocols and data mapping;
  • Financial services background would be considered as advantage;
  • Experience working in regulated or institutional environments;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar);
  • Comfort using AI-assisted development tools;
  • Ability to work independently and drive things forward;
  • Exelent communication skills with a proactive, speak-up mindset.

Nice to have:

  • React.js experience is a plus;
  • FIX protocol experience;
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS);
  • Docker/containerisation experience.

The offer:

  • Project/Client:

    Global Investment Management Firm

  • Location: Remote (Baltic States, EU)
  • ﻿﻿Language: English
  • Engagement: Full-time
  • B2B contract till the end of the year (possibility to renew)
  • Hourly rate: 30-35 EUR

Selection Process

Stage 1: CV Screening

Your application will be reviewed within 24 hours of submission.

Stage 2: Pre-Screening

A short Q/A session to assess your experience and technical background. You can choose between:

  • Automated Q/A session (recommended for faster feedback)
  • Recruiter interview

Stage 3: Shortlisting

Candidates whose experience best matches the role will be shortlisted and presented to the hiring manager.

Stage 4: Technical Interview

The technical interview process includes:

  • Technical discussion with the Team Lead (approximately 30 minutes)
  • Live coding session (approximately 60 minutes)

Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)

Before the technical interview, candidates will be asked to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), as confidential information about the end client may be discussed during the interview.

To prepare the NDA, we will request the following information:

  • Full name
  • Residential address
  • National identification number (or equivalent identification required by your country)

Stage 5: End Client Interview

Candidates who successfully complete the previous stages will proceed to the end client interview process.

This stage may include one or more interview rounds. The first interview is typically a 60 min. (live coding) + 30 min. soft-skills discussion, focusing on your technical expertise, project experience, system design approach, and problem-solving skills.

Stage 6: Offer and Onboarding

Successful candidates will receive an offer and begin the onboarding process.

As part of the onboarding process, a background verification will be conducted. Candidates will be asked to provide the following documents:

  • Criminal Record Certificate
  • Confirmation that the contractor is not subject to financial sanctions (Financial Sanctions Screening)
  • Copies of educational certificates and diplomas
  • A valid work permit for the country where the contractor resides and works (if applicable)

Once all required documentation has been received and the background verification has been successfully completed, the onboarding process can begin.

---

Additional Information

  • We recommend completing the Automated Q/A Session during the pre-screening stage, as it typically allows us to provide feedback more quickly.
  • Candidates who prefer a traditional approach may instead complete the pre-screening with one of our recruiters.
  • We aim to keep candidates informed throughout the process and provide updates after each completed stage.
